178.s:
agnir uvāca
tṛtīyāvratānyākhyāsye bhuktimuktipradāni te /
lalitāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ mūlagaurīvrataṃ śṛṇu //
178.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
तृतीयाव्रतान्याख्यास्ये भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदानि ते /
ललितायां तृतीयायां मूलगौरीव्रतं शृणु //
178.m: Agni said: / I will declare to you the votive observances of the third lunar day, which grant worldly enjoyment and liberation. / Hear the Mūlagaurīvrata on the Lalitā third lunar day:

178.s:
tṛtīyāyāṃ caitraśukle ūḍhā gaurī hareṇa hi /
tilasnāto 'rcayecchambhuṃ gauryā haimaphalādibhiḥ //
178.d:
तृतीयायां चैत्रशुक्ले ऊढा गौरी हरेण हि /
तिलस्नातो ऽर्चयेच्छम्भुं गौर्या हैमफलादिभिः //
178.m: on the bright third lunar day of Caitra, Gaurī was indeed married by Hara. / Having bathed with sesame, one should worship Śambhu together with Gaurī with golden fruits and other offerings.

178.s:
namo 'stu pāṭalāyaiva pādau devyāḥ śivasya ca /
śivāyeti ca saṅkīrtya jayāyai gulphayoryajet //
178.d:
नमो ऽस्तु पाटलायैव पादौ देव्याः शिवस्य च /
शिवायेति च सङ्कीर्त्य जयायै गुल्फयोर्यजेत् //
178.m: ‘Salutation to the Rosy-red One,’ [worship] the feet of the Goddess and of Śiva; / and pronouncing ‘To Śivā,’ one should worship the ankles, [saying] ‘To Jayā’;

178.s:
tripuraghnāya rudrāya bhānyai jaṅghayordvayaoḥ /
śivaṃ rudrāyeśvarāya(1) vijayāyaiva jānunī //
178.d:
त्रिपुरघ्नाय रुद्राय भान्यै जङ्घयोर्द्वयओः /
शिवं रुद्रायेश्वराय(1) विजयायैव जानुनी //
178.m: ‘To Rudra, the Destroyer of Tripura,’ and ‘To the Resplendent One,’ [worship] the two shanks; / Śiva with ‘To Rudra, the Supreme Lord,’ and the two knees with ‘To Vijayā’;

178.s:
īśāyeti kaṭiṃ devyāḥ(2) śaṅkarāyeti śaṅkaram /
:n
1 śivaṃ rudrāya viśvāyeti kha.. , cha.. ca / śivaṃ bhadrāyeśvarāyeti ja..
, jha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca
2 īśāya kaṭyāṃ devyāś ca iti ṅa.. / īśāyeti tāto devyā iti
gha..
:p 202
kukṣidvayañca koṭavyai śūlinam śūlapāṇaye //
178.d:
ईशायेति कटिं देव्याः(2) शङ्करायेति शङ्करम् /
:न्
1 शिवं रुद्राय विश्वायेति ख.. , छ.. च / शिवं भद्रायेश्वरायेति ज..
, झ.. , ञ.. , ट.. च
2 ईशाय कट्यां देव्याश् च इति ङ.. / ईशायेति तातो देव्या इति
घ..
:प् 202
कुक्षिद्वयञ्च कोटव्यै शूलिनम् शूलपाणये //
178.m:
with ‘To Īśa,’ [worship] the waist of the Goddess, and Śaṅkara with ‘To Śaṅkara’;
:n
1 'śivaṃ rudrāya viśvāyeti' thus in kha and cha; 'śivaṃ bhadrāyeśvarāyeti' in ja, jha, ña, and ṭa.
2 'īśāya kaṭyāṃ devyāś ca' thus in ṅa; 'īśāyeti tāto devyā' in gha. / :p 202
and the two flanks with ‘To Koṭavī’; and the Trident-bearer with ‘To the Trident-handed One’.

178.s:
maṅgalāyai namastubhyamudarañcābhipūjayet /
sarvātmane namo rudramaiśānyai ca kucadvayaṃ //
178.d:
मङ्गलायै नमस्तुभ्यमुदरञ्चाभिपूजयेत् /
सर्वात्मने नमो रुद्रमैशान्यै च कुचद्वयं //
178.m: ‘Salutation to You, to Maṅgalā,’ one should worship the belly; / ‘Salutation to Rudra, the Self of All,’ and the two breasts with ‘To Aiśānī’;

178.s:
śivaṃ devātmane tadvat hrādinyai(1) kaṇṭhamarcayet /
mahādevāya ca śivamanantāyai karadvayaṃ //
178.d:
शिवं देवात्मने तद्वत् ह्रादिन्यै(1) कण्ठमर्चयेत् /
महादेवाय च शिवमनन्तायै करद्वयं //
178.m: likewise, Śiva with ‘To the Divine Self,’ and the neck [of the Goddess] with ‘To the Delighting One’; / and Śiva with ‘To Mahādeva,’ and the two hands with ‘To Anantā’;

178.s:
trilocanāyeti haraṃ bāhuṃ kālānalapriye(2) /
saubhāgyāyai maheśāya bhūṣaṇāni prapūjayet //
178.d:
त्रिलोचनायेति हरं बाहुं कालानलप्रिये(2) /
सौभाग्यायै महेशाय भूषणानि प्रपूजयेत् //
178.m: Hara with ‘To the Three-eyed One,’ and the arm with ‘O Beloved of the Fire of Time!’; / one should worship the ornaments with ‘To Saubhāgyā’ and ‘To Maheśa’;

178.s:
aśokamadhuvāsinyai īśvarāyeti cauṣṭhakau /
caturmukhapriyā cāsyaṃ harāya sthāṇave namaḥ //
178.d:
अशोकमधुवासिन्यै ईश्वरायेति चौष्ठकौ /
चतुर्मुखप्रिया चास्यं हराय स्थाणवे नमः //
178.m: and the two lips with ‘To the One dwelling in the nectar of Aśoka’ and ‘To Īśvara’; / the face with ‘Beloved of the Four-faced One’; ‘Salutation to Hara, to Sthāṇu’;

178.s:
namo 'rdhanārīśaharamamitāṅgyai ca nāsikāṃ /
nama ugrāya lokeśaṃ laliteti punarbhruvau //
178.d:
नमो ऽर्धनारीशहरममिताङ्ग्यै च नासिकां /
नम उग्राय लोकेशं ललितेति पुनर्भ्रुवौ //
178.m: ‘Salutation to the Lord who is half-woman, to Hara,’ and the nose with ‘To the Immense-bodied One’; / the Lord of the world with ‘Salutation to the Fierce One,’ and again the eyebrows with ‘Lalitā’;

178.s:
sarvāya purahantāraṃ(3) vāsantyai caiva tālukaṃ(4) /
namaḥ śrīkaṇṭhanāthāyai śitikaṇṭhāya keśakaṃ //
178.d:
सर्वाय पुरहन्तारं(3) वासन्त्यै चैव तालुकं(4) /
नमः श्रीकण्ठनाथायै शितिकण्ठाय केशकं //
178.m: the Destroyer of the cities with ‘To Śarva,’ and the palate with ‘To Vāsantī’; / the hair with ‘Salutation to the Mistress of Śrīkaṇṭha’ and ‘To the Dark-throated One’;

178.s:
bhīmogrāya supūpiṇyai śiraḥ sarvātmane namaḥ /
mallikāśokakamalakundantagaramālatī(5) //
178.d:
भीमोग्राय सुपूपिण्यै शिरः सर्वात्मने नमः /
मल्लिकाशोककमलकुन्दन्तगरमालती(5) //
178.m: the head with ‘To the Terrifyingly Fierce One, the Well-formed One’ and ‘Salutation to the Self of All’. / Mallikā, aśoka, lotus, kunda, tagara, mālatī,

178.s:
kadambakaravīrañca(6) vāṇamamlānakuṅkumaṃ /
sindhuvārañca māseṣu sarveṣu kramaśaḥ smṛtaṃ //
178.d:
कदम्बकरवीरञ्च(6) वाणमम्लानकुङ्कुमं /
सिन्धुवारञ्च मासेषु सर्वेषु क्रमशः स्मृतं //
178.m: kadamba, karavīra, vāṇa, unwithering [flower], saffron, / and sindhuvāra are prescribed respectively in all the months.

178.s:
umāmaheśvarau pūjya saubhāgyāṣṭakamagrataḥ(7) /
:n
1 śivaṃ vedātmane tadvadrūpiṇyai iti gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
2 harañcāntakālānalapriye iti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
3 purahartāramiti gha..
4 vāsanyai ca tathālakamiti cha.. , ṭa.. ca
5 mallikāśokakamalacchadaṃ tagaramālatī iti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca
6 kundañca karavīrañceti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca
7 mallikāśoketyādiḥ, saubhāgyāṣṭakamagrataḥ ity antaḥ cha..
pustake nāsti
:p 203
sthāpayed(1) ghṛtaniṣpāvakusumbhakṣīrajīvakaṃ //
178.d:
उमामहेश्वरौ पूज्य सौभाग्याष्टकमग्रतः(7) /
:न्
1 शिवं वेदात्मने तद्वद्रूपिण्यै इति घ.. , ज.. , ञ.. च
2 हरञ्चान्तकालानलप्रिये इति ख.. , घ.. , ज.. , ञ.. च
3 पुरहर्तारमिति घ..
4 वासन्यै च तथालकमिति छ.. , ट.. च
5 मल्लिकाशोककमलच्छदं तगरमालती इति ख.. , घ.. , ज.. च
6 कुन्दञ्च करवीरञ्चेति ख.. , घ.. , ज.. च
7 मल्लिकाशोकेत्यादिः, सौभाग्याष्टकमग्रतः इत्य् अन्तः छ..
पुस्तके नास्ति
:प् 203
स्थापयेद्(1) घृतनिष्पावकुसुम्भक्षीरजीवकं //
178.m:
Having worshipped Umā and Maheśvara, [one should place] the eight auspicious items before them:
:n
1 'śivaṃ vedātmane tadvadrūpiṇyai' thus in gha, ja, and ña.
2 'harañcāntakālānalapriye' thus in kha, gha, ja, and ña.
3 'purahartāram' thus in gha.
4 'vāsanyai ca tathālakam' thus in cha and ṭa.
5 'mallikāśokakamalacchadaṃ tagaramālatī' thus in kha, gha, and ja.
6 'kundañca karavīrañca' thus in kha, gha, ja.
7 The text from 'mallikāśoka-' up to 'saubhāgyāṣṭakamagrataḥ' is missing in manuscript cha. / :p 203
one should arrange: ghee, niṣpāva beans, safflower, milk, jīvaka,

178.s:
tarurājekṣulavaṇaṃ(2) kustumburumathāṣṭamaṃ /
caitre śṛgodakaṃ prāśya devadevyagrataḥ svapet //
178.d:
तरुराजेक्षुलवणं(2) कुस्तुम्बुरुमथाष्टमं /
चैत्रे शृगोदकं प्राश्य देवदेव्यग्रतः स्वपेत् //
178.m: sugarcane from the royal tree, salt, and eighth, coriander. / Having consumed water from a horn in Caitra, one should sleep before the God and Goddess.

178.s:
prātaḥ snātvā samabhyarcya vipradāmpatyamarcayet(3) /
tadaṣṭakaṃ dvije dadyāllalitā prīyatāṃ mama(4) //
178.d:
प्रातः स्नात्वा समभ्यर्च्य विप्रदाम्पत्यमर्चयेत्(3) /
तदष्टकं द्विजे दद्याल्ललिता प्रीयतां मम(4) //
178.m: Having bathed and worshipped in the morning, one should honor a Brahmin couple; / one should give that group of eight to a twice-born, saying: ‘May Lalitā be pleased with me!’

178.s:
śṛṅgodakaṃ(5) gomayaṃ ca mandāraṃ bilvapatrakaṃ /
kuśodakaṃ dadhi kṣīraṃ kārttike pṛṣadājyakam //
178.d:
शृङ्गोदकं(5) गोमयं च मन्दारं बिल्वपत्रकं /
कुशोदकं दधि क्षीरं कार्त्तिके पृषदाज्यकम् //
178.m: Water from a horn, cow dung, mandāra, bilva leaves, / kuśa water, curds, milk, and in Kārttika ghee mixed with curds,

178.s:
gomūtrājyaṃ kṛṣṇatilaṃ pañcagavyaṃ kramāśanaṃ /
lalitā vijayā bhadrā bhavānī kumudā śivā //
178.d:
गोमूत्राज्यं कृष्णतिलं पञ्चगव्यं क्रमाशनं /
ललिता विजया भद्रा भवानी कुमुदा शिवा //
178.m: cow urine with ghee, black sesame, and the five products of the cow are the successive items to be consumed. / ‘Lalitā, Vijayā, Bhadrā, Bhavānī, Kumudā, Śivā,

178.s:
vāsudevī tathā gaurī maṅgalā kamalā satī /
caitrādau dānakāle ca prīyatāmiti vācayet //
178.d:
वासुदेवी तथा गौरी मङ्गला कमला सती /
चैत्रादौ दानकाले च प्रीयतामिति वाचयेत् //
178.m: Vāsudevī, and Gaurī, Maṅgalā, Kamalā, Satī’— / in Caitra and the other [months], at the time of giving gifts, one should recite: ‘May she be pleased!’

178.s:
phalamekaṃ pavitrājyaṃ(6) vratānte śayānaṃ dadet /
umāmaheśvaraṃ haimaṃ vṛṣabhañca gavā saha //
178.d:
फलमेकं पवित्राज्यं(6) व्रतान्ते शयानं ददेत् /
उमामहेश्वरं हैमं वृषभञ्च गवा सह //
178.m: At the conclusion of the votive observance, one should give a fruit, pure ghee, and a bed, / a golden [image of] Umā and Maheśvara, and a bull along with a cow.

178.s:
guruñca mithunānyarcya(7) vastrādyair bhuktimuktibhāk(8) /
saubhāgyārogyarūpāyuḥ saubhāgyaśayanavratān //
178.d:
गुरुञ्च मिथुनान्यर्च्य(7) वस्त्राद्यैर् भुक्तिमुक्तिभाक्(8) /
सौभाग्यारोग्यरूपायुः सौभाग्यशयनव्रतान् //
178.m: And after worshiping the teacher and married couples with clothes and other offerings, one enjoys worldly enjoyment and liberation, / [and obtains] good fortune, health, beauty, and long life from the votive observance of the couch of good fortune.

178.s:
nabhasye vātha vaiśākhe kuryānmārgaśirasyatha(9) /
:n
1 arpayediti kha.. , cha.. ca
2 tṛṇarājekṣulavaṇamiti kha.. , cha.. , ṭa.. ca
3 dvijadāmpatyamarcayediti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ṭa.. ca
4 lalitā prīyatāmiti ṭa..
5 pṛṣṭhodakamiti ña.. / kūpodakamiti ja.. , jha.. ca
6 parityājyamiti ka.. , ja.. , ṭha.. ca / parityajyeti kha.. , cha.. ca / parigrāhyamiti
ṅa..
7 guruṃ mithunamabharcyeti ṅa..
8 vastrādyaiḥ sarvamāpnuyāditi kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa..
ca
9 kuryādvā mārgaśīrṣake iti ṅa.. , ña.. ca
:p 204
śuklapakṣe tṛtīyāyām lalitāyai namo yajet //
178.d:
नभस्ये वाथ वैशाखे कुर्यान्मार्गशिरस्यथ(9) /
:न्
1 अर्पयेदिति ख.. , छ.. च
2 तृणराजेक्षुलवणमिति ख.. , छ.. , ट.. च
3 द्विजदाम्पत्यमर्चयेदिति ख.. , घ.. , छ.. , ट.. च
4 ललिता प्रीयतामिति ट..
5 पृष्ठोदकमिति ञ.. / कूपोदकमिति ज.. , झ.. च
6 परित्याज्यमिति क.. , ज.. , ठ.. च / परित्यज्येति ख.. , छ.. च / परिग्राह्यमिति
ङ..
7 गुरुं मिथुनमभर्च्येति ङ..
8 वस्त्राद्यैः सर्वमाप्नुयादिति ख.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. , झ.. , ञ.. , ट..
च
9 कुर्याद्वा मार्गशीर्षके इति ङ.. , ञ.. च
:प् 204
शुक्लपक्षे तृतीयायाम् ललितायै नमो यजेत् //
178.m:
One should perform it in the month of Nabhasya (Bhādrapada), or in Vaiśākha, or in Mārgaśiras.
[Apparatus]
1 arpayed iti in Kha and Cha
2 tṛṇarājekṣulavaṇam iti in Kha, Cha, and Ṭa
3 dvijadāmpatyam arcayed iti in Kha, Gha, Cha, and Ṭa
4 lalitā prīyatām iti in Ṭa
5 pṛṣṭhodakam iti in Ña; kūpodakam iti in Ja and Jha
6 parityājyam iti in Ka, Ja, and Ṭha; parityajya iti in Kha and Cha; parigrāhyam iti in Ṅa
7 guruṃ mithunam abhyarcya iti in Ṅa
8 vastrādyaiḥ sarvam āpnuyād iti in Kha, Gha, Ṅa, Cha, Jha, Ña, and Ṭa
9 kuryād vā mārgaśīrṣake iti in Ṅa and Ña / [Page 204]
On the third lunar day of the bright fortnight, one should worship [saying]: “Homage to Lalitā!”

178.s:
pratipakṣaṃ tataḥ prārcya vratānte(1) mityunāni ca /
caturviṃśatimabhyarcya vastrādyair bhuktimuktibhāk //
178.d:
प्रतिपक्षं ततः प्रार्च्य व्रतान्ते(1) मित्युनानि च /
चतुर्विंशतिमभ्यर्च्य वस्त्राद्यैर् भुक्तिमुक्तिभाक् //
178.m: Then, having worshiped each fortnight, and at the conclusion of the votive observance having worshiped / twenty-four married couples with garments and the like, one enjoys worldly enjoyment and liberation.

178.s:
ukto mārgo dvitīyo 'yaṃ saubhāgyavratamāvade /
phālguṇāditṛtīyāyāṃ lavaṇaṃ yastu varjayet //
178.d:
उक्तो मार्गो द्वितीयो ऽयं सौभाग्यव्रतमावदे /
फाल्गुणादितृतीयायां लवणं यस्तु वर्जयेत् //
178.m: This second method has been declared; I shall explain the votive observance of good fortune: / Whoever gives up salt on the third lunar day from Phālguna onwards,

178.s:
samāpte śayanandadyādgṛhaścopaskarānvitaṃ /
sampūjya vipramithunaṃ bhavānī prīyatāmiti(2) //
178.d:
समाप्ते शयनन्दद्याद्गृहश्चोपस्करान्वितं /
सम्पूज्य विप्रमिथुनं भवानी प्रीयतामिति(2) //
178.m: upon its completion, one should donate a bed together with a house and household utensils, / having worshiped a brahmin couple, [saying]: “May Bhavānī be pleased!”

178.s:
saubhāgyārthaṃ tṛtīyoktā gaurīlokādidāyinī /
māghe bhādre ca vaiśākhe tṛtīyāvratakṛttathā //
178.d:
सौभाग्यार्थं तृतीयोक्ता गौरीलोकादिदायिनी /
माघे भाद्रे च वैशाखे तृतीयाव्रतकृत्तथा //
178.m: The third lunar day is declared to grant good fortune and bestow the world of Gaurī and other realms. / Likewise, one who observes the votive observance of the third lunar day in Māgha, Bhādra, and Vaiśākha,

178.s:
damanakatṛtīyākṛt caitre damanakair yajet /
ātmatṛtīyā mārgasya prārcyecchābhojanādinā //
178.d:
दमनकतृतीयाकृत् चैत्रे दमनकैर् यजेत् /
आत्मतृतीया मार्गस्य प्रार्च्येच्छाभोजनादिना //
178.m: and performs the Damanakatṛtīyā, should worship in Caitra with damanaka blossoms. / The Ātmatṛtīyā of the month of Mārga[śīrṣa] is worshiped with food to one's liking and other offerings.

178.s:
gaurī kālī umā bhadrā durgā kāntiḥ sarasvatī /
vaiṣṇavī lakṣmīḥ prakṛtiḥ śivā nārāyaṇī kramāt(3) //
178.d:
गौरी काली उमा भद्रा दुर्गा कान्तिः सरस्वती /
वैष्णवी लक्ष्मीः प्रकृतिः शिवा नारायणी क्रमात्(3) //
178.m: Gaurī, Kālī, Umā, Bhadrā, Durgā, Kānti, Sarasvatī, / Vaiṣṇavī, Lakṣmī, Prakṛti, Śivā, and Nārāyaṇī in succession—

178.s:
mārgatṛtīyāmārabhya saubhāgyaṃ svargamāpnuyāt //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe tṛtīyāvratāni nāma
aṣṭasaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 varṣānte iti kha.. , ṅa.. , ṭa.. ca
2 alaṅkārāṇi sarvāṇi bhavāno prīyatāmiti ṭa..
3 damanakatṛtīyākṛdityādiḥ nārāyaṇī kramādityantaḥ
pāṭhaḥ ja.. pustake nāsti
:p 205
:ś athaikonāśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
caturthīvratāni
178.d:
मार्गतृतीयामारभ्य सौभाग्यं स्वर्गमाप्नुयात् //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे तृतीयाव्रतानि नाम
अष्टसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 वर्षान्ते इति ख.. , ङ.. , ट.. च
2 अलङ्काराणि सर्वाणि भवानो प्रीयतामिति ट..
3 दमनकतृतीयाकृदित्यादिः नारायणी क्रमादित्यन्तः
पाठः ज.. पुस्तके नास्ति
:प् 205
:श् अथैकोनाशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
चतुर्थीव्रतानि
178.m:
beginning from the third lunar day of Mārgaśīrṣa, one attains good fortune and heaven.
Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-eighth chapter, entitled “Votive Observances of the Third Lunar Day,” in the great Agni Purāṇa.
[Apparatus]
1 varṣānte iti in Kha, Ṅa, and Ṭa
2 alaṅkārāṇi sarvāṇi bhavānī prīyatām iti in Ṭa
3 The passage from damanakatṛtīyākṛd up to nārāyaṇī kramād is missing in manuscript Ja / [Page 205]
Now, the one hundred and seventy-ninth chapter.
Votive Observances of the Fourth Lunar Day

179.s:
agnir uvāca
caturthī vratānyākhyāsye bhuktimuktipradāni te(1) /
māghe śuklacaturthyāntu upavāsī yajed guṇaṃ //
179.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
चतुर्थी व्रतान्याख्यास्ये भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदानि ते(1) /
माघे शुक्लचतुर्थ्यान्तु उपवासी यजेद् गुणं //
179.m: Agni said: / I shall explain the votive observances of the fourth lunar day, which bestow worldly enjoyment and liberation upon you. / On the fourth lunar day of the bright fortnight in Māgha, fasting, one should worship Gaṇa (Gaṇeśa).

179.s:
pañcamyāñca tilānnādī varṣānnirvighnataḥ(2) sukhī /
gaṃ svāhā(3) mūlamantro 'yaṃ gāmādyaṃ hṛdayādikaṃ //
179.d:
पञ्चम्याञ्च तिलान्नादी वर्षान्निर्विघ्नतः(2) सुखी /
गं स्वाहा(3) मूलमन्त्रो ऽयं गामाद्यं हृदयादिकं //
179.m: And on the fifth lunar day, eating sesamum rice, happy, one is free from obstacles for a year. / ‘Gaṃ svāhā’ is this root mantra; ‘Gām’ and the rest are [used for] the heart and other limbs.

179.s:
āgaccholkāya cāvāhya gaccholkāya visarjanaṃ /
ulkāntair gādigandhādyaiḥ pūjayenmodakādibhiḥ //
oṃ maholkāya vidmahe vakratuṇḍāya(4) dhīmahi tanno dantī
pracīdayāt
179.d:
आगच्छोल्काय चावाह्य गच्छोल्काय विसर्जनं /
उल्कान्तैर् गादिगन्धाद्यैः पूजयेन्मोदकादिभिः //
ओं महोल्काय विद्महे वक्रतुण्डाय(4) धीमहि तन्नो दन्ती
प्रचीदयात्
179.m:
With ‘Āgaccholkāya’ one invokes him, and with ‘Gaccholkāya’ one dismisses him. / One should worship with modakas and other offerings, along with fragrances and the rest beginning with ‘ga-’ and ending with ‘-ulkāya’.
“Oṃ. We know Maholka; we meditate upon Vakratuṇḍa; may that single-tusked one (Dantin) impel us.”

179.s:
māsi bhādrapade cāpi caturthīkṛcchivaṃ vrajet /
caturthyāṃ phālgune naktamavighnākhyā vrajet //
179.d:
मासि भाद्रपदे चापि चतुर्थीकृच्छिवं व्रजेत् /
चतुर्थ्यां फाल्गुने नक्तमविघ्नाख्या व्रजेत् //
179.m: And one who performs the fourth lunar day in the month of Bhādrapada goes to Śiva. / On the fourth lunar day in Phālguna, [eating] at night, one attains the [vow] named Avighnā.

179.s:
caturthyāṃ phālgune naktamavighnākhyā caturthyapi /
caturthyāṃ damanaiḥ pūjya caitre prārcya gaṇaṃ sukhī //
:e ity āgneye mahapurāṇe caturthīvratāni nāma
ekonāśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 caturthī vratakaṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradāyakamiti ṅa..
2 varṣannirvighnata iti ṅa.. , ña.. ca / varṣannirvighnavān iti ga..
3 hāṃ svāheti kha..
4 cakramuṇḍāyeti kha.. , gha.. ca / vakramuṇḍāyeti ṅa.. /
raktatuṇḍāyeti ja.. , jha.. ca
:p 206
:ś athāśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
pañcamīvratāni
179.d:
चतुर्थ्यां फाल्गुने नक्तमविघ्नाख्या चतुर्थ्यपि /
चतुर्थ्यां दमनैः पूज्य चैत्रे प्रार्च्य गणं सुखी //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महपुराणे चतुर्थीव्रतानि नाम
एकोनाशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 चतुर्थी व्रतकं वक्ष्ये भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकमिति ङ..
2 वर्षन्निर्विघ्नत इति ङ.. , ञ.. च / वर्षन्निर्विघ्नवान् इति ग..
3 हां स्वाहेति ख..
4 चक्रमुण्डायेति ख.. , घ.. च / वक्रमुण्डायेति ङ.. /
रक्ततुण्डायेति ज.. , झ.. च
:प् 206
:श् अथाशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
पञ्चमीव्रतानि
179.m:
On the fourth lunar day in Phālguna, [eating] at night, that fourth lunar day is also called Avighnā. / On the fourth lunar day in Caitra, having worshiped Gaṇa with damana leaves and adored him, one becomes happy.
Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-ninth chapter, entitled “Votive Observances of the Fourth Lunar Day,” in the great Agni Purāṇa.
[Apparatus]
1 caturthīvratakaṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradāyakam iti in Ṅa
2 varṣan nirvighnata iti in Ṅa and Ña; varṣan nirvighnavān iti in Ga
3 hāṃ svāhā iti in Kha
4 cakramuṇḍāya iti in Kha and Gha; vakramuṇḍāya iti in Ṅa;
raktatuṇḍāya iti in Ja and Jha / [Page 206]
Now, the one hundred and eightieth chapter.
Votive Observances of the Fifth Lunar Day

180.s:
agnir uvāca
pañcamīvratakaṃ vakṣye ārogyasvargamokṣadaṃ(1) /
nabhonabhasyāśvine ca kārttike śuklapakṣake //
180.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
पञ्चमीव्रतकं वक्ष्ये आरोग्यस्वर्गमोक्षदं(1) /
नभोनभस्याश्विने च कार्त्तिके शुक्लपक्षके //
180.m: Agni said: / I shall declare the votive observance of the fifth lunar day, which bestows health, heaven, and liberation. / In the bright fortnight of Nabhas (Śrāvaṇa), Nabhasya (Bhādrapada), Āśvina, and Kārttika,

180.s:
vāsukistakṣakaḥ pūjyaḥ kālīyo maṇibhadrakaḥ /
airāvato dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ karkoṭakadhanañjayau //
180.d:
वासुकिस्तक्षकः पूज्यः कालीयो मणिभद्रकः /
ऐरावतो धृतराष्ट्रः कर्कोटकधनञ्जयौ //
180.m: Vāsuki, Takṣaka, Kālīya, Maṇibhadraka, / Airāvata, Dhṛtarāṣṭra, Karkoṭaka, and Dhanañjaya are to be worshiped.

180.s:
ete prayacchantyabhayamāyurvidyāyaśaḥ śriyaṃ //3//
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe pañcamīvratāni nāma
aśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athaikāśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
ṣaṣṭhīvratāni
180.d:
एते प्रयच्छन्त्यभयमायुर्विद्यायशः श्रियं //3//
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे पञ्चमीव्रतानि नाम
अशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथैकाशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
षष्ठीव्रतानि
180.m:
These bestow freedom from fear, long life, learning, fame, and prosperity. // 3
Thus ends the one hundred and eightieth chapter, entitled “Votive Observances of the Fifth Lunar Day,” in the great Agni Purāṇa.
Now, the one hundred and eighty-first chapter.
Votive Observances of the Sixth Lunar Day

181.s:
agnir uvāca
ṣaṣṭhīvratāni vakṣyāmi kārttikādau samācaret(2) /
ṣaṣṭyāṃ phalāśano(3) 'rghyādyair bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt //
:n
1 ārogyamukhamokṣadamiti ṅa..
2 airāvata ity ādiḥ, kārttakādau samācaredityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha..
pustake nāsti
3 ṣaṣṭyāṃ malāśano 'rghyādyair iti ṭa..
:p 207
skandaṣaṣṭhīvrataṃ proktaṃ bhādre
181.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
षष्ठीव्रतानि वक्ष्यामि कार्त्तिकादौ समाचरेत्(2) /
षष्ट्यां फलाशनो(3) ऽर्घ्याद्यैर् भुक्तिमुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् //
:न्
1 आरोग्यमुखमोक्षदमिति ङ..
2 ऐरावत इत्य् आदिः, कार्त्तकादौ समाचरेदित्यन्तः पाठः झ..
पुस्तके नास्ति
3 षष्ट्यां मलाशनो ऽर्घ्याद्यैर् इति ट..
:प् 207
स्कन्दषष्ठीव्रतं प्रोक्तं भाद्रे
181.m:
Agni said: / I shall declare the votive observances of the sixth lunar day; one should undertake them beginning from Kārttika. / Eating fruit on the sixth lunar day, [worshiping] with water offerings and the like, one obtains worldly enjoyment and liberation.
[Apparatus]
1 ārogyamukhamokṣadam iti in Ṅa
2 The text from airāvata up to kārttikādau samācaret is missing in manuscript Jha
3 ṣaṣṭyāṃ malāśano 'rghyādyair iti in Ṭa / [Page 207]
The votive observance of Skandaṣaṣṭhī is declared in Bhādra[pada].

181.s:
ṣaṣṭyāmathākṣayaṃ /
kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhīvrataṃ vakṣye mārgaśīrṣe carecca tat(1) //
181.d:
षष्ट्यामथाक्षयं /
कृष्णषष्ठीव्रतं वक्ष्ये मार्गशीर्षे चरेच्च तत्(1) //
181.m: On the sixth lunar day, then, [the fruit is] imperishable. / I shall declare the votive observance of the dark sixth lunar day; one should observe that in Mārgaśīrṣa.

181.s:
anāhāro varṣamekaṃ bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt /
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe ṣaṣṭhīvratāni nāma
ekāśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha dvyaśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
saptamīvratāni
181.d:
अनाहारो वर्षमेकं भुक्तिमुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् /
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे षष्ठीव्रतानि नाम
एकाशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ द्व्यशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
सप्तमीव्रतानि
181.m:
Without food for one year, one attains worldly enjoyment and liberation.
Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-first chapter, entitled “Votive Observances of the Sixth Lunar Day,” in the great Agni Purāṇa.
Now, the one hundred and eighty-second chapter.
Votive observances of the seventh lunar day.

182.s:
agnir uvāca
saptamīvratakaṃ vakṣye sarveṣāṃ bhuktimuktidaṃ(2) /
māghamāse 'bjake śukle sūryaṃ prārcya viśokabhāk //
182.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
सप्तमीव्रतकं वक्ष्ये सर्वेषां भुक्तिमुक्तिदं(2) /
माघमासे ऽब्जके शुक्ले सूर्यं प्रार्च्य विशोकभाक् //
182.m: Agni said: / I shall explain the votive observance of the seventh lunar day, which grants worldly enjoyment and liberation to all. / Having thoroughly worshipped the sun on the bright seventh lunar day in the month of Māgha, one becomes free of sorrow.

182.s:
sarvāvāptistu saptabhyāṃ māsi bhādre 'rkapūjanāt /
pauṣe māsi site 'naśnan prārcyārkaṃ pāpanāśanaṃ //
182.d:
सर्वावाप्तिस्तु सप्तभ्यां मासि भाद्रे ऽर्कपूजनात् /
पौषे मासि सिते ऽनश्नन् प्रार्च्यार्कं पापनाशनं //
182.m: Attainment of all things comes from worshipping the sun on the seventh lunar day in the month of Bhādrapada. / Fasting in the bright fortnight of the month of Pauṣa and worshipping the sun destroys sin.

182.s:
kṛṣṇapakṣe tu māghasya sarvāvāptistu saptamī /
phālgune tu site nandā saptamī cārkapūjanāt //
182.d:
कृष्णपक्षे तु माघस्य सर्वावाप्तिस्तु सप्तमी /
फाल्गुने तु सिते नन्दा सप्तमी चार्कपूजनात् //
182.m: The seventh lunar day in the dark fortnight of Māgha brings the attainment of everything. / In Phālguna, in the bright fortnight, Nandā is the seventh lunar day by worshipping the sun.

182.s:
mārgaśīrṣe site prārcya saptamī cāparājitā /
mārgaśīrṣe site cāvdaṃ putrīyā saptamī striyāḥ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe saptamīvratāni nāma
dvyaśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 mārgaśīrṣe caredvratamiti gha.. , ja.. , jha.. , ṭa.. ca
2 sarvathā bhuktimuktidamiti gha.. , ja.. , jha.. ca
:p 208
:ś atha tryaśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
aṣṭamīvratāni
182.d:
मार्गशीर्षे सिते प्रार्च्य सप्तमी चापराजिता /
मार्गशीर्षे सिते चाव्दं पुत्रीया सप्तमी स्त्रियाः //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे सप्तमीव्रतानि नाम
द्व्यशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 मार्गशीर्षे चरेद्व्रतमिति घ.. , ज.. , झ.. , ट.. च
2 सर्वथा भुक्तिमुक्तिदमिति घ.. , ज.. , झ.. च
:प् 208
:श् अथ त्र्यशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
अष्टमीव्रतानि
182.m:
Having worshipped on the bright seventh lunar day in Mārgaśīrṣa, it is Aparājitā. / And observed for a year starting on the bright seventh of Mārgaśīrṣa, it is the Putrīyā seventh for a woman.
Thus in the great Purāṇa of Agni, the one hundred and eighty-second chapter, entitled 'Votive Observances of the Seventh Lunar Day'.
[Apparatus]
1 'mārgaśīrṣe caredvratam' in manuscripts gha, ja, jha, and ṭa.
2 'sarvathā bhuktimuktidam' in manuscripts gha, ja, and jha.
Now, the one hundred and eighty-third chapter.
Votive observances of the eighth lunar day.

183.s:
agnir uvāca
vakṣye vratāni cāṣṭamyāṃ rohiṇyāṃ prathamaṃ vrataṃ /
māsi bhādrapade 'ṣṭabhyāṃ rohiṇyāmardharātrake //
183.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
वक्ष्ये व्रतानि चाष्टम्यां रोहिण्यां प्रथमं व्रतं /
मासि भाद्रपदे ऽष्टभ्यां रोहिण्यामर्धरात्रके //
183.m: Agni said: / I shall explain the votive observances of the eighth lunar day. The first votive observance is on Rohiṇī: / in the month of Bhādrapada, on the eighth lunar day with Rohiṇī at midnight.

183.s:
kṛṣṇo jāto yatastasyāṃ jayantī syāttato 'ṣṭamī /
saptajanmakṛtāt pāpāt mucyate copavāsataḥ //
183.d:
कृष्णो जातो यतस्तस्यां जयन्ती स्यात्ततो ऽष्टमी /
सप्तजन्मकृतात् पापात् मुच्यते चोपवासतः //
183.m: Because Kṛṣṇa was born on it, that eighth lunar day is known as Jayantī. / Through fasting [on it], one is freed from sin committed over seven lifetimes.

183.s:
kṛṣṇapakṣe bhādrapade aṣṭamyāṃ rohiṇīyute /
upāṣitorcayet kṛṣṇaṃ(1) bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ //
183.d:
कृष्णपक्षे भाद्रपदे अष्टम्यां रोहिणीयुते /
उपाषितोर्चयेत् कृष्णं(1) भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकं //
183.m: In the dark fortnight of Bhādrapada, on the eighth lunar day conjoined with Rohiṇī, / one should fast and worship Kṛṣṇa, the bestower of worldly enjoyment and liberation:

183.s:
āvāhayāmyahaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ balabhadrañca devakīṃ /
vasudevaṃ yaśodāṅgāḥ(2) pūjayāmi namo 'stu te //
183.d:
आवाहयाम्यहं कृष्णं बलभद्रञ्च देवकीं /
वसुदेवं यशोदाङ्गाः(2) पूजयामि नमो ऽस्तु ते //
183.m: "I invoke Kṛṣṇa, Balabhadra, and Devakī, / Vasudeva, and Yaśodā with her attendants. I worship [them]; homage be to you!

183.s:
yogāya yogapataye yogeśāya namo namaḥ /
yogādisambhāvayaiva govindāya namo namaḥ //
183.d:
योगाय योगपतये योगेशाय नमो नमः /
योगादिसम्भावयैव गोविन्दाय नमो नमः //
183.m: Homage, homage to yoga, to the lord of yoga, to the master of yoga! / Homage, homage to Govinda, the origin of yoga and the rest!

183.s:
snānaṃ kṛṣṇāya dadyāttu arghyaṃ cānena dāpayet /
yajñāya yajñeśvarāya yajñānāṃ pataye namaḥ //
183.d:
स्नानं कृष्णाय दद्यात्तु अर्घ्यं चानेन दापयेत् /
यज्ञाय यज्ञेश्वराय यज्ञानां पतये नमः //
183.m: One should offer a bath to Kṛṣṇa, and should present water offering with this [mantra]: / "Homage to the sacrifice, to the lord of sacrifice, to the master of sacrifices!

183.s:
yajñādisaṃbhavāyaiva govindāya namo namaḥ /
gṛhāṇa deva puṣpāṇi sugandhīni priyāṇi te //
183.d:
यज्ञादिसंभवायैव गोविन्दाय नमो नमः /
गृहाण देव पुष्पाणि सुगन्धीनि प्रियाणि ते //
183.m: Homage, homage to Govinda, the origin of sacrifice and the rest! / Receive, O God, fragrant flowers dear to you!

183.s:
sarvakāmaprado deva bhava me devavandita /
dhūpadhūpita dhūpaṃ tvaṃ dhūpitaistvaṃ gṛhāṇa me //
183.d:
सर्वकामप्रदो देव भव मे देववन्दित /
धूपधूपित धूपं त्वं धूपितैस्त्वं गृहाण मे //
183.m: O God praised by the gods, become the fulfiller of all my desires! / O perfumed one, receive the incense offered by me!

183.s:
sugandha dhūpagandhāḍhyaṃ kuru māṃ sarvadā hare /
:n
1 viṣṇumiti ṭa..
2 yaśodāñceti ṅa.. , ja.. ca
:p 209
dīpadīpta mahādīpaṃ dīpadīptada sarvadā(1) //
183.d:
सुगन्ध धूपगन्धाढ्यं कुरु मां सर्वदा हरे /
:न्
1 विष्णुमिति ट..
2 यशोदाञ्चेति ङ.. , ज.. च
:प् 209
दीपदीप्त महादीपं दीपदीप्तद सर्वदा(1) //
183.m:
O Hari, always make me fragrant with the scent of incense!
[Footnote]
1 "viṣṇum" thus in manuscript ṭa.
2 "yaśodāñca" in manuscripts ṅa and ja. / [Page 209]
O blazing lamp, great lamp, bestower of light at all times!

183.s:
mayā dattaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ kuru cordhvagatiṃ ca māṃ /
viśvāya viśvapataye viśveśāya namo namaḥ(2) //
183.d:
मया दत्तं गृहाण त्वं कुरु चोर्ध्वगतिं च मां /
विश्वाय विश्वपतये विश्वेशाय नमो नमः(2) //
183.m: Receive [this lamp] offered by me, and grant me the upward path! / Homage, homage to the all, to the lord of the universe, to the master of the universe!

183.s:
viśvādisambhavāyaiva govindāya niveditaṃ /
dharmāya dharmapataye darmeśāya namo namaḥ //
183.d:
विश्वादिसम्भवायैव गोविन्दाय निवेदितं /
धर्माय धर्मपतये दर्मेशाय नमो नमः //
183.m: This offering is presented to Govinda, the origin of the universe and the rest! / Homage, homage to righteousness, to the lord of righteousness, to the master of righteousness!

183.s:
dharmādisambhavāyaiva govindaśayanaṃ kuru /
sarvāya sarvapataye sarveśāya namao namaḥ //
183.d:
धर्मादिसम्भवायैव गोविन्दशयनं कुरु /
सर्वाय सर्वपतये सर्वेशाय नमओ नमः //
183.m: To Govinda, the origin of righteousness and the rest: take your rest! / Homage, homage to the all, to the lord of all, to the master of all!

183.s:
sarvādisambhavāyaiva govindāya ca pāvanaṃ(3) /
kṣīrodārṇavasambhūta atrinetrasamudbhava //
183.d:
सर्वादिसम्भवायैव गोविन्दाय च पावनं(3) /
क्षीरोदार्णवसम्भूत अत्रिनेत्रसमुद्भव //
183.m: And the purifying [offering] to Govinda, the origin of all and the rest! / O you who arose from the Ocean of Milk, who originated from the eye of Atri,

183.s:
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ śaśāṅkedaṃ rohiṇyā sahito mama /
sthaṇḍile sthāpayeddevaṃ sacandrāṃ rohiṇīṃ yajet //
183.d:
गृहाणार्घ्यं शशाङ्केदं रोहिण्या सहितो मम /
स्थण्डिले स्थापयेद्देवं सचन्द्रां रोहिणीं यजेत् //
183.m: receive this water offering of mine, O Moon, together with Rohiṇī!" / One should place the god upon a cleared altar ground and worship Rohiṇī along with the Moon,

183.s:
devakīṃ vasudevaṃ ca yaśodāṃ nandakaṃ balaṃ /
ardharātre parodhārāḥ pātayed guḍasarpiṣā //
183.d:
देवकीं वसुदेवं च यशोदां नन्दकं बलं /
अर्धरात्रे परोधाराः पातयेद् गुडसर्पिषा //
183.m: Devakī, Vasudeva, Yaśodā, Nanda, and Balarāma. / At midnight one should pour out superior streams [of libation] with molasses and clarified butter.
The observer of the vow should give garments, gold, and other gifts, and feed brāhmaṇas. / One who performs the Janmāṣṭamī votive observance obtains sons and participates in the world of Viṣṇu.

183.s:
varṣe varṣe tu yaḥ kuryāt putrārthī vetti no bhayaṃ(5) /
putrān dehi dhanaṃ dehi āyurārogyasantatiṃ //
183.d:
वर्षे वर्षे तु यः कुर्यात् पुत्रार्थी वेत्ति नो भयं(5) /
पुत्रान् देहि धनं देहि आयुरारोग्यसन्ततिं //
183.m: One who desires a son and performs it year after year knows no fear: / "Grant me sons, grant me wealth, long life, health, and progeny!

183.s:
dharmaṃ kāmaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca dehi me /
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe jayantyaṣṭamīvrataṃ nāma
tryaśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 sarvadā iti gha.. , ṅa.. ca
2 viśveśāya namo 'stu te iti ja..
3 pāragamiti ga.. / sarvāyetyādiḥ. pāvanamityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ cha..
pustake nāsti
4 kṛṣṇalokabhāgiti cha..
5 putrārtho labhate sutamiti ja.. , ṭa.. ca
:p 210
:ś atha caturaśityadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
aṣṭamīvratāni
183.d:
धर्मं कामं च सौभाग्यं स्वर्गं मोक्षं च देहि मे /
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे जयन्त्यष्टमीव्रतं नाम
त्र्यशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 सर्वदा इति घ.. , ङ.. च
2 विश्वेशाय नमो ऽस्तु ते इति ज..
3 पारगमिति ग.. / सर्वायेत्यादिः. पावनमित्यन्तः पाठः छ..
पुस्तके नास्ति
4 कृष्णलोकभागिति छ..
5 पुत्रार्थो लभते सुतमिति ज.. , ट.. च
:प् 210
:श् अथ चतुरशित्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
अष्टमीव्रतानि
183.m:
Grant me righteousness, pleasure, good fortune, heaven, and liberation!"
Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-third chapter, entitled "The Jayantyaṣṭamī Votive Observance," in the Great Purāṇa of Agni.
[Footnote]
1 "sarvadā" thus in manuscripts gha and ṅa.
2 "viśveśāya namo 'stu te" thus in manuscript ja.
3 "pāragam" in manuscript ga. / The reading beginning with "sarvāya" and ending with "pāvanam" is missing in manuscript cha.
4 "kṛṣṇalokabhāk" in manuscript cha.
5 "putrārtho labhate sutam" in manuscripts ja and ṭa. / [Page 210]
Now, the one hundred and eighty-fourth chapter.
Votive observances of the eighth lunar day.

184.s:
agnir uvāca
brahmādimātṛyajanājjapen mātṛgaṇāṣṭamīṃ /
kṛṣṇāṣṭābhyāṃ caitramāse pūjyābdaṃkṛṣṇamarthabhāk //
184.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
ब्रह्मादिमातृयजनाज्जपेन् मातृगणाष्टमीं /
कृष्णाष्टाभ्यां चैत्रमासे पूज्याब्दंकृष्णमर्थभाक् //
184.m: Agni said: / From worshipping the Mothers headed by Brahmā, one should recite on the eighth day sacred to the host of Mothers. / Worshipping Kṛṣṇa on the dark eighth lunar day in the month of Caitra for a year, one gains prosperity.

184.s:
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīvrataṃ vakṣye māse mārgaśire caret /
naktaṃ kṛtvā śucirbhūtvā gomūtraṃ prāśayenniśi //
184.d:
कृष्णाष्टमीव्रतं वक्ष्ये मासे मार्गशिरे चरेत् /
नक्तं कृत्वा शुचिर्भूत्वा गोमूत्रं प्राशयेन्निशि //
184.m: I shall declare the votive observance of the dark eighth lunar day. One should perform it in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa: / having taken only an evening meal and having become pure, one should consume cow urine at night.

184.s:
bhūmiśāyī niśāyāñca śaṅkaraṃ pujayed vratī /
pauṣe śambhuṃ ghṛtaṃ prāśya māghe kṣīraṃmaheśvaram(1) //
184.d:
भूमिशायी निशायाञ्च शङ्करं पुजयेद् व्रती /
पौषे शम्भुं घृतं प्राश्य माघे क्षीरंमहेश्वरम्(1) //
184.m: Sleeping on the ground at night, the observer of the vow should worship Śaṅkara. / In Pauṣa [one should worship] Śambhu after consuming clarified butter, in Māgha Maheśvara [after consuming] milk;

184.s:
mahādevaṃ phālgune ca tilāśī(2) samupoṣitaḥ /
caitre sthāṇuṃ yavāśī ca vaiśākhe 'tha śivaṃ yajet //
184.d:
महादेवं फाल्गुने च तिलाशी(2) समुपोषितः /
चैत्रे स्थाणुं यवाशी च वैशाखे ऽथ शिवं यजेत् //
184.m: in Phālguna Mahādeva, fasting and eating sesame seeds; / in Caitra Sthāṇu while eating barley; and in Vaiśākha one should worship Śiva

184.s:
kuśodaśī paśupatiṃ jyaiṣṭhe śṛṅgodakāśanaḥ /
āṣāḍhe gomayāśyugraṃ śrāvaṇe sarvamarkabhuk //
184.d:
कुशोदशी पशुपतिं ज्यैष्ठे शृङ्गोदकाशनः /
आषाढे गोमयाश्युग्रं श्रावणे सर्वमर्कभुक् //
184.m: drinking kuśa-grass water; in Jyaiṣṭha Paśupati while drinking water poured over a horn; / in Āṣāḍha Ugra while eating cow dung; in Śrāvaṇa Sarva while consuming calotropis;

184.s:
tryambakaṃ ca bhādrapade bilvapatrāśano niśi /
taṇḍulāśī cāśvayuje īśaṃ rudantu kārttike //
184.d:
त्र्यम्बकं च भाद्रपदे बिल्वपत्राशनो निशि /
तण्डुलाशी चाश्वयुजे ईशं रुदन्तु कार्त्तिके //
184.m: in Bhādrapada Tryambaka while eating bilva leaves at night; / in Āśvina [worship] Īśa while eating rice grains, and in Kārttika Rudra

184.s:
dadhyāśī homakārī syādvarṣānte maṇḍale yajet(3) /
govastrahema gurave dadyādviprebhya īdṛśaṃ //
184.d:
दध्याशी होमकारी स्याद्वर्षान्ते मण्डले यजेत्(3) /
गोवस्त्रहेम गुरवे दद्याद्विप्रेभ्य ईदृशं //
184.m: while eating curd, performing a fire oblation. At the end of the year, one should worship in a maṇḍala. / One should give a cow, garments, and gold to the guru, and similar gifts to the brāhmaṇas.

184.s:
prārthayitvā dvijān bhojya(4) bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt /
:n
1 māghe kṣīrī maheśvaramiti gha.. , cha.. , ña.. ca
2 tilādīti ja..
3 varṣe varṣe tu maṇḍale iti ña..
4 dvijān toṣya iti ja..
:p 211
naktāśī tvaṣṭamīṣu syād vatsarānte ca dhenudaḥ //
184.d:
प्रार्थयित्वा द्विजान् भोज्य(4) भुक्तिमुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् /
:न्
1 माघे क्षीरी महेश्वरमिति घ.. , छ.. , ञ.. च
2 तिलादीति ज..
3 वर्षे वर्षे तु मण्डले इति ञ..
4 द्विजान् तोष्य इति ज..
:प् 211
नक्ताशी त्वष्टमीषु स्याद् वत्सरान्ते च धेनुदः //
184.m:
Having prayed and fed the twice-born, one attains worldly enjoyment and liberation.
[Footnote]
1 "māghe kṣīrī maheśvaram" in manuscripts gha, cha, and ña.
2 "tilādī" in manuscript ja.
3 "varṣe varṣe tu maṇḍale" in manuscript ña.
4 "dvijān toṣya" in manuscript ja. / [Page 211]
One should eat only at night on the eighth lunar days, and give a milch cow at the end of the year.

184.s:
paurandaraṃ padaṃ yāti svargativratamucyate(1) /
aṣṭamī budhavāreṇa pakṣayorubhayoryadā //
184.d:
पौरन्दरं पदं याति स्वर्गतिव्रतमुच्यते(1) /
अष्टमी बुधवारेण पक्षयोरुभयोर्यदा //
184.m: One attains the abode of Indra; this is called the votive observance for reaching heaven. / When the eighth lunar day falls on a Wednesday in either fortnight,

184.s:
tadā vrataṃ prakurvīta athavā saguḍāśitā /
tasyāṃ niyamakartāro na syuḥ khaṇḍitasampadaḥ //
184.d:
तदा व्रतं प्रकुर्वीत अथवा सगुडाशिता /
तस्यां नियमकर्तारो न स्युः खण्डितसम्पदः //
184.m: then one should perform the votive observance, or eat food with molasses. / Those who observe rules on that day do not have their fortunes impaired.

184.s:
taṇḍulasyāṣṭamuṣṭīnāṃ varjayitvāṅgulīdvayaṃ /
bhaktaṃ kṛtvā cāmrapuṭe sakuśe sakulāmbikāṃ //
184.d:
तण्डुलस्याष्टमुष्टीनां वर्जयित्वाङ्गुलीद्वयं /
भक्तं कृत्वा चाम्रपुटे सकुशे सकुलाम्बिकां //
184.m: Taking eight handfuls of rice grains minus two fingerbreadths, / and making cooked food in an folded mango leaf with kuśa grass, / [one should worship] the Mother of the family.

184.s:
sāttvikaṃ pūjayitvāṅgaṃ bhuñjīta ca kathāśravāt /
śaktito dakṣiṇāndadyāt karkaṭīntaṇḍulānvitāṃ(2) //
184.d:
सात्त्विकं पूजयित्वाङ्गं भुञ्जीत च कथाश्रवात् /
शक्तितो दक्षिणान्दद्यात् कर्कटीन्तण्डुलान्वितां(2) //
184.m: Having worshipped the pure [goddess], one should eat after hearing the sacred story. / According to one's capacity, one should give a sacrificial fee, [along with] a cucumber accompanied by rice grains.

184.s:
dhīro dvijo 'sya(3) bhāryāsti rambhā putrastu kaiśikaḥ /
duhitā vijayā tasya dhīrasya dhanado vṛṣaḥ(4) //
184.d:
धीरो द्विजो ऽस्य(3) भार्यास्ति रम्भा पुत्रस्तु कैशिकः /
दुहिता विजया तस्य धीरस्य धनदो वृषः(4) //
184.m: There was a wise brāhmaṇa whose wife was Rambhā, and his son was Kauśika; / his daughter was Vijayā. That wise man had a bull that bestowed wealth.

184.s:
kauśikastaṃ gṛhītvā tu gopālaiścārayan vṛṣaṃ /
gaṅgāyāṃ snānakṛtye 'tha(5) nītaś caurair vṛṣastadā //
184.d:
कौशिकस्तं गृहीत्वा तु गोपालैश्चारयन् वृषं /
गङ्गायां स्नानकृत्ये ऽथ(5) नीतश् चौरैर् वृषस्तदा //
184.m: Kauśika took that bull and grazed it with the cowherds. / Then, during the bath in the Gaṅgā, the bull was carried off by thieves.

184.s:
snātvā vṛṣamapaśyan sa vṛṣaṃ mārgitumāgataḥ /
vijayābhaginīyukto dadarśa sa sarovare //
184.d:
स्नात्वा वृषमपश्यन् स वृषं मार्गितुमागतः /
विजयाभगिनीयुक्तो ददर्श स सरोवरे //
184.m: Having bathed and not seeing the bull, he went to search for the bull; / accompanied by his sister Vijayā, he saw at a lake

184.s:
divyastrīyoṣitāṃ vṛndamavravīddehi bhojanaṃ /
strīvṛndamūce vratakṛd bhuṅkṣva tvamatithiryataḥ //
184.d:
दिव्यस्त्रीयोषितां वृन्दमव्रवीद्देहि भोजनं /
स्त्रीवृन्दमूचे व्रतकृद् भुङ्क्ष्व त्वमतिथिर्यतः //
184.m: a company of celestial women. He said: "Give [us] food!" / The group of women said: "Perform the vow, and then eat, since you are a guest."

184.s:
vrataṃ kṛtvā sa bubhuje prāptavān vanapālakaṃ /
:n
1 sugativratamucyate iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca
/suśāntivratamucyate iti ja..
2 karkarīntaṇḍulānvitāmiti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca /
gargarīntaṇḍulānvitāmiti jha..
3 vīro dvijo 'syeti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
4 vīrasya dhanapo vṛṣa iti kha.. , cha.. , ṭa.. ca / vīrasya dhanado
vṛṣa iti gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
5 snānakṛtyeṣu iti ṭa..
:p 212
gato dhīraḥ(1) savṛṣabho vijayāsahitastadā //
184.d:
व्रतं कृत्वा स बुभुजे प्राप्तवान् वनपालकं /
:न्
1 सुगतिव्रतमुच्यते इति ख.. , घ.. , छ.. , ज.. , ञ.. , ट.. च
/सुशान्तिव्रतमुच्यते इति ज..
2 कर्करीन्तण्डुलान्वितामिति ख.. , घ.. , ङ.. च /
गर्गरीन्तण्डुलान्वितामिति झ..
3 वीरो द्विजो ऽस्येति ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , ज.. , ञ.. च
4 वीरस्य धनपो वृष इति ख.. , छ.. , ट.. च / वीरस्य धनदो
वृष इति घ.. , ङ.. , ज.. , ञ.. च
5 स्नानकृत्येषु इति ट..
:प् 212
गतो धीरः(1) सवृषभो विजयासहितस्तदा //
184.m:
Having performed the vow, he ate, and found the guardian of the forest.
[Footnote]
1 "sugativratamucyate" in manuscripts kha, gha, cha, ja, ña, and ṭa; / "suśāntivratamucyate" in manuscript ja.
2 "karkarīntaṇḍulānvitām" in manuscripts kha, gha, and ṅa;
"gargarīntaṇḍulānvitām" in manuscript jha.
3 'vīro dvijo 'sya' in manuscripts ga, gha, ṅa, ja, and ña.
4 'vīrasya dhanapo vṛṣaḥ' in manuscripts kha, cha, and ṭa; 'vīrasya dhanado vṛṣaḥ' in manuscripts gha, ṅa, ja, and ña.
5 'snānakṛtyeṣu' in manuscript ṭa.
Then Dhīra went, accompanied by the bull and along with Vijayā.

184.s:
dhīreṇa(2) vijayā dattā yamāyāntaritaḥ pitā /
vratabhāvāt kauśiko 'pi hy ayodhyāyāṃ nṛpo 'bhavat //
184.d:
धीरेण(2) विजया दत्ता यमायान्तरितः पिता /
व्रतभावात् कौशिको ऽपि ह्य् अयोध्यायां नृपो ऽभवत् //
184.m: Vijayā was given by Dhīra to Yama; his father was concealed [from torment]. / Due to the power of the votive observance, Kauśika also became king in Ayodhyā.

184.s:
pitrostu narake dṛṣṭvā vijayārtiṃ yame gatā /
mṛgayāmāgataṃ proce mucyate narakāt kathaṃ //
184.d:
पित्रोस्तु नरके दृष्ट्वा विजयार्तिं यमे गता /
मृगयामागतं प्रोचे मुच्यते नरकात् कथं //
184.m: Having seen the torment of her parents in hell, Vijayā went to Yama / and said to him as he arrived from hunting: 'How may [they] be freed from hell?'

184.s:
vratadvayādyamaḥ proce prāpya tat kaiśiko dadau /
budhāṣṭamīdvayaphalaṃ svargatau pitarau tataḥ(3) //
184.d:
व्रतद्वयाद्यमः प्रोचे प्राप्य तत् कैशिको ददौ /
बुधाष्टमीद्वयफलं स्वर्गतौ पितरौ ततः(3) //
184.m: Yama said, 'From the two votive observances.' Having obtained that, Kauśika gave / the fruit of two Budhāṣṭamī [observances]; thereupon the two parents went to heaven.

184.s:
vijayā harṣitā cakre vrataṃ bhuktyādisiddhaye /
aśokakalikāścāṣtau ye pivanti punarvasau //
184.d:
विजया हर्षिता चक्रे व्रतं भुक्त्यादिसिद्धये /
अशोककलिकाश्चाष्तौ ये पिवन्ति पुनर्वसौ //
184.m: Delighted, Vijayā undertook the votive observance for the attainment of worldly enjoyment and other ends. / Those who drink eight buds of the aśoka tree on the Punarvasu asterism,

184.s:
caitre māsi sitāṣṭamyāṃ na te śokamavāpnuyuḥ /
tvāmaśokaharābhīṣṭa madhumāsasamuḍgava //
184.d:
चैत्रे मासि सिताष्टम्यां न ते शोकमवाप्नुयुः /
त्वामशोकहराभीष्ट मधुमाससमुड्गव //
184.m: on the bright eighth lunar day in the month of Caitra, shall not incur grief: / 'O aśoka, dear to Śiva, born in the spring month,

184.s:
pivāmi śokasantapto māmaśokaṃ sadā kuru /
caitrādau mātṛpūjākṛdaṣṭamyāṃ jayate ripūn //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe aṣṭamīvratāni nāma
caturaśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha pañcāśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
navamīvratāni ||
184.d:
पिवामि शोकसन्तप्तो मामशोकं सदा कुरु /
चैत्रादौ मातृपूजाकृदष्टम्यां जयते रिपून् //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे अष्टमीव्रतानि नाम
चतुरशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ पञ्चाशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
नवमीव्रतानि ||
184.m:
tormented by sorrow, I drink [you]; make me forever free of sorrow!' / One who worships the Mothers on the eighth lunar day in the beginning of Caitra overcomes enemies.
Thus in the great Purāṇa of Agni, the one hundred and eighty-fourth chapter, entitled 'Votive Observances of the Eighth Lunar Day'.
Now, the one hundred and eighty-fifth chapter.
Votive observances of the ninth lunar day.

185.s:
agnir uvāca
navamīvratakaṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktyādisiddhidaṃ /
devī pūjyāśvine śukle gauryākhyānavamīvrataṃ //
:n
1 gato vīra iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
2 vīreṇeti ṭa..
3 pitarau tadeti kha..
:p 213
185.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
नवमीव्रतकं वक्ष्ये भुक्तिमुक्त्यादिसिद्धिदं /
देवी पूज्याश्विने शुक्ले गौर्याख्यानवमीव्रतं //
:न्
1 गतो वीर इति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , ज.. , ञ.. च
2 वीरेणेति ट..
3 पितरौ तदेति ख..
:प् 213
185.m:
Agni said: / I shall declare the votive observance of the ninth lunar day, which grants the attainment of worldly enjoyment, liberation, and other fruits. / The Goddess should be worshipped in the bright fortnight of Āśvina; it is the votive observance of the ninth lunar day named Gaurī.
[Apparatus]
1 'gato vīraḥ' in manuscripts kha, ga, gha, ṅa, ja, and ña.
2 'vīreṇa' in manuscript ṭa.
3 'pitarau tadā' in manuscript kha.

185.s:
piṣṭakākhyā tu navamī piṣṭāśī devapūjanāt /
aṣṭamyāmāśvine śukte kanyārkamūlabhe yadā //
185.d:
पिष्टकाख्या तु नवमी पिष्टाशी देवपूजनात् /
अष्टम्यामाश्विने शुक्ते कन्यार्कमूलभे यदा //
185.m: The ninth lunar day is named Piṣṭakā, where one eats ground meal after worshipping the deity. / When on the bright eighth lunar day in Āśvina, the sun is in Virgo and the asterism is Mūla,

185.s:
aghārdanā sarvadā vai mahatī navamī smṛtā /
durgā tu navagehasthā ekāgārasthitāthavā //
185.d:
अघार्दना सर्वदा वै महती नवमी स्मृता /
दुर्गा तु नवगेहस्था एकागारस्थिताथवा //
185.m: it destroys sins at all times; it is known as the Great Ninth Lunar Day. / Durgā, situated in nine chambers or standing in a single abode,

185.s:
pūjitāṣṭādaśabhujā śeṣāḥ ṣoḍaśamatkarāḥ(1) /
śeṣāḥ ṣoḍaśahastāḥ syurañjanaṃ ḍamaruntathā //
185.d:
पूजिताष्टादशभुजा शेषाः षोडशमत्कराः(1) /
शेषाः षोडशहस्ताः स्युरञ्जनं डमरुन्तथा //
185.m: is worshipped with eighteen arms; the remaining [goddesses] have sixteen hands. / The remaining ones should have sixteen hands, holding collyrium and a drum,

185.s:
rudracaṇḍā pracaṇḍā ca caṇḍogrā saṇḍanāyikā /
caṇḍā caṇḍavatī pūjyā caṇḍarūpāticaṇḍikā //
185.d:
रुद्रचण्डा प्रचण्डा च चण्डोग्रा सण्डनायिका /
चण्डा चण्डवती पूज्या चण्डरूपातिचण्डिका //
185.m: Rudracaṇḍā, Pracaṇḍā, Caṇḍogrā, Caṇḍanāyikā, / Caṇḍā, Caṇḍavatī, Caṇḍarūpā, and Aticaṇḍikā should be worshipped,

185.s:
kramānmadhye cogracaṇḍā durgā mahiṣamardinī(2) /
oṃ durge durge rakṣaṇi svāhā daśākṣāro mantraḥ //
185.d:
क्रमान्मध्ये चोग्रचण्डा दुर्गा महिषमर्दिनी(2) /
ओं दुर्गे दुर्गे रक्षणि स्वाहा दशाक्षारो मन्त्रः //
185.m: and in order in their midst, Ugracaṇḍā, Durgā the slayer of Mahiṣa. / 'Oṃ durge durge rakṣaṇi svāhā' is the ten-syllable mantra.

185.s:
dīrghākārādimantrādir navanetro namo 'ntikaḥ /
ṣaḍbhiḥ padair namaḥsvadhāvaṣaṭkārahṛdādikaṃ //
185.d:
दीर्घाकारादिमन्त्रादिर् नवनेत्रो नमो ऽन्तिकः /
षड्भिः पदैर् नमःस्वधावषट्कारहृदादिकं //
185.m: The mantra begins with long vowels, has nine eyes, and ends with namaḥ. / With six words accompanied by namaḥ, svadhā, and vaṣaṭ, one performs [the nyāsa of] the heart and other limbs,

185.s:
aṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntaṃ nyasyāṅgāni japecchivāṃ(3) /
etañjapati(4) yo guhyaṃ nāsau kenāpi bādhyate //
185.d:
अङ्गुष्ठादिकनिष्ठान्तं न्यस्याङ्गानि जपेच्छिवां(3) /
एतञ्जपति(4) यो गुह्यं नासौ केनापि बाध्यते //
185.m: depositing the limbs from the thumb to the little finger, and should recite [the mantra of] the auspicious goddess. / Whoever recites this secret mantra is not afflicted by anyone.

185.s:
kapālaṃ kheṭakaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ darpaṇantarjanīndhanuḥ /
dhvajaṇḍamarukaṃ pāśaṃ vāmahasteṣu vibhratīṃ //
185.d:
कपालं खेटकं घण्टां दर्पणन्तर्जनीन्धनुः /
ध्वजण्डमरुकं पाशं वामहस्तेषु विभ्रतीं //
185.m: [She is visualised] bearing in her left hands a skull-cup, a shield, a bell, a mirror, a forefinger gesture, a bow, / a flag, a small drum, and a noose;

185.s:
śaktimudgaraśūlāni vajraṃ khaḍgañca kuntakaṃ /
śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ śalākāṃ ca āyudhāni ca pūjayet //
185.d:
शक्तिमुद्गरशूलानि वज्रं खड्गञ्च कुन्तकं /
शङ्खं चक्रं शलाकां च आयुधानि च पूजयेत् //
185.m: and one should worship her weapons: a spear, a mallet, trident, thunderbolt, sword, lance, / conch, discus, and dart.

185.s:
paśuñca kālī kālīti japtvā khaḍgena ghātayet /
kāli kāli vajreśvari lauhadaṇḍāyai namaḥ //
:n
1 ṣoḍaśahastakā iti ṅa..
2 kramāt madhye copacaṇḍāṃ kṭtvā mahiṣamardinīmiti ga..
3 dīrghākārādītyādiḥ, japecchivāmityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ gha.. , ja..
, jha.. , ña.. pustake nāsti
4 evaṃ japatīti ja.. , jha.. ca
:p 214
185.d:
पशुञ्च काली कालीति जप्त्वा खड्गेन घातयेत् /
कालि कालि वज्रेश्वरि लौहदण्डायै नमः //
:न्
1 षोडशहस्तका इति ङ..
2 क्रमात् मध्ये चोपचण्डां क्ट्त्वा महिषमर्दिनीमिति ग..
3 दीर्घाकारादीत्यादिः, जपेच्छिवामित्यन्तः पाठः घ.. , ज..
, झ.. , ञ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
4 एवं जपतीति ज.. , झ.. च
:प् 214
185.m:
Having recited 'Kālī, Kālī', one should slay the sacrificial animal with a sword: / 'Kālī, Kālī, O Vajreśvarī, homage to the iron-staffed goddess!'
[Apparatus]
1 'ṣoḍaśahastakāḥ' in manuscript ṅa.
2 'kramāt madhye copacaṇḍāṃ kṛtvā mahiṣamardinīm' in manuscript ga.
3 The text from 'dīrghākārādi' up to 'japecchivām' is missing in manuscripts gha, ja, jha, and ña.
4 'evaṃ japati' in manuscripts ja and jha.

185.s:
tadutthaṃ rudhiraṃ māṃsaṃ pūtanāyai ca nairṛte /
vāyavyāṃ pāparākṣasyai carakyai nama īśvare //
185.d:
तदुत्थं रुधिरं मांसं पूतनायै च नैरृते /
वायव्यां पापराक्षस्यै चरक्यै नम ईश्वरे //
185.m: The blood and meat arising from it [should be offered] to Pūtanā in the southwest, / to the sinful demoness Carakī in the northwest, 'Homage to the sovereign goddess!';

185.s:
vidārikāyai cāgneyyāṃ mahākauśikamagnaye(1) /
tasyāgrato nṛpaḥ snāyācchatruṃ piṣṭamayaṃ haret(2) //
185.d:
विदारिकायै चाग्नेय्यां महाकौशिकमग्नये(1) /
तस्याग्रतो नृपः स्नायाच्छत्रुं पिष्टमयं हरेत्(2) //
185.m: and to Vidārikā in the southeast, [and] to Mahākauśika for Agni. / Before her, the king should bathe and destroy an enemy made of flour.

185.s:
dadyāt skandaviśākhābhyāṃ brāhmādyā niśi tā yajet /
jayantī maṅgalā kālī bhadrakālī kapālinī //
185.d:
दद्यात् स्कन्दविशाखाभ्यां ब्राह्माद्या निशि ता यजेत् /
जयन्ती मङ्गला काली भद्रकाली कपालिनी //
185.m: He should give [offerings] to Skanda and Viśākha; at night he should sacrifice to Brāhmī and the others: / Jayantī, Maṅgalā, Kālī, Bhadrakālī, Kapālinī,

185.s:
durgā śivā kṣamā dhātrī svāhā svadhā namo 'stu te /
devīṃ pañcāmṛtaiḥ snāpya pūjayeccārhaṇādinā //
185.d:
दुर्गा शिवा क्षमा धात्री स्वाहा स्वधा नमो ऽस्तु ते /
देवीं पञ्चामृतैः स्नाप्य पूजयेच्चार्हणादिना //
185.m: Durgā, Śivā, Kṣamā, Dhātrī, Svāhā, Svadhā, reverence to you! / Having bathed the Goddess with the five nectars, one should worship her with respectful offerings and the like.

185.s:
dhvajādirathayātrādibalidānaṃ varādikṛt /
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe navamīvratāni nāma
pañcāśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha ṣaḍaśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
daśamīvrataṃ
185.d:
ध्वजादिरथयात्रादिबलिदानं वरादिकृत् /
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे नवमीव्रतानि नाम
पञ्चाशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ षडशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
दशमीव्रतं
185.m:
The hoisting of flags, chariot processions, and animal sacrifices bestow boons and the like.
Thus in the great Purāṇa of Agni, the one hundred and eighty-fifth chapter, entitled 'Votive Observances of the Ninth Lunar Day'.
Now, the one hundred and eighty-sixth chapter.
Votive observance of the tenth lunar day.

186.s:
agnir uvāca
daśamīvratakaṃ vakṣye dharmakāmādidāyakaṃ /
daśamyāmekabhaktāśī samāpte daśadhenudaḥ //
186.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
दशमीव्रतकं वक्ष्ये धर्मकामादिदायकं /
दशम्यामेकभक्ताशी समाप्ते दशधेनुदः //
186.m: Agni said: / I shall declare the votive observance of the tenth lunar day, which grants virtue, desire, and other ends. / Eating only a single meal on the tenth lunar day, one should give ten cows at the conclusion.

186.s:
diśaś ca kāñcanīrdadyādbrāhmaṇādhipatirbhavet /
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe daśamīvratāni nāma
ṣaḍaśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 mahākauśikaṃ maṇḍape iti gha.. , ña.. ca
2 piṣṭamayaṃ hunoditi kha.. , cha.. ca
:p 215
:ś atha saptāśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
ekādaśīvrataṃ
186.d:
दिशश् च काञ्चनीर्दद्याद्ब्राह्मणाधिपतिर्भवेत् /
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे दशमीव्रतानि नाम
षडशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 महाकौशिकं मण्डपे इति घ.. , ञ.. च
2 पिष्टमयं हुनोदिति ख.. , छ.. च
:प् 215
:श् अथ सप्ताशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
एकादशीव्रतं
186.m:
He should give golden [images of] the directions, and he will become a ruler of brāhmaṇas.
Thus in the great Purāṇa of Agni, the one hundred and eighty-sixth chapter, entitled 'Votive Observances of the Tenth Lunar Day'.
[Apparatus]
[Variant reading:] 1. 'mahākauśikaṃ maṇḍape' in manuscripts gha and ña.
[Variant reading:] 2. 'piṣṭamayaṃ hunot' in manuscripts kha and cha.
Now, the one hundred and eighty-seventh chapter.
The votive observance of the eleventh lunar day.

187.s:
agnir uvāca
ekādaśīvrataṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradāyākaṃ /
daśamyānniyatāhāro māṃsamaithunavarjitaḥ(1) //
187.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
एकादशीव्रतं वक्ष्ये भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायाकं /
दशम्यान्नियताहारो मांसमैथुनवर्जितः(1) //
187.m: Agni said: / I will proclaim the votive observance of the eleventh lunar day, which grants worldly enjoyment and liberation. / On the tenth lunar day, one should be restrained in diet, abstaining from meat and sexual intercourse.

187.s:
ekadaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta pakṣayorubhayorapi /
dvādaśyekādaśī yatra tatra sannihito hariḥ //
187.d:
एकदश्यां न भुञ्जीत पक्षयोरुभयोरपि /
द्वादश्येकादशी यत्र तत्र सन्निहितो हरिः //
187.m: One should not eat on the eleventh lunar day in either of the two fortnights. / Where the eleventh lunar day [coincides with] the twelfth lunar day, there Hari is present.

187.s:
tatra(2) kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇe /
ekādaśī kalā yatra parato dvādaśo gatā(3) //
187.d:
तत्र(2) क्रतुशतं पुण्यं त्रयोदश्यां तु पारणे /
एकादशी कला यत्र परतो द्वादशो गता(3) //
187.m: There is the religious merit of a hundred sacrifices there, while breaking the fast is done on the thirteenth lunar day. / Where a single minute division of the eleventh lunar day remains and the twelfth has passed beyond,

187.s:
tatra kratuśataṃ puṇyantrayodaśyāntu pāraṇe /
daśamyekādaśīmiśrā nopoṣyā narakapradā //
187.d:
तत्र क्रतुशतं पुण्यन्त्रयोदश्यान्तु पारणे /
दशम्येकादशीमिश्रा नोपोष्या नरकप्रदा //
187.m: there is the religious merit of a hundred sacrifices, while breaking the fast is done on the thirteenth lunar day. / An eleventh lunar day mixed with the tenth should not be observed as a fast, as it brings hell.

187.s:
ekādaśyānnirāhāro bhuktvā caivāpare 'hani /
bhokṣye 'haṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa śaraṇaṃ me bhavācyuta //
187.d:
एकादश्यान्निराहारो भुक्त्वा चैवापरे ऽहनि /
भोक्ष्ये ऽहं पुण्डरीकाक्ष शरणं मे भवाच्युत //
187.m: "Fasting on the eleventh lunar day and having eaten on the next day, / I shall eat, O lotus-eyed one; be my refuge, O Acyuta."

187.s:
ekādaśyāṃ site pakṣe puṣyarkṣantu yadā bhavet /
sopoṣpākṣayyaphaladā proktā sā pāpanāśinī //
187.d:
एकादश्यां सिते पक्षे पुष्यर्क्षन्तु यदा भवेत् /
सोपोष्पाक्षय्यफलदा प्रोक्ता सा पापनाशिनी //
187.m: When the asterism Puṣya occurs on the eleventh lunar day in the bright fortnight, / that [day], fasted upon, is declared to bestow imperishable fruit and destroy sin.

187.s:
ekādaśī dvādaśī yā śravaṇena ca saṃyutā /
vijayā sā tithiḥ proktā bhaktānāṃ vijayapradā //
187.d:
एकादशी द्वादशी या श्रवणेन च संयुता /
विजया सा तिथिः प्रोक्ता भक्तानां विजयप्रदा //
187.m: The eleventh or twelfth lunar day that is conjoined with Śravaṇa / is called the Vijayā lunar day; it grants victory to devotees.

187.s:
eṣaiva phālgune māsi puṣyarkṣeṇa ca saṃyutā /
:n
1 madhumāṃsair vivarjita iti ga..
2 atreti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
3 dvādaśī mateti gha.. , ña.. ca / dvādaśī bhavediti ṅa.. , jha.. ca
:p 216
vijayā procyate sadbhiḥ koṭikoṭiguṇottarā(1) //
187.d:
एषैव फाल्गुने मासि पुष्यर्क्षेण च संयुता /
:न्
1 मधुमांसैर् विवर्जित इति ग..
2 अत्रेति ख.. , छ.. , ज.. च
3 द्वादशी मतेति घ.. , ञ.. च / द्वादशी भवेदिति ङ.. , झ.. च
:प् 216
विजया प्रोच्यते सद्भिः कोटिकोटिगुणोत्तरा(1) //
187.m:
This very [lunar day], conjoined with the asterism Puṣya in the month of Phālguna,
[Footnote]
[Variant reading:] 1. 'madhumāṃsair vivarjitaḥ' in manuscript ga.
[Variant reading:] 2. 'atra' in manuscripts kha, cha, and ja.
[Variant reading:] 3. 'dvādaśī matā' in manuscripts gha and ña; 'dvādaśī bhavet' in manuscripts ṅa and jha.
is proclaimed by the virtuous to be Vijayā, yielding millions upon millions times greater [fruits].

187.s:
ekādaśyāṃ viṣṇupūjā(2) kāryā sarvopakāriṇī(3) /
dhanavān putravān loke viṣṇuloke mahīyate //
:e ity āgnyeye mahāpurāṇe ekādaśīvrataṃ nāma
saptāśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athāṣṭāśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
dvādaśīvratāni
187.d:
एकादश्यां विष्णुपूजा(2) कार्या सर्वोपकारिणी(3) /
धनवान् पुत्रवान् लोके विष्णुलोके महीयते //
:ए इत्य् आग्न्येये महापुराणे एकादशीव्रतं नाम
सप्ताशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथाष्टाशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
द्वादशीव्रतानि
187.m:
On the eleventh lunar day, worship of Viṣṇu should be performed, which aids everyone; / one becomes wealthy and possesses sons in this world, and is honoured in the world of Viṣṇu.
Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-seventh chapter, named 'The Votive Observance of the Eleventh Lunar Day', in the Great Purāṇa of Agni.
Now, the one hundred and eighty-eighth chapter.
The votive observances of the twelfth lunar day.

188.s:
agnir uvāca
dvādaśīvratakaṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ /
ekabhaktena bhaktena tathaivāyācitena ca //
188.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
द्वादशीव्रतकं वक्ष्ये भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकं /
एकभक्तेन भक्तेन तथैवायाचितेन च //
188.m: Agni said: / I will proclaim the votive observance of the twelfth lunar day, which grants worldly enjoyment and liberation, / by means of eating once a day, eating food, or similarly unasked food,

188.s:
upavāsena bhaikṣyeṇa caivaṃ dvādaśikavratī /
caitre māsi site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ madanaṃ hariṃ //
188.d:
उपवासेन भैक्ष्येण चैवं द्वादशिकव्रती /
चैत्रे मासि सिते पक्षे द्वादश्यां मदनं हरिं //
188.m: by fasting, or by begged food—thus one who observes the vow of the twelfth lunar day [observes it]. / In the month of Caitra, in the bright fortnight, on the twelfth lunar day, one worships Hari as Madana.

188.s:
pūjayedbhuktimuktyarthī(4) madanadvādaśaīvratī /
māghaśukle tu dvādaśyāṃ bhīmadvādaśikavratī //
188.d:
पूजयेद्भुक्तिमुक्त्यर्थी(4) मदनद्वादशईव्रती /
माघशुक्ले तु द्वादश्यां भीमद्वादशिकव्रती //
188.m: Seeking worldly enjoyment and liberation, one observes the vow of Madanadvādaśī. / On the twelfth lunar day of the bright fortnight of Māgha, observing the vow of Bhīmadvādaśī,

188.s:
namo nārāyaṇāyeti yajedviṣṇuṃ sa sarvabhāk /
phālgune ca site pakṣe govindadvādaśīvratī //
188.d:
नमो नारायणायेति यजेद्विष्णुं स सर्वभाक् /
फाल्गुने च सिते पक्षे गोविन्दद्वादशीव्रती //
188.m: one should worship Viṣṇu with the mantra, "Homage to Nārāyaṇa"; he obtains all. / In the month of Phālguna, in the bright fortnight, observing the vow of Govindadvādaśī,

188.s:
viśokadvādaśīkārī yajedāśvayuje hariṃ /
lavaṇaṃ mārgaśīrṣe tu kṛṣṇamabhyarcya yo naraḥ //
188.d:
विशोकद्वादशीकारी यजेदाश्वयुजे हरिं /
लवणं मार्गशीर्षे तु कृष्णमभ्यर्च्य यो नरः //
188.m: performing the Viśokadvādaśī, one should worship Hari in the month of Āśvina. / In the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, the person who, having worshipped Kṛṣṇa,

188.s:
dadāti śukladvādaśyāṃ sa sarvarasadāyakaḥ /
:n
1 kīṭikoṭiguṇottameti kha..
2 ekādaśyāmṛṣiṃ pūjyeti kha.. , cha.. ca / ekadaśyāmṛṣipūjeti
ṅa..
3 kāryā sarvāghahāriṇīti jha.. , ña.. ca
4 bhuktimuktyarthamiti cha.. , ña.. ca
:p 217
govatsaṃ pūjayed bhādre govatsadvādaśīvratī //
188.d:
ददाति शुक्लद्वादश्यां स सर्वरसदायकः /
:न्
1 कीटिकोटिगुणोत्तमेति ख..
2 एकादश्यामृषिं पूज्येति ख.. , छ.. च / एकदश्यामृषिपूजेति
ङ..
3 कार्या सर्वाघहारिणीति झ.. , ञ.. च
4 भुक्तिमुक्त्यर्थमिति छ.. , ञ.. च
:प् 217
गोवत्सं पूजयेद् भाद्रे गोवत्सद्वादशीव्रती //
188.m:
gives salt on the twelfth lunar day of the bright fortnight, becomes a bestower of all essences.
[Footnote]
[Variant reading:] 1. 'koṭikoṭiguṇottamā' in manuscript kha.
[Variant reading:] 2. 'ekādaśyām ṛṣiṃ pūjya' in manuscripts kha and cha; 'ekadaśyām ṛṣipūjā' in manuscript ṅa.
[Variant reading:] 3. 'kāryā sarvāghahāriṇī' in manuscripts jha and ña.
[Variant reading:] 4. 'bhuktimuktyartham' in manuscripts cha and ña.
One observing the vow of Govatsadvādaśī should worship a cow and calf in the month of Bhādrapada.

188.s:
mādhyāntu samatītāyāṃ śravaṇena tu saṃyutā /
dvādaśī yā bhavet kṛṣṇā proktā sā tiladvādaśī //
188.d:
माध्यान्तु समतीतायां श्रवणेन तु संयुता /
द्वादशी या भवेत् कृष्णा प्रोक्ता सा तिलद्वादशी //
188.m: When noon has passed, the twelfth lunar day of the dark fortnight / that is conjoined with the asterism Śravaṇa is called Tiladvādaśī.

188.s:
tilaiḥ snānantilair homo naivedyantilamodakaṃ /
dīpaś ca tilatailena tathā deyaṃ tilodakaṃ //
188.d:
तिलैः स्नानन्तिलैर् होमो नैवेद्यन्तिलमोदकं /
दीपश् च तिलतैलेन तथा देयं तिलोदकं //
188.m: Bathing with sesame seeds, fire oblation with sesame seeds, food offering of sesame-sweetmeats, / a lamp with sesame oil, and likewise water with sesame seeds is to be offered,

188.s:
tilāś ca deyā viprebhyaḥ phalaṃ homopavāsataḥ /
oṃ namo bhagavate 'tho vāsudevāya vai yajet //
188.d:
तिलाश् च देया विप्रेभ्यः फलं होमोपवासतः /
ओं नमो भगवते ऽथो वासुदेवाय वै यजेत् //
188.m: and sesame seeds are to be given to brāhmaṇas, yielding the fruit of fire oblation and fasting. / Then one should worship with: "Om, homage to the Blessed Vāsudeva."

188.s:
sukalaḥ svargamāpnoti ṣaṭtiladvādaśīvratī /
manorathadvādaśīkṛt phālgune tu site 'rcayet //
188.d:
सुकलः स्वर्गमाप्नोति षट्तिलद्वादशीव्रती /
मनोरथद्वादशीकृत् फाल्गुने तु सिते ऽर्चयेत् //
188.m: One who observes the vow of Ṣaṭtiladvādaśī attains heaven with their family. / One who performs the Manorathadvādaśī should worship in the bright fortnight of Phālguna.

188.s:
nāmadvādaśīvratakṛt keśavādyaiś ca nāmabhiḥ /
varṣaṃ yajeddhariṃ svargī na bhaven nārakī naraḥ //
188.d:
नामद्वादशीव्रतकृत् केशवाद्यैश् च नामभिः /
वर्षं यजेद्धरिं स्वर्गी न भवेन् नारकी नरः //
188.m: One who performs the vow of Nāmadvādaśī should worship Hari with the names beginning with Keśava / for a year; he goes to heaven and does not become an inhabitant of hell.

188.s:
phālgunasya site 'bhyarcya sumatidvādaśīvratī /
māsi bhādrapade śukte anantadvādaśīvratī(1) //
188.d:
फाल्गुनस्य सिते ऽभ्यर्च्य सुमतिद्वादशीव्रती /
मासि भाद्रपदे शुक्ते अनन्तद्वादशीव्रती(1) //
188.m: Having worshipped in the bright fortnight of Phālguna, one observes the vow of Sumatidvādaśī. / In the bright fortnight of the month of Bhādrapada, one observes the vow of Anantadvādaśī.

188.s:
aśleṣarkṣe tu mūle vā(2) māghe kṛṣṇāya vai namaḥ /
yajettilāṃś ca juhuyāttiladvādaśīkṛnnaraḥ //
188.d:
अश्लेषर्क्षे तु मूले वा(2) माघे कृष्णाय वै नमः /
यजेत्तिलांश् च जुहुयात्तिलद्वादशीकृन्नरः //
188.m: Under the asterism Āśleṣā or Mūla, in Māgha, with "Homage to Kṛṣṇa", / a man observing Tiladvādaśī should worship and make fire oblation with sesame seeds.

188.s:
sugatidvādaśīkārī phālgune tu site yajet /
jaya kṛṣṇa namastubhyaṃ varṣaṃ syād bhuktimuktigaḥ(3) //
188.d:
सुगतिद्वादशीकारी फाल्गुने तु सिते यजेत् /
जय कृष्ण नमस्तुभ्यं वर्षं स्याद् भुक्तिमुक्तिगः(3) //
188.m: One performing Sugatidvādaśī should worship in the bright fortnight of Phālguna, / with "Victory, O Kṛṣṇa! Homage to you!" for a year; he attains worldly enjoyment and liberation.

188.s:
pauṣaśukle tu dvādaśyāṃ samprāptidvādaśīvratī /
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe nānādvādaśīvratāni
nāmāṣṭāśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 manorathadvādaśītyādiḥ, anantadvādaśīvratītyantaḥ
pāṭhaḥ gha.. pustake nāsti
2 āṣāḍharkṣe tu mūle vā iti kha.. , ga.. , ja.. , ṭa.. ca
3 varṣe syād bhuktimuktida iti ga.. , gha.. ca
:p 218
:ś athaikonanavatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
śravaṇadvādaśīvratam
188.d:
पौषशुक्ले तु द्वादश्यां सम्प्राप्तिद्वादशीव्रती /
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे नानाद्वादशीव्रतानि
नामाष्टाशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 मनोरथद्वादशीत्यादिः, अनन्तद्वादशीव्रतीत्यन्तः
पाठः घ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
2 आषाढर्क्षे तु मूले वा इति ख.. , ग.. , ज.. , ट.. च
3 वर्षे स्याद् भुक्तिमुक्तिद इति ग.. , घ.. च
:प् 218
:श् अथैकोननवत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
श्रवणद्वादशीव्रतम्
188.m:
On the twelfth lunar day of the bright fortnight of Pauṣa, one observes the vow of Samprāptidvādaśī.
Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-eighth chapter, named 'The Various Votive Observances of the Twelfth Lunar Day', in the Great Purāṇa of Agni.
[Footnote]
[Variant reading:] 1. The passage beginning with 'manorathadvādaśī' up to 'anantadvādaśīvratī' is missing in manuscript gha.
[Variant reading:] 2. 'āṣāḍharkṣe tu mūle vā' in manuscripts kha, ga, ja, and ṭa.
[Variant reading:] 3. 'varṣe syād bhuktimuktidaḥ' in manuscripts ga and gha.
Now, the one hundred and eighty-ninth chapter.
The votive observance of Śravaṇadvādaśī.

189.s:
agnir uvāca
śravaṇādaśīṃ vakṣye māsi bhādrapade site /
śravaṇena yutā śreṣṭhā(1) mahatī sā hy upoṣitā //
189.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
श्रवणादशीं वक्ष्ये मासि भाद्रपदे सिते /
श्रवणेन युता श्रेष्ठा(1) महती सा ह्य् उपोषिता //
189.m: Agni said: / I will proclaim Śravaṇadvādaśī: in the bright fortnight of the month of Bhādrapada, / conjoined with the asterism Śravaṇa, it is supreme; when fasted upon, it is indeed great.

189.s:
saṅgame saritāṃ snānācchravaṇadvādaśophalaṃ(2) /
budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā dānādau sumahāphalā //
189.d:
सङ्गमे सरितां स्नानाच्छ्रवणद्वादशोफलं(2) /
बुधश्रवणसंयुक्ता दानादौ सुमहाफला //
189.m: From bathing at the confluence of rivers comes the fruit of Śravaṇadvādaśī. / Conjoined with Wednesday and Śravaṇa, it yields exceedingly great fruit in giving gifts and the like.

189.s:
niṣiddhamapi kartavyantrayodaśyāntu pāraṇaṃ /
dvādṛśyāñca nirāhāro vāmanaṃ pūjayāmyahaṃ //
189.d:
निषिद्धमपि कर्तव्यन्त्रयोदश्यान्तु पारणं /
द्वादृश्याञ्च निराहारो वामनं पूजयाम्यहं //
189.m: Even if forbidden, the breaking of the fast must be done on the thirteenth lunar day. / [The vow:] "Fasting on the twelfth lunar day, I shall worship Vāmana

189.s:
udakumbhe svarṇamayantrayodaśyāntu pāraṇaṃ /
āvāhayāmyahaṃ viṣṇuṃ vāmanaṃ śaṅkhacakriṇaṃ //
189.d:
उदकुम्भे स्वर्णमयन्त्रयोदश्यान्तु पारणं /
आवाहयाम्यहं विष्णुं वामनं शङ्खचक्रिणं //
189.m: in a golden [image] placed on a water-jar, and break my fast on the thirteenth lunar day. / I invoke Viṣṇu as Vāmana, the bearer of the conch and discus,

189.s:
sitavastrayugacchanne ghaṭe sacchatrapāduke /
snāpayāmi jalaiḥ śuddhair viṣṇuṃ(3) pañcāmṛtādibhiḥ //
189.d:
सितवस्त्रयुगच्छन्ने घटे सच्छत्रपादुके /
स्नापयामि जलैः शुद्धैर् विष्णुं(3) पञ्चामृतादिभिः //
189.m: upon a jar covered with a pair of white garments, furnished with an umbrella and sandals. / I bathe Viṣṇu with pure waters and with the five nectars and other substances.

189.s:
chatradaṇḍadharaṃ viṣṇuṃ vāmanāya namo namaḥ /
arghyaṃ dadāmi deveśa arghyārhādyaiḥ sadārcitaḥ(4) //
189.d:
छत्रदण्डधरं विष्णुं वामनाय नमो नमः /
अर्घ्यं ददामि देवेश अर्घ्यार्हाद्यैः सदार्चितः(4) //
189.m: To Viṣṇu who holds an umbrella and a staff, to Vāmana, homage, homage! / I offer the water offering, O Lord of gods, who are ever worshipped by those worthy of water offerings and the rest.

189.s:
bhuktimuktiprajākīrtisarvaiśvaryayutaṃ kuru /
vāmanāya namo gandhaṃ homo 'nenāṣṭakaṃ śataṃ //
:n
1 śravaṇena samāyukteti gha..
2 dvādaśadvādaśīphalamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ña.. ca
3 śuddhair harimiti ga.. , ṭa.. ca
4 mudārcita iti ga..
:p 219
189.d:
भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रजाकीर्तिसर्वैश्वर्ययुतं कुरु /
वामनाय नमो गन्धं होमो ऽनेनाष्टकं शतं //
:न्
1 श्रवणेन समायुक्तेति घ..
2 द्वादशद्वादशीफलमिति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. , ञ.. च
3 शुद्धैर् हरिमिति ग.. , ट.. च
4 मुदार्चित इति ग..
:प् 219
189.m:
Make me endowed with worldly enjoyment, liberation, offspring, fame, and all sovereign power! / Homage to Vāmana!" Perfume [is offered, and] fire oblation is made one hundred and eight times with this [mantra].
[Footnote]
1 In manuscript gha: "śravaṇena samāyuktā".
2 In manuscripts kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cha, and ña: "dvādaśadvādaśīphalam".
3 In manuscripts ga and ṭa: "śuddhair harim".
4 In manuscript ga: "mudārcitaḥ".

189.s:
oṃ namo vāsudevāya śiraḥ sampūjayeddhareḥ /
śrīdharāya mukhaṃ tadvat kaṇṭhe kṛṣṇāya vai namaḥ //
189.d:
ओं नमो वासुदेवाय शिरः सम्पूजयेद्धरेः /
श्रीधराय मुखं तद्वत् कण्ठे कृष्णाय वै नमः //
189.m: With "oṃ namo vāsudevāya", one should worship the head of Hari; / likewise the face with "to Śrīdhara"; [and] at the neck with "homage to Kṛṣṇa".

189.s:
namaḥ śrīpataye vakṣo bhujo sarvāstradhāriṇe /
vyāpakāya namo nābhiṃ vāmanāya namaḥ kaṭiṃ //
189.d:
नमः श्रीपतये वक्षो भुजो सर्वास्त्रधारिणे /
व्यापकाय नमो नाभिं वामनाय नमः कटिं //
189.m: "Homage to Śrīpati" on the chest; the two arms with "to the wielder of all weapons"; / "homage to the all-pervading one" on the navel; "homage to Vāmana" on the hips;

189.s:
trailokyajayakāyeti(1) meḍhraṃ jaṅghe yajeddhareḥ /
sarvādhipataye pādau viṣṇoḥ sarvātmane namaḥ //
189.d:
त्रैलोक्यजयकायेति(1) मेढ्रं जङ्घे यजेद्धरेः /
सर्वाधिपतये पादौ विष्णोः सर्वात्मने नमः //
189.m: with "to the conqueror of the three worlds", one should worship the penis [and] the shanks of Hari; / with "to the sovereign lord of all", the two feet; homage to Viṣṇu, the universal Self.

189.s:
ghṛtapakvañca naivedyandadyād dadhyodanair ghaṭān /
rātrau ca jāgaraṃ kṛtvā prātaḥ snātvā ca saṅgame //
189.d:
घृतपक्वञ्च नैवेद्यन्दद्याद् दध्योदनैर् घटान् /
रात्रौ च जागरं कृत्वा प्रातः स्नात्वा च सङ्गमे //
189.m: And one should offer food cooked in clarified butter, and vessels with curd-rice; / and having kept a night-vigil, and having bathed at dawn at a confluence,

189.s:
gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya vadet puṣpāñjalistvidaṃ /
namo namaste govinda budhaśravaṇasañjñita //
189.d:
गन्धपुष्पादिभिः पूज्य वदेत् पुष्पाञ्जलिस्त्विदं /
नमो नमस्ते गोविन्द बुधश्रवणसञ्ज्ञित //
189.m: having worshipped with perfumes, flowers, and the rest, holding an offering of flowers in folded hands, he should say this: / "Homage, homage to you, Govinda, named Budha-Śravaṇa!

189.s:
aghaughasaṅkṣayaṃ kṛtvā sarvasaukhyaprado bhava /
prīyatāndeva deveśa mama nityañjanārdana //
189.d:
अघौघसङ्क्षयं कृत्वा सर्वसौख्यप्रदो भव /
प्रीयतान्देव देवेश मम नित्यञ्जनार्दन //
189.m: Having destroyed the heap of sins, be the bestower of all happiness! / May you be pleased, O God, Lord of Gods, Janārdana, always toward me!

189.s:
vāmano buddhido dātā dravyastho vāmanaḥ svayaṃ /
vāmanaḥ pratigṛhṇāti vāmano me dadāti ca //
189.d:
वामनो बुद्धिदो दाता द्रव्यस्थो वामनः स्वयं /
वामनः प्रतिगृह्णाति वामनो मे ददाति च //
189.m: Vāmana gives intellect; the giver is himself Vāmana residing within the wealth; / Vāmana accepts [it], and Vāmana gives to me.

189.s:
dravyastho vāmano nityaṃ vāmanāya namo namaḥ /
pradattadakṣiṇo viprān sambhojyānnaṃ svayañcaret //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe śravaṇadvādaśīvrataṃ
nāmaikonanavatyadhikaśatatmo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 trailokyajananāyeti jha.. , ña.. ca / trailokyajanakāyeti ṅa.. , ṭa.. ca
:p 220
:ś atha navatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
akhaṇḍadvādaśīvrataṃ
189.d:
द्रव्यस्थो वामनो नित्यं वामनाय नमो नमः /
प्रदत्तदक्षिणो विप्रान् सम्भोज्यान्नं स्वयञ्चरेत् //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे श्रवणद्वादशीव्रतं
नामैकोननवत्यधिकशतत्मो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 त्रैलोक्यजननायेति झ.. , ञ.. च / त्रैलोक्यजनकायेति ङ.. , ट.. च
:प् 220
:श् अथ नवत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
अखण्डद्वादशीव्रतं
189.m:
Vāmana resides constantly within the wealth; homage, homage to Vāmana!" / Having presented the sacrificial fee, having fed the brāhmaṇas, he may himself partake of the food.
Thus, in the Great Purāṇa of Agni, the chapter entitled "The Votive Observance of Śravaṇa-dvādaśī", being the one hundred eighty-ninth chapter.
[Footnote]
1 In manuscripts jha and ña: "trailokyajananāya"; in manuscripts ṅa and ṭa: "trailokyajanakāya".
Now, the one hundred ninetieth chapter.
The Votive Observance of Akhaṇḍa-dvādaśī.

190.s:
agnir uvāca
akhaṇḍadvādaśīṃ vakṣye vratasampūrṇatākṛtaṃ /
mārgaśīrṣe site viṣṇuṃ dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ //
190.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
अखण्डद्वादशीं वक्ष्ये व्रतसम्पूर्णताकृतं /
मार्गशीर्षे सिते विष्णुं द्वादश्यां समुपोषितः //
190.m: Agni said: / I will proclaim Akhaṇḍa-dvādaśī, which effects the completion of votive observances. / In Mārgaśīrṣa, during the bright [fortnight], fasting completely on the twelfth lunar day,

190.s:
pañcagavyajale snāto yajettatprāśano vratī /
yavavrīhiyutampātrandvādaśyāṃ hi dvije 'rpayet //
190.d:
पञ्चगव्यजले स्नातो यजेत्तत्प्राशनो व्रती /
यवव्रीहियुतम्पात्रन्द्वादश्यां हि द्विजे ऽर्पयेत् //
190.m: having bathed in water mixed with the five products of the cow, having consumed them, the observer of the vow should worship Viṣṇu. / On the twelfth lunar day, he should indeed offer a vessel filled with barley and rice to a brāhmaṇa [with the prayer]:

190.s:
saptajanmani yat kiñcinmayā khaṇḍaṃ vrataṃ kṛtaṃ /
bhagavaṃstvatprasādena tadakhaṇḍamihāstu me //
190.d:
सप्तजन्मनि यत् किञ्चिन्मया खण्डं व्रतं कृतं /
भगवंस्त्वत्प्रसादेन तदखण्डमिहास्तु मे //
190.m: "Whatever vow has been broken by me in seven lifetimes, / O Lord, by your grace, may that become unbroken for me in this life.

190.s:
yathākhaṇḍaṃ jagat sarvaṃ tvameva puruṣottama /
tathākhilānyakhaṇḍāni vratāni mama santu vai //
190.d:
यथाखण्डं जगत् सर्वं त्वमेव पुरुषोत्तम /
तथाखिलान्यखण्डानि व्रतानि मम सन्तु वै //
190.m: Just as the entire universe is unbroken, [and] you alone are it, O Puruṣottama, / even so may all my votive observances be unbroken!"

190.s:
evamevānumāsañca cāturmāsyo vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ /
anyaccaitrādimāseṣu śaktupātrāṇi(1) cārpayet //
190.d:
एवमेवानुमासञ्च चातुर्मास्यो विधिः स्मृतः /
अन्यच्चैत्रादिमासेषु शक्तुपात्राणि(1) चार्पयेत् //
190.m: In this very manner, month by month, the four-month rite is remembered. / Further, in the months beginning with Caitra, he should also offer vessels of roasted grain flour;

190.s:
śrāvaṇādiṣu cārabhya kārttikānteṣu pāraṇaṃ /
saptajanmasu vaikalyaṃ vratānāṃ saphalaṃ kṛte //
190.d:
श्रावणादिषु चारभ्य कार्त्तिकान्तेषु पारणं /
सप्तजन्मसु वैकल्यं व्रतानां सफलं कृते //
190.m: and the concluding fast-breaking begins in the months starting with Śrāvaṇa and ending with Kārttika. / When it is performed, deficiency of vows across seven lifetimes becomes fruitful;

190.s:
āyurārogyasaubhāgyarājyabhogādimāpnuyāt(2) /
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe akhaṇḍadvādaśīvrataṃ nāma
navatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 svarṇapātrāṇi iti kha.. , gha.. , ña.. ca
2 agnir uvāca / akhaṇḍadvādaśīṃ vakṣye ity ādiḥ,
rājyabhogādimāpnuyādityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti
:p 221
:ś athaikanavatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
trayodaśīvratāni
190.d:
आयुरारोग्यसौभाग्यराज्यभोगादिमाप्नुयात्(2) /
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे अखण्डद्वादशीव्रतं नाम
नवत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 स्वर्णपात्राणि इति ख.. , घ.. , ञ.. च
2 अग्निर् उवाच / अखण्डद्वादशीं वक्ष्ये इत्य् आदिः,
राज्यभोगादिमाप्नुयादित्यन्तः पाठः झ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
:प् 221
:श् अथैकनवत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
त्रयोदशीव्रतानि
190.m:
he will obtain longevity, health, good fortune, the enjoyments of kingship, and the like.
Thus, in the Great Purāṇa of Agni, the chapter entitled "The Votive Observance of Akhaṇḍa-dvādaśī", being the one hundred ninetieth chapter.
[Footnote]
1 In manuscripts kha, gha, and ña: "svarṇapātrāṇi".
2 The passage beginning with "agnir uvāca / akhaṇḍadvādaśīṃ vakṣye" and ending with "rājyabhogādimāpnuyāt" is missing in manuscript jha.
Now, the one hundred ninety-first chapter.
The Votive Observances of the Thirteenth Lunar Day.

191.s:
agnir uvāca
trayodaśīvratānīha sarvadāni vadāmi te /
anaṅgena kṛtāmādau vakṣye 'naṅgatrayodaśīṃ //
191.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
त्रयोदशीव्रतानीह सर्वदानि वदामि ते /
अनङ्गेन कृतामादौ वक्ष्ये ऽनङ्गत्रयोदशीं //
191.m: Agni said: / I will proclaim to you the votive observances of the thirteenth lunar day, which bestow everything. / First I will proclaim Anaṅga-trayodaśī, instituted by Anaṅga.

191.s:
trayodaśyāṃ mārgaśīrṣe śukle 'naṅgaṃ haraṃ yajet(1) /
madha samprāśayedrātrau ghṛtahomastilākṣataiḥ //
191.d:
त्रयोदश्यां मार्गशीर्षे शुक्ले ऽनङ्गं हरं यजेत्(1) /
मध सम्प्राशयेद्रात्रौ घृतहोमस्तिलाक्षतैः //
191.m: On the thirteenth lunar day of the bright fortnight in Mārgaśīrṣa, one should worship Hara as Anaṅga. / At night, he should consume honey; there is a fire oblation of clarified butter with sesame and unbroken rice grains.

191.s:
pauṣe yogeśvaraṃ prārcya candanāśī kṛtāhutiḥ /
maheśvaraṃ mauktikāśī māghe 'bhyarcya divaṃ vrajet //
191.d:
पौषे योगेश्वरं प्रार्च्य चन्दनाशी कृताहुतिः /
महेश्वरं मौक्तिकाशी माघे ऽभ्यर्च्य दिवं व्रजेत् //
191.m: In Pauṣa, having worshipped Yogeśvara, eating sandalwood, having offered oblations; / in Māgha, eating pearl, having worshipped Maheśvara, he goes to heaven.

191.s:
kākolaṃ prāśya nīraṃ tu(2) phālgune pūjayedvratī /
karpūrāśī svarūpaṃ ca caitre saubhāgyavān bhavet //
191.d:
काकोलं प्राश्य नीरं तु(2) फाल्गुने पूजयेद्व्रती /
कर्पूराशी स्वरूपं च चैत्रे सौभाग्यवान् भवेत् //
191.m: In Phālguna, consuming the fruit of *kākola* and water, the observer of the vow should worship. / In Caitra, eating camphor, [worshipping] Svarūpa, he will become endowed with good fortune.

191.s:
mahārūpantu vaiśākhe yajejjātīphalāśyapi /
lavaṅgāśī jyaiṣṭhadine(3) pradyumnaṃ pūjayed vratī //
191.d:
महारूपन्तु वैशाखे यजेज्जातीफलाश्यपि /
लवङ्गाशी ज्यैष्ठदिने(3) प्रद्युम्नं पूजयेद् व्रती //
191.m: In Vaiśākha, eating nutmeg, he should worship Mahārūpa. / On the day of Jyaiṣṭha, eating clove, the observer of the vow should worship Pradyumna.

191.s:
tilodāśī tathāṣāḍhe umābhartāramarcayet /
śrāvaṇe gandhatoyāśī pūjayecchūlapāṇinaṃ //
191.d:
तिलोदाशी तथाषाढे उमाभर्तारमर्चयेत् /
श्रावणे गन्धतोयाशी पूजयेच्छूलपाणिनं //
191.m: Likewise, in Āṣāḍha, consuming sesame water, he should worship the husband of Umā. / In Śrāvaṇa, consuming fragrant water, he should worship the Trident-bearer.

191.s:
sadyojātaṃ bhādrapade prāśitā gurumarcayet /
suvarṇavāri saṃprāśya āśvine tridaśādhipam //
:n
1 hariṃ yajediti cha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
2 kākolaṃ prāśya cīnañceti gha.. , ja.. , jha.. , ña.. ca
3 jyaiṣṭhamāse īt ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , jha.. , ña.. ca
:p 222
191.d:
सद्योजातं भाद्रपदे प्राशिता गुरुमर्चयेत् /
सुवर्णवारि संप्राश्य आश्विने त्रिदशाधिपम् //
:न्
1 हरिं यजेदिति छ.. , ज.. , ञ.. च
2 काकोलं प्राश्य चीनञ्चेति घ.. , ज.. , झ.. , ञ.. च
3 ज्यैष्ठमासे ईत् ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , ज.. , झ.. , ञ.. च
:प् 222
191.m:
In Bhādrapada, eating [the food of the deity] Sadyojāta, he should worship the Guru. / In Āśvina, consuming water touched with gold, [he should worship] the Lord of the Gods.
[Footnote]
1 In manuscripts cha, ja, and ña: "hariṃ yajet".
2 In manuscripts gha, ja, jha, and ña: "kākolaṃ prāśya cīnañca".
3 In manuscripts ga, gha, ṅa, ja, jha, and ña: "jyaiṣṭhamāse".

191.s:
viśveśvaraṃ kārttike tu madanāśī yajedvratī /
śivaṃ haimantu varṣānte sañcchādyāmradalena tu //
191.d:
विश्वेश्वरं कार्त्तिके तु मदनाशी यजेद्व्रती /
शिवं हैमन्तु वर्षान्ते सञ्च्छाद्याम्रदलेन तु //
191.m: In Kārttika, consuming the fruit of the *dhattūra*, the observer of the vow should worship Viśveśvara. / At the end of the year, having covered golden Śiva with mango leaves

191.s:
vastreṇa pūjayitvā tu dadyādviprāya gāntathā /
śayanañchatrakalaśān pādukārasabhājanam //
191.d:
वस्त्रेण पूजयित्वा तु दद्याद्विप्राय गान्तथा /
शयनञ्छत्रकलशान् पादुकारसभाजनम् //
191.m: and having worshipped [him] with cloth, he should give to a brāhmaṇa a cow, / a bed, an umbrella, water pots, sandals, and a vessel of syrup.

191.s:
trayodaśyāṃ site caitre ratiprītiyutaṃ smaran /
aśokākhyaṃ nagaṃ likhya sindūrarajanīmukhaiḥ //
191.d:
त्रयोदश्यां सिते चैत्रे रतिप्रीतियुतं स्मरन् /
अशोकाख्यं नगं लिख्य सिन्दूररजनीमुखैः //
191.m: On the bright thirteenth lunar day of Caitra, remembering [the god of love] accompanied by Rati and Prīti, / having drawn the tree named Aśoka with red lead, turmeric, and the like,

191.s:
avdhaṃ yajettu kāmārthī kāmatrayodaśīvratam /
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe trayodaśī vratāni
nāmaikanavatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha dvinavatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
caturdaśīvratāni
191.d:
अव्धं यजेत्तु कामार्थी कामत्रयोदशीव्रतम् /
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे त्रयोदशी व्रतानि
नामैकनवत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ द्विनवत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
चतुर्दशीव्रतानि
191.m:
one who desires fulfillment of desires should worship for a year the vow of Kāma-trayodaśī.
Thus, in the Great Purāṇa of Agni, the chapter entitled "The Votive Observances of the Thirteenth Lunar Day", being the one hundred ninety-first chapter.
Now, the one hundred ninety-second chapter.
The Votive Observances of the Fourteenth Lunar Day.

192.s:
agnir uvāca
vrataṃ vakṣye caturdaśyāṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ(1) /
kārttike tu caturdaśyāṃ nirāhāro yajecchivam //
192.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
व्रतं वक्ष्ये चतुर्दश्यां भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकं(1) /
कार्त्तिके तु चतुर्दश्यां निराहारो यजेच्छिवम् //
192.m: Agni said: / I will proclaim the votive observance on the fourteenth lunar day, which grants worldly enjoyment and liberation. / On the fourteenth lunar day in Kārttika, fasting, one should worship Śiva.

192.s:
varṣabhogadhanāyuṣmān(2) kurvan śivacaturdaśīm /
mārgaśīrṣe site 'ṣṭābhyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ munivrataḥ //
:n
1 bhuktimuktipradaṃ śṛṇu iti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca /
bhuktimuktisukhapradamiti ṅa..
2 bhogabalāyuṣmāniti ṅa..
:p 223
192.d:
वर्षभोगधनायुष्मान्(2) कुर्वन् शिवचतुर्दशीम् /
मार्गशीर्षे सिते ऽष्टाभ्यां तृतीयायां मुनिव्रतः //
:न्
1 भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं शृणु इति ख.. , घ.. , ज.. , झ.. , ञ.. , ट.. च /
भुक्तिमुक्तिसुखप्रदमिति ङ..
2 भोगबलायुष्मानिति ङ..
:प् 223
192.m:
Performing the Śiva-caturdaśī, he becomes endowed with wealth, longevity, and enjoyment for a year. / In Mārgaśīrṣa, during the bright [fortnight], on the eighth [or] the third lunar day, keeping the vow of a sage,
[Footnote]
1 In manuscripts kha, gha, ja, jha, ña, and ṭa: "bhuktimuktipradaṃ śṛṇu".
In manuscript ṅa: "bhuktimuktisukhapradam".
2 In manuscript ṅa: "bhogabalāyuṣmān".

192.s:
