adyaprabhṛtyahaṃ viṣṇo yāvadutthānakantava /
arcayetvāmanaśnan hi yāvat triṃśaddināni tu //
204.d:
अद्यप्रभृत्यहं विष्णो यावदुत्थानकन्तव /
अर्चयेत्वामनश्नन् हि यावत् त्रिंशद्दिनानि तु //
204.m: [resolving:] 'From today onwards, O Viṣṇu, until your awakening, / I shall worship you while fasting, for thirty days.

204.s:
kārttikāśvinayorviṣṇoryāvadutthānakantava /
mriye yadyantarāle 'haṃ vratabhaṅgo na me bhavet //
204.d:
कार्त्तिकाश्विनयोर्विष्णोर्यावदुत्थानकन्तव /
म्रिये यद्यन्तराले ऽहं व्रतभङ्गो न मे भवेत् //
204.m: During the months of Āśvina and Kārttika, until your awakening, O Viṣṇu, / if I die in the interim, let there be no breach of my votive observance.'

204.s:
trikālaṃ pūjayedviṣṇuṃ triḥsnāto gandhapuṣpakaiḥ /
viṣṇorgītādikaṃ japyandhyānaṃ kuryād vratī naraḥ //
204.d:
त्रिकालं पूजयेद्विष्णुं त्रिःस्नातो गन्धपुष्पकैः /
विष्णोर्गीतादिकं जप्यन्ध्यानं कुर्याद् व्रती नरः //
204.m: Having bathed three times a day, the observer of the vow should worship Viṣṇu at the three junctures of the day with perfumes and flowers, / reciting the hymns of Viṣṇu and the like, and meditating [upon him].

204.s:
vṛthāvādampariharedarthākāṅkṣāṃ vivarjayet(2) /
nāvratasthaṃ spṛśet kañcidvikarmasthānna cālayet //
:n
1 vrataṃ māsopavāsākhyamiti gha.. , ja.. ca
2 annākāṅkṣāṃ vivarjayediti gha.. , ṅa.. ca
:p 246
204.d:
वृथावादम्परिहरेदर्थाकाङ्क्षां विवर्जयेत्(2) /
नाव्रतस्थं स्पृशेत् कञ्चिद्विकर्मस्थान्न चालयेत् //
:न्
1 व्रतं मासोपवासाख्यमिति घ.. , ज.. च
2 अन्नाकाङ्क्षां विवर्जयेदिति घ.. , ङ.. च
:प् 246
204.m:
He should avoid idle talk; he should abandon desire for wealth; / he should not touch anyone not engaged in a votive observance, nor disturb those occupied with inappropriate actions.
[Note]
1 [Variant reading:] 'vrataṃ māsopavāsākhyam' in manuscripts gha and ja.
2 [Variant reading:] 'annākāṅkṣāṃ vivarjayet' in manuscripts gha and ṅa.

204.s:
devatāyatane tiṣṭhedyāvat triṃśaddināni tu /
dvādaśyāṃ pūjayitvā tu bhojayitvā dvijānvratī //
204.d:
देवतायतने तिष्ठेद्यावत् त्रिंशद्दिनानि तु /
द्वादश्यां पूजयित्वा तु भोजयित्वा द्विजान्व्रती //
204.m: He should dwell in a temple of the deity for thirty days. / On the twelfth lunar day, having worshipped [Viṣṇu] and fed the twice-born,

204.s:
samāpya dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā pāraṇantu samācaret /
bhuktimuktimavāpnoti kalpāṃś caiva trayodaśa //
204.d:
समाप्य दक्षिणां दत्त्वा पारणन्तु समाचरेत् /
भुक्तिमुक्तिमवाप्नोति कल्पांश् चैव त्रयोदश //
204.m: completing [the vow] and giving a sacrificial fee, the observer of the vow should break the fast. / He attains worldly enjoyment and liberation, and [dwells in heaven] for thirteen cosmic cycles.

204.s:
kārayedvaiṣṇavaṃ yajñaṃ yajedviprāṃstrayodaśa /
tāvanti vastrayugmāni bhājanānyāsanāni ca //
204.d:
कारयेद्वैष्णवं यज्ञं यजेद्विप्रांस्त्रयोदश /
तावन्ति वस्त्रयुग्मानि भाजनान्यासनानि च //
204.m: He should perform a Vaiṣṇava sacrifice and honor thirteen brāhmaṇas; / as many pairs of garments, vessels, and seats,

204.s:
chatrāṇi sapavitrāṇi tathopānadyugāni ca(1) /
yogapaṭṭopavītāni dadyādviprāya tairmataḥ(2) //
204.d:
छत्राणि सपवित्राणि तथोपानद्युगानि च(1) /
योगपट्टोपवीतानि दद्याद्विप्राय तैर्मतः(2) //
204.m: umbrellas together with sacred threads, and likewise pairs of sandals, / meditation bands, and sacred threads he should give to a brāhmaṇa, being approved by them.

204.s:
anyaviprāya śayyāyāṃ haimaṃ viṣṇuṃ prapūjya ca /
ātmanaś ca tathāmūrtiṃ vastrādyaiś ca prapūjayet //
204.d:
अन्यविप्राय शय्यायां हैमं विष्णुं प्रपूज्य च /
आत्मनश् च तथामूर्तिं वस्त्राद्यैश् च प्रपूजयेत् //
204.m: Having worshipped a golden Viṣṇu upon a bed for another brāhmaṇa, / he should likewise worship an icon of himself with garments and the like.

204.s:
sarvapāpavinirmukto vipro viṣṇuprasādataḥ /
viṣṇulokaṃ gamiṣyāmi viṣṇureva bhavāmyahaṃ //
204.d:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विप्रो विष्णुप्रसादतः /
विष्णुलोकं गमिष्यामि विष्णुरेव भवाम्यहं //
204.m: [Saying:] ‘Liberated from all sin, the brāhmaṇa, by the grace of Viṣṇu, / [thinks,] “I shall go to the world of Viṣṇu; I myself become Viṣṇu.”

204.s:
vraja vraja devabuddhe viṣṇoḥ sthānamanāmayaṃ /
vimānenāmalastatra tiṣṭhed viṣṇusvarūpadhṛk //
204.d:
व्रज व्रज देवबुद्धे विष्णोः स्थानमनामयं /
विमानेनामलस्तत्र तिष्ठेद् विष्णुस्वरूपधृक् //
204.m: Go, go, O you who have the intellect of a deity, to the sorrowless abode of Viṣṇu!’ / By a celestial chariot he would remain there stainless, bearing the very form of Viṣṇu.

204.s:
dvijānuktvātha(3) tāṃ śayyāṃ gurave 'tha nivedayet /
kulānāṃ śatamuddhṛtya viṣṇulokannayed vratī //
204.d:
द्विजानुक्त्वाथ(3) तां शय्यां गुरवे ऽथ निवेदयेत् /
कुलानां शतमुद्धृत्य विष्णुलोकन्नयेद् व्रती //
204.m: Having addressed the twice-born, he should then offer that bed to his preceptor. / Having delivered a hundred families, the observer of the votive observance leads them to the world of Viṣṇu.

204.s:
māsopavāsī yaddeśe sa deśo nirmalo bhavet /
kiṃ punastatkulaṃ sarvaṃ yatra māsopavāsakṛt //
204.d:
मासोपवासी यद्देशे स देशो निर्मलो भवेत् /
किं पुनस्तत्कुलं सर्वं यत्र मासोपवासकृत् //
204.m: In whichever region one who fasts for a month dwells, that region becomes stainless; / how much more the entire family wherein lives a performer of the month-long fast!

204.s:
vratasthaṃ mūrchitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣīrājyañcaiva pāyayet /
naite vrataṃ vinighranti havirviprānumoditaṃ //
:n
1 tataḥ pānayutāni ceti kha..
2 vai nata iti gha..
3 dvijān natvātheti ṅa..
:p 247
204.d:
व्रतस्थं मूर्छितं दृष्ट्वा क्षीराज्यञ्चैव पाययेत् /
नैते व्रतं विनिघ्रन्ति हविर्विप्रानुमोदितं //
:न्
1 ततः पानयुतानि चेति ख..
2 वै नत इति घ..
3 द्विजान् नत्वाथेति ङ..
:प् 247
204.m:
Seeing one observing a votive observance fainted, one should give him milk and clarified butter to drink. / These do not break the votive observance, being sacrificial food approved by the brāhmaṇas.
[Note]
1 tataḥ pānayutāni ceti kha..
2 vai nata iti gha..
3 dvijān natvātheti ṅa..
:p 247

204.s:
kṣīraṃ gurorhitauṣadhva āpo mūlaphalāni ca /
viṣṇurmahauṣadhaṃ kartā vratamasmāt samuddharet //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe māsopavāsavrataṃ nāma
caturadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha pañcādhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
bhīṣmapañcakavrataṃ
204.d:
क्षीरं गुरोर्हितौषध्व आपो मूलफलानि च /
विष्णुर्महौषधं कर्ता व्रतमस्मात् समुद्धरेत् //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे मासोपवासव्रतं नाम
चतुरधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ पञ्चाधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः
भीष्मपञ्चकव्रतं
204.m:
Milk, medicines beneficial according to the preceptor, water, roots, and fruits— / Viṣṇu is the great medicine, the agent; one should rescue the votive observance from this [danger].
Thus in the great Purāṇa of Agni, the two hundred and fourth chapter, entitled ‘The Votive Observance of Fasting for a Month.’
Now, the two hundred and fifth chapter:
The Votive Observance of the Bhīṣmapañcaka.

205.s:
agnir uvāca
bhīṣmapañcakamākhyāsye vratarājantu sarvadaṃ /
kārttikasyāmale pakṣe ekādaśyāṃ samacaret //
205.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
भीष्मपञ्चकमाख्यास्ये व्रतराजन्तु सर्वदं /
कार्त्तिकस्यामले पक्षे एकादश्यां समचरेत् //
205.m: Agni said: / I shall declare the Bhīṣmapañcaka, the king of votive observances, all-bestowing. / In the bright fortnight of the month of Kārttika, one should perform it on the eleventh lunar day.

205.s:
dināni pañcatriḥsnātī pañcavrīhitilais tathā(1) /
tarpayeddevapitrādīn maunī sampūjayeddhariṃ //
205.d:
दिनानि पञ्चत्रिःस्नाती पञ्चव्रीहितिलैस् तथा(1) /
तर्पयेद्देवपित्रादीन् मौनी सम्पूजयेद्धरिं //
205.m: For five days, bathing thrice [daily], with the five grains and sesame seeds, / one should offer libations to the gods, ancestors, and others, and silently worship Hari.

205.s:
pañcagavyena saṃsnāpya devaṃ pañcāmṛtena ca /
candanādyaiḥ samālipya gugguluṃ saghṛtandahet //
205.d:
पञ्चगव्येन संस्नाप्य देवं पञ्चामृतेन च /
चन्दनाद्यैः समालिप्य गुग्गुलुं सघृतन्दहेत् //
205.m: Bathing the deity with the five products of the cow and with the five nectars, / and anointing [him] with sandalwood paste and the like, one should burn guggulu resin with clarified butter.

205.s:
dīpaṃ dadyāddivārātrau naivedyaṃ paramānnakaṃ /
oṃ namo vāsudevāya japedaṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ //
:n
1 yavavrīhitilaistatheti gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
:p 248
205.d:
दीपं दद्याद्दिवारात्रौ नैवेद्यं परमान्नकं /
ओं नमो वासुदेवाय जपेदष्टोत्तरं शतं //
:न्
1 यवव्रीहितिलैस्तथेति घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. , ज.. च
:प् 248
205.m:
Day and night he should offer a lamp, and the supreme boiled rice as food offering; / he should recite one hundred and eight times: ‘Oṃ namo Vāsudevāya’ [‘Oṃ, obeisance to Vāsudeva’].
[Note]
1 yavavrīhitilaistatheti gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
:p 248

205.s:
juhuyācca ghṛtābhyaktāṃstilavrīhīṃstato vratī /
ṣaḍakṣareṇa mantreṇa svāhākārānvitena ca //
205.d:
जुहुयाच्च घृताभ्यक्तांस्तिलव्रीहींस्ततो व्रती /
षडक्षरेण मन्त्रेण स्वाहाकारान्वितेन च //
205.m: The observer of the votive observance should then offer sesame seeds and rice smeared with clarified butter into the fire / with the six-syllabled mantra accompanied by the exclamation ‘svāhā’.

205.s:
kamalaiḥ pūjayet pādau dvitīye bilvapatrakaiḥ /
jānu sakthi tṛtīye 'tha nābhiṃ bhṛṅgarajena tu //
205.d:
कमलैः पूजयेत् पादौ द्वितीये बिल्वपत्रकैः /
जानु सक्थि तृतीये ऽथ नाभिं भृङ्गरजेन तु //
205.m: With lotuses he should worship the feet; on the second [day], with leaves of the bilva tree; / the knees and thighs on the third, and then the navel with bhṛṅgarāja leaves;

205.s:
vāṇabilvajavābhistu caturthe pañcame 'hani /
mālatyā bhūmiśāyī syādekādaśyāntu gomayaṃ //
205.d:
वाणबिल्वजवाभिस्तु चतुर्थे पञ्चमे ऽहनि /
मालत्या भूमिशायी स्यादेकादश्यान्तु गोमयं //
205.m: with arrow-flowers, bilva, and hibiscus on the fourth; on the fifth day, / with jasmine; he should sleep on the ground; on the eleventh lunar day, however, cow-dung,

205.s:
gomūtraṃ dadhi dugdhaṃ ca pañcame pañcagavyakaṃ /
paurṇamāsyāñcarennaktaṃ bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhedvratī //
205.d:
गोमूत्रं दधि दुग्धं च पञ्चमे पञ्चगव्यकं /
पौर्णमास्याञ्चरेन्नक्तं भुक्तिं मुक्तिं लभेद्व्रती //
205.m: cow-urine, curds, milk, and on the fifth the five products of the cow [should be consumed]; / on the full moon day he should take a night-meal; the observer of the votive observance attains worldly enjoyment and liberation.

205.s:
bhīṣmaḥ kṛtvā hariṃ prāptastenaiva(1) bhīṣmapañcakaṃ /
brāhmaṇaḥ pūjanādyaiś ca upavāsādikaṃ vrataṃ(2) //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe bhīṣmapañcakaṃ nāma
pañcādhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha ṣaḍadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
agastyārghyadānakathanaṃ
205.d:
भीष्मः कृत्वा हरिं प्राप्तस्तेनैव(1) भीष्मपञ्चकं /
ब्राह्मणः पूजनाद्यैश् च उपवासादिकं व्रतं(2) //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे भीष्मपञ्चकं नाम
पञ्चाधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ षडधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः
अगस्त्यार्घ्यदानकथनं
205.m:
Having performed [this], Bhīṣma attained Hari; therefore [it is called] the Bhīṣmapañcaka. / A brāhmaṇa [performs] the votive observance of fasting and the like through worship and other rites.
Thus in the great Purāṇa of Agni, the two hundred and fifth chapter, entitled ‘The Bhīṣmapañcaka.’
Now, the two hundred and sixth chapter:
The Declaration of the Water Offering Gift to Agastya.

206.s:
agnir uvāca
agastyo bhagavānviṣṇustamabhyarcyāpnuyāddhariṃ /
aprāpte bhāskare kanyāṃ satribhāgaistribhirdinaiḥ //
:n
1 hariṃ lebhe tenaitaditi ga.. / hariṃ prāpa tenaitaditi ṅa.. / hariṃ
prāptastenaitaditi ja.. , ṭa.. ca
2 pūjanātpañca upavāsādajavratamiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , ña.. , ḍa..
ca
:p 249
206.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
अगस्त्यो भगवान्विष्णुस्तमभ्यर्च्याप्नुयाद्धरिं /
अप्राप्ते भास्करे कन्यां सत्रिभागैस्त्रिभिर्दिनैः //
:न्
1 हरिं लेभे तेनैतदिति ग.. / हरिं प्राप तेनैतदिति ङ.. / हरिं
प्राप्तस्तेनैतदिति ज.. , ट.. च
2 पूजनात्पञ्च उपवासादजव्रतमिति ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , ज.. , ञ.. , ड..
च
:प् 249
206.m:
Agni said: / Agastya is the Lord Viṣṇu; having worshipped him, one attains Hari. / When the sun has not yet reached Virgo, [that is,] three days and a third before,
[Note]
1 hariṃ lebhe tenaitaditi ga.. / hariṃ prāpa tenaitaditi ṅa.. / hariṃ
prāptastenaitaditi ja.. , ṭa.. ca
2 pūjanātpañca upavāsādajavratamiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , ña.. , ḍa..
ca
:p 249

206.s:
arghyaṃ dadyādagastyāya pūjayitvā hy upoṣitaḥ /
kāśapuṣpamayīṃ mūrtiṃ pradoṣe vinyased ghaṭe //
206.d:
अर्घ्यं दद्यादगस्त्याय पूजयित्वा ह्य् उपोषितः /
काशपुष्पमयीं मूर्तिं प्रदोषे विन्यसेद् घटे //
206.m: fasting, one should offer the water offering to Agastya, having worshipped him. / At twilight he should place an icon made of kāśa flowers into a pot.

206.s:
muneryajettāṃ kumbhasthāṃ rātrau kuryāt prajāgaraṃ /
agastya miniśārdūla tejorāśe mahāmate(1) //
206.d:
मुनेर्यजेत्तां कुम्भस्थां रात्रौ कुर्यात् प्रजागरं /
अगस्त्य मिनिशार्दूल तेजोराशे महामते(1) //
206.m: He should worship that [icon] of the sage resting in the pitcher; at night he should keep vigil: / ‘O Agastya, tiger among sages, mass of splendor, of great intellect!

206.s:
imāṃ mama kṛtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇīṣva priyayā saha /
āvāhyārghye ca sammukhyaṃ prārcayeccandanādinā //
206.d:
इमां मम कृतां पूजां गृह्णीष्व प्रियया सह /
आवाह्यार्घ्ये च सम्मुख्यं प्रार्चयेच्चन्दनादिना //
206.m: Accept this worship performed by me together with your beloved wife!’ / Having invoked him, facing him at the water offering, one should worship him with sandalwood paste and other offerings.

206.s:
jalāśayasamīpe tu prātarnītvārghyamarpayet /
kāśapuṣpapratīkāśa agnimārutasambhava(2) //
206.d:
जलाशयसमीपे तु प्रातर्नीत्वार्घ्यमर्पयेत् /
काशपुष्पप्रतीकाश अग्निमारुतसम्भव(2) //
206.m: In the morning, having taken [the offering] near a reservoir of water, he should present the water offering: / ‘O you who resemble the kāśa flower, born of Agni and Māruta,

206.s:
mitrāvaruṇayoḥ putra kumbhayone namo 'stu te /
ātāpirbhakṣito yena vātāpiś ca mahāsuraḥ //
206.d:
मित्रावरुणयोः पुत्र कुम्भयोने नमो ऽस्तु ते /
आतापिर्भक्षितो येन वातापिश् च महासुरः //
206.m: O son of Mitra and Varuṇa, born from a water-jar, obeisance to you! / By whom Ātāpi was devoured, and the great Asura Vātāpi,

206.s:
samudraḥ śoṣito yena so 'gastyaḥ sammukho 'stu me /
agastiṃ prārthayiṣyāmi karmaṇā manasā girā //
206.d:
समुद्रः शोषितो येन सो ऽगस्त्यः सम्मुखो ऽस्तु मे /
अगस्तिं प्रार्थयिष्यामि कर्मणा मनसा गिरा //
206.m: by whom the ocean was dried up, may that Agastya be propitious to me! / I shall make supplication to Agasti through action, mind, and speech.

206.s:
arcayisyāmyahaṃ maitraṃ paralokābhikāṅkṣayā /
dvīpāntarasamutpannaṃ devānāṃ paramaṃ priyaṃ //
206.d:
अर्चयिस्याम्यहं मैत्रं परलोकाभिकाङ्क्षया /
द्वीपान्तरसमुत्पन्नं देवानां परमं प्रियं //
206.m: Desiring the other world, I shall worship the son of Mitra. / Produced in other islands, exceedingly dear to the gods,

206.s:
rājānaṃ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ candanaṃ pratigṛhyatāṃ(3) /
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ bhājanī pāpanāśanī //
206.d:
राजानं सर्ववृक्षाणां चन्दनं प्रतिगृह्यतां(3) /
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां भाजनी पापनाशनी //
206.m: the king of all trees, let this sandalwood be accepted! / It is a vessel of dharma, wealth, pleasure, and liberation, a destroyer of sin;

206.s:
saubhāgyārogyalakṣmīdā puṣpamālā pragṛhyatāṃ /
dhūpo 'yaṃ gṛhyatāṃ deva bhaktiṃ me hy acalāṅkuru //
206.d:
सौभाग्यारोग्यलक्ष्मीदा पुष्पमाला प्रगृह्यतां /
धूपो ऽयं गृह्यतां देव भक्तिं मे ह्य् अचलाङ्कुरु //
206.m: bestower of good fortune, health, and prosperity, let this garland of flowers be received! / Let this incense be received, O deity; make my devotion steadfast!

206.s:
īpsitaṃ me varaṃ dehi paratra ca śubhāṅgatiṃ /
surāsurairmuniśreṣṭha sarvakāmaphalaprada //
:n
1 tejorāśe mahādyute iti ga.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca /
tejorāśe jagatpate iti ṅa..
2 vahnimārutasambhaveti jha..
3 candanaṃ me pragṛhyanāmiti ja.. , ña.. ca
:p 250
206.d:
ईप्सितं मे वरं देहि परत्र च शुभाङ्गतिं /
सुरासुरैर्मुनिश्रेष्ठ सर्वकामफलप्रद //
:न्
1 तेजोराशे महाद्युते इति ग.. , घ.. , छ.. , ज.. , झ.. , ञ.. , ट.. च /
तेजोराशे जगत्पते इति ङ..
2 वह्निमारुतसम्भवेति झ..
3 चन्दनं मे प्रगृह्यनामिति ज.. , ञ.. च
:प् 250
206.m:
Grant me my desired boon, and auspicious attainment in the hereafter, / O best of sages, praised by gods and demons, bestower of the fruits of all desires!’
[Note]
1 tejorāśe mahādyute iti ga.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca
tejorāśe jagatpate iti ṅa..
2 vahnimārutasambhaveti jha..
3 candanaṃ me pragṛhyanāmiti ja.. , ña.. ca
:p 250

206.s:
vastravrīhiphalairhemnā dattastvarghyo hy ayaṃ(1) mayā /
agastyaṃ bodhayiṣyāmi yanmayā manasoddhṛtaṃ(2) //
206.d:
वस्त्रव्रीहिफलैर्हेम्ना दत्तस्त्वर्घ्यो ह्य् अयं(1) मया /
अगस्त्यं बोधयिष्यामि यन्मया मनसोद्धृतं(2) //
206.m: ‘This water offering has been presented by me with garments, rice, fruits, and gold. / I shall awaken Agastya to that which has been conceived by my mind.

206.s:
phalairarghyaṃ pradāsyāmi gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mahāmune /
agastya evaṃ khanamānaḥ khanitraiḥ prajāmapatyaṃbalamīhamānaḥ /
ubhau karṇāvṛṣirugratejāḥ pupoṣa satyā deveṣvāśiṣojagāma //
206.d:
फलैरर्घ्यं प्रदास्यामि गृहाणार्घ्यं महामुने /
अगस्त्य एवं खनमानः खनित्रैः प्रजामपत्यंबलमीहमानः /
उभौ कर्णावृषिरुग्रतेजाः पुपोष सत्या देवेष्वाशिषोजगाम //
206.m: I shall grant the water offering with fruits; accept the water offering, O great sage! / Thus Agastya, digging with spades, desiring progeny, offspring, and strength, / the sage of fierce splendor nourished both varnas; true among the gods, he attained their blessings.’

206.s:
rājaputri namastubhyaṃ munipatnī mahāvrate /
arghyaṃ gṛhṇīṣva deveśi lopāmudre yaśasvini //
206.d:
राजपुत्रि नमस्तुभ्यं मुनिपत्नी महाव्रते /
अर्घ्यं गृह्णीष्व देवेशि लोपामुद्रे यशस्विनि //
206.m: ‘O princess, obeisance to you, wife of the sage, observer of great vows! / Receive the water offering, O queen of gods, renowned Lopāmudrā!’

206.s:
pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ hemarūpyasamanvitaṃ /
saptadhānyavṛtaṃ(3) pātraṃ dadhicandanasaṃyutaṃ //
206.d:
पञ्चरत्नसमायुक्तं हेमरूप्यसमन्वितं /
सप्तधान्यवृतं(3) पात्रं दधिचन्दनसंयुतं //
206.m: Endowed with five gems, accompanied by gold and silver, / a vessel surrounded by seven grains, containing curds and sandalwood paste,

206.s:
arghyaṃ dadyādagastyāya strīśūdrāṇāmavaidikaṃ /
agastya muniśārdūla tejorāśe ca sarvada //
206.d:
अर्घ्यं दद्यादगस्त्याय स्त्रीशूद्राणामवैदिकं /
अगस्त्य मुनिशार्दूल तेजोराशे च सर्वद //
206.m: he should offer as a water offering to Agastya, non-Vedic for women and Śūdras: / ‘O Agastya, tiger among sages, mass of splendor, all-bestower,

206.s:
imāṃ mama kṛtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhītvā vraja śāntaye /
tyajedagastryamuddiśya dhānyamekaṃ phalaṃ rasaṃ //
206.d:
इमां मम कृतां पूजां गृहीत्वा व्रज शान्तये /
त्यजेदगस्त्र्यमुद्दिश्य धान्यमेकं फलं रसं //
206.m: having accepted this worship performed by me, depart for peace!’ / Dedicated to Agastya, he should abandon one grain, fruit, or liquid.

206.s:
tato 'nnaṃ bhojayedviprān ghṛtapāyasamodakān /
gāṃ vāsāṃsi suvarṇañca(4) tebhyo dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ //
206.d:
ततो ऽन्नं भोजयेद्विप्रान् घृतपायसमोदकान् /
गां वासांसि सुवर्णञ्च(4) तेभ्यो दद्याच्च दक्षिणां //
206.m: Then he should feed the brāhmaṇas food, clarified butter, rice cooked in milk, and sweetmeats; / and to them he should give a cow, garments, gold, and a sacrificial fee.

206.s:
ghṛtapāyasayuktena pātreṇācchāditānanaṃ /
sahiraṇyañca taṃ kumbhaṃ brāhmaṇāyopakalpayet(5) //
:n
1 dattastvarghyo 'kṣaya iti ṅa..
2 manasepsitamiti ga.. , gha.. , jha.. ca / manasehitamiti ṅa..
3 saptadhānyayutamiti ja..
4 pratimāñca suvarṇañceti ka..
5 brāhmaṇāyopapādayediti gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
:p 251
206.d:
घृतपायसयुक्तेन पात्रेणाच्छादिताननं /
सहिरण्यञ्च तं कुम्भं ब्राह्मणायोपकल्पयेत्(5) //
:न्
1 दत्तस्त्वर्घ्यो ऽक्षय इति ङ..
2 मनसेप्सितमिति ग.. , घ.. , झ.. च / मनसेहितमिति ङ..
3 सप्तधान्ययुतमिति ज..
4 प्रतिमाञ्च सुवर्णञ्चेति क..
5 ब्राह्मणायोपपादयेदिति घ.. , ङ.. , ज.. , ञ.. च
:प् 251
206.m:
Covering the mouth [of the jar] with a vessel containing clarified butter and rice cooked in milk, / he should assign that pitcher together with gold to a brāhmaṇa.
[Note]
1 dattastvarghyo 'kṣaya iti ṅa..
"Desired in mind" in manuscripts ga, gha, and jha; "wished in mind" in manuscript ṅa.
"Joined with seven grains" in manuscript ja.
"And an image and gold" in manuscript ka.
"One should deliver to a brāhmaṇa" in manuscripts gha, ṅa, ja, and ña. / [Page 251]

206.s:
saptavarṣāṇi datvārghyaṃ sarve sarvamavāpnuyuḥ /
nīrā putrāṃś ca saubhāgyaṃ patiṃ kanyā nṛpodbhavaṃ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe agastyārghyadānavrataṃ nāma
ṣaḍadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha saptādhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
kaumudavrataṃ
206.d:
सप्तवर्षाणि दत्वार्घ्यं सर्वे सर्वमवाप्नुयुः /
नीरा पुत्रांश् च सौभाग्यं पतिं कन्या नृपोद्भवं //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे अगस्त्यार्घ्यदानव्रतं नाम
षडधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ सप्ताधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः
कौमुदव्रतं
206.m:
Having offered the water offering for seven years, all attain everything: / a barren woman [obtains] sons and good fortune, an unmarried girl a husband born of kings.
Thus in the great Purāṇa of Agni, the two hundred and sixth chapter, entitled "The Votive Observance of Offering the Water Offering to Agastya."
Now, the two hundred and seventh chapter.
The Kaumuda Votive Observance.

207.s:
agnir uvāca
kaumudākhyaṃ mayoktañca caredāśvayuje site /
hariṃ yajet māsamekamekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ //
207.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
कौमुदाख्यं मयोक्तञ्च चरेदाश्वयुजे सिते /
हरिं यजेत् मासमेकमेकादश्यामुपोषितः //
207.m: Agni said: / One should observe the [votive observance] named Kaumuda, taught by me, in the bright [fortnight] of Āśvayuja; / fasting on the eleventh [lunar day], one should worship Hari for one month.

207.s:
āśvine śuklapakṣehamekāhārī hariṃ japan /
māsamekaṃ bhuktimuktyai kariṣye kaumudaṃ vrataṃ //
207.d:
आश्विने शुक्लपक्षेहमेकाहारी हरिं जपन् /
मासमेकं भुक्तिमुक्त्यै करिष्ये कौमुदं व्रतं //
207.m: "Eating once a day in the bright fortnight of Āśvina, reciting [the name of] Hari, / I shall perform the Kaumuda votive observance for one month for the sake of worldly enjoyment and liberation."

207.s:
upoṣya viṣṇuṃ dvādaśyāṃ yajeddevaṃ vilipya ca /
candanāgurukāśmīraiḥ kamalotpalapuṣpakaiḥ //
207.d:
उपोष्य विष्णुं द्वादश्यां यजेद्देवं विलिप्य च /
चन्दनागुरुकाश्मीरैः कमलोत्पलपुष्पकैः //
207.m: Having fasted, one should worship God Viṣṇu on the twelfth lunar day, having smeared [the image] / with sandalwood, agallochum, and saffron, with lotuses and water-lily flowers,

207.s:
kalhārairvātha mālatyā dīpaṃ tailena vāgyataḥ /
ahorātraṃ ca naivedyaṃ pāyasāpūpamodakaiḥ //
207.d:
कल्हारैर्वाथ मालत्या दीपं तैलेन वाग्यतः /
अहोरात्रं च नैवेद्यं पायसापूपमोदकैः //
207.m: or with white water-lilies or jasmine; [one should offer] a lamp with oil while restraining one's speech, / and throughout day and night an offering of food with milk-rice, cakes, and sweetmeats.

207.s:
oṃ namo vāsudevāya vijñāpyātha kṣamāpayet /
:p 252
bhojanādi(1) dvije dadyādyāvad devaḥ prabuddhyate //
207.d:
ओं नमो वासुदेवाय विज्ञाप्याथ क्षमापयेत् /
:प् 252
भोजनादि(1) द्विजे दद्याद्यावद् देवः प्रबुद्ध्यते //
207.m:
Having announced, "Oṃ, homage to Vāsudeva!", one should then ask forgiveness.
[Page 252]
One should give food and the like to a twice-born until the god awakes.

207.s:
tāvanmāsopavāsaḥ syādadhikaṃ phalamapyataḥ /
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe kaumudavrataṃ nāma saptādhikadviśatatamo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athāṣṭādhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
vratadānādisamuccayaḥ
207.d:
तावन्मासोपवासः स्यादधिकं फलमप्यतः /
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे कौमुदव्रतं नाम सप्ताधिकद्विशततमो
ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथाष्टाधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः
व्रतदानादिसमुच्चयः
207.m:
Thence there would be a fasting for a month, and from that an even greater fruit.
Thus in the great Purāṇa of Agni, the two hundred and seventh chapter, entitled "The Kaumuda Votive Observance."
Now, the two hundred and eighth chapter.
A Summary of Votive Observances, Gifts, and Other Rites.

208.s:
agnir uvāca
vratadānāni sāmānyaṃ pravadāmi samāsataḥ /
tithau pratipadādau ca sūryādau kṛttikāsu ca //
208.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
व्रतदानानि सामान्यं प्रवदामि समासतः /
तिथौ प्रतिपदादौ च सूर्यादौ कृत्तिकासु च //
208.m: Agni said: / I shall state the common rules of votive observances and gifts in brief: / On a lunar day, beginning with the first lunar day, on [a day ruled by] the Sun and the rest, and under Kṛttikā and the other [asterisms],

208.s:
viṣkambhādau ca meṣādau kāle ca grahaṇādike /
yat kāle yad vrataṃ dānaṃ yad dravyaṃ niyamādi yat //
208.d:
विष्कम्भादौ च मेषादौ काले च ग्रहणादिके /
यत् काले यद् व्रतं दानं यद् द्रव्यं नियमादि यत् //
208.m: in [the yogas] beginning with Viṣkambha, in [the signs] beginning with Aries, and at the time of an eclipse and so forth; / at whatever time, whatever votive observance, gift, substance, restriction, and so on [is prescribed]—

208.s:
tad dravyākhyañca kālākhyaṃ sarvaṃ vai viṣṇudaivataṃ /
ravīśabrahmalakṣmyādyāḥ(2) sarve viṣṇorvibhūtayaḥ //
208.d:
तद् द्रव्याख्यञ्च कालाख्यं सर्वं वै विष्णुदैवतं /
रवीशब्रह्मलक्ष्म्याद्याः(2) सर्वे विष्णोर्विभूतयः //
208.m: that which is called substance and that which is called time, all that has Viṣṇu as its deity; / the Sun, the Lord, Brahmā, Lakṣmī, and the rest are all manifestations of Viṣṇu.

208.s:
tamuddiśya vrataṃ dānaṃ pūjādi syāttu sarvadaṃ /
jagatpate samāgaccha āsanaṃ pādyamarghyakaṃ //
208.d:
तमुद्दिश्य व्रतं दानं पूजादि स्यात्तु सर्वदं /
जगत्पते समागच्छ आसनं पाद्यमर्घ्यकं //
208.m: Intended for him, a votive observance, gift, worship, and the like will grant everything. / "O Lord of the world, come forth! [Here is] the seat, water for the feet, water offering,

208.s:
madhuparkaṃ tathācāmaṃ snānaṃ vastañca gandhakaṃ /
:n
1 bhojanāni iti ga.. , ja.. ca
2 ravīśabrahmalokeśā iti ja..
:p 253
puṣpaṃ dhūpaś ca dīpaś ca naivedyādi namo 'stu te //
208.d:
मधुपर्कं तथाचामं स्नानं वस्तञ्च गन्धकं /
:न्
1 भोजनानि इति ग.. , ज.. च
2 रवीशब्रह्मलोकेशा इति ज..
:प् 253
पुष्पं धूपश् च दीपश् च नैवेद्यादि नमो ऽस्तु ते //
208.m:
honey-mixture, sipping water, bath, garment, and fragrance,
[Note]
1 "Foods" in manuscripts ga and ja.
2 "The Sun, the Lord, Brahmā, and the guardians of the worlds" in manuscript ja. / [Page 253]
flower, incense, lamp, and offering of food and the like; homage be to you!"

208.s:
iti pūjāvrate dāne dānavākyaṃ samaṃ śṛṇu /
adyāmukasagotrāya viprāyāmukaśarmaṇe //
208.d:
इति पूजाव्रते दाने दानवाक्यं समं शृणु /
अद्यामुकसगोत्राय विप्रायामुकशर्मणे //
208.m: Thus in worship, a votive observance, and a gift. Hear the uniform declaration of giving: / "Today, to a brāhmaṇa of such-and-such gotra, named such-and-such Śarman,

208.s:
etad dravyaṃ viṣṇudaivaṃ sarvapāpopaśāntaye/
āyurārogyavṛddhyarthaṃ saubhāgyādivivṛddhaye(1) //
208.d:
एतद् द्रव्यं विष्णुदैवं सर्वपापोपशान्तये/
आयुरारोग्यवृद्ध्यर्थं सौभाग्यादिविवृद्धये(1) //
208.m: this substance, having Viṣṇu as deity, for the pacification of all sins, / for the increase of longevity and health, for the enhancement of good fortune and the like,

208.s:
gotrasantativṛddhyarthaṃ vijayāya dhanāya ca /
dharmāyaiśvaryakāmāya tatpāpaśamanāya ca //
208.d:
गोत्रसन्ततिवृद्ध्यर्थं विजयाय धनाय च /
धर्मायैश्वर्यकामाय तत्पापशमनाय च //
208.m: for the increase of the gotra and offspring, for victory, and for wealth, / for virtue, for desirable wealth, and for the pacification of those sins,

208.s:
saṃsāramuktaye dānantubhyaṃ sampradade hy ahaṃ /
etaddānapratiṣṭhārthaṃ tubhyametad dadāmyahaṃ //
208.d:
संसारमुक्तये दानन्तुभ्यं सम्प्रददे ह्य् अहं /
एतद्दानप्रतिष्ठार्थं तुभ्यमेतद् ददाम्यहं //
208.m: for liberation from transmigratory existence, I give this gift to you. / For the confirmation of this gift, I give this to you.

208.s:
etena prīyatāṃ nityaṃ sarvalokapatiḥ prabhuḥ /
yajñadānavratapate vidyākīrtyādi dehi me //
208.d:
एतेन प्रीयतां नित्यं सर्वलोकपतिः प्रभुः /
यज्ञदानव्रतपते विद्याकीर्त्यादि देहि मे //
208.m: Through this may the Lord, the master of all worlds, be perpetually pleased. / O Lord of sacrifices, gifts, and votive observances, grant me learning, renown, and the rest!

208.s:
dharmakāmārthamokṣāṃś ca dehi me manasepsitaṃ /
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyānnityaṃ vratadānasamuccayaṃ //
208.d:
धर्मकामार्थमोक्षांश् च देहि मे मनसेप्सितं /
यः पठेच्छृणुयान्नित्यं व्रतदानसमुच्चयं //
208.m: Grant me virtue, desire, wealth, and liberation, and what is desired in my mind!" / Whoever recites or listens daily to this summary of votive observances and gifts,

208.s:
sa prāptakāmo vimalo bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt /
tithivārarkṣasaṅkrāntiyogamanvādikaṃ vrataṃ //
208.d:
स प्राप्तकामो विमलो भुक्तिमुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् /
तिथिवारर्क्षसङ्क्रान्तियोगमन्वादिकं व्रतं //
208.m: having his desires attained and being spotless, will attain worldly enjoyment and liberation. / A votive observance [prescribed on] a lunar day, weekday, asterism, solstice, planetary conjunction, beginning of an era of Manu, and so forth,

208.s:
naikadhā vāsudevāderniyamāt pūjanādbhavet /
:e ity āgenye mahāpurāṇe vratadānasamuccayo nāma
aṣṭādhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 saubhāgyāya suṣṭadvaye iti ka.. , cha.. , ṭa, ca / saubhāgyāya subuddhaye
iti gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
:p 254
:ś atha navādhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
dānaparibhāṣākathanaṃ
208.d:
नैकधा वासुदेवादेर्नियमात् पूजनाद्भवेत् /
:ए इत्य् आगेन्ये महापुराणे व्रतदानसमुच्चयो नाम
अष्टाधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 सौभाग्याय सुष्टद्वये इति क.. , छ.. , ट, च / सौभाग्याय सुबुद्धये
इति घ.. , ज.. , ञ.. च
:प् 254
:श् अथ नवाधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः
दानपरिभाषाकथनं
208.m:
takes place in manifold ways through the restriction [of food, etc.] and through the worship of Vāsudeva and others.
Thus in the great Purāṇa of Agni, the two hundred and eighth chapter, entitled "A Summary of Votive Observances and Gifts."
[Note]
1 "For good fortune, well-being in both [worlds]" in manuscripts ka, cha, and ṭa; "for good fortune, for good intellect" in manuscripts gha, ja, and ña. / [Page 254]
Now, the two hundred and ninth chapter.
Declaration of the Definitions of Gifts.

209.s:
agnir uvāca
dānadharmān pravakṣyāmi bhuktimuktidān śṛṇu /
dānamiṣṭaṃ tathā pūrtaṃ dharmaṃ kurvan hi sarvabhāk //
209.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
दानधर्मान् प्रवक्ष्यामि भुक्तिमुक्तिदान् शृणु /
दानमिष्टं तथा पूर्तं धर्मं कुर्वन् हि सर्वभाक् //
209.m: Agni said: / I shall declare the duties of giving that bestow worldly enjoyment and liberation; listen! / Performing the duty of sacrificial rites and charitable works, one truly obtains everything.

209.s:
vāpīkūpataḍāgāni devatāyatanāni ca /
annapradānamārāmāḥ pūrtaṃ dharmaṃ ca muktidaṃ //
209.d:
वापीकूपतडागानि देवतायतनानि च /
अन्नप्रदानमारामाः पूर्तं धर्मं च मुक्तिदं //
209.m: Oblong ponds, wells, water reservoirs, shrines of deities, / distribution of food, and pleasure gardens are charitable works that bestow liberation.

209.s:
agnihotraṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ vedānāñcānupālanaṃ /
ātithyaṃ vaiśvadevañca prāhuriṣṭañca nākadaṃ //
209.d:
अग्निहोत्रं तपः सत्यं वेदानाञ्चानुपालनं /
आतिथ्यं वैश्वदेवञ्च प्राहुरिष्टञ्च नाकदं //
209.m: The agnihotra, ascetic austerity, truthfulness, preservation of the Vedas, / hospitality, and the offering to all deities—this they declare to be sacrificial rite, which grants heaven.

209.s:
grahoparāge yaddānaṃ sūryasaṅkramaṇeṣu ca /
dvādaśyādau ca yaddānaṃ pūrtaṃ tadapi nākadaṃ //
209.d:
ग्रहोपरागे यद्दानं सूर्यसङ्क्रमणेषु च /
द्वादश्यादौ च यद्दानं पूर्तं तदपि नाकदं //
209.m: The gift made during an eclipse of a planet, at the transits of the sun, / on the twelfth lunar day, and so forth, is also a charitable work granting heaven.

209.s:
deśe kāle ca pātre ca dānaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet /
ayane viṣuve puṇye vyatīpāte dinakṣaye //
209.d:
देशे काले च पात्रे च दानं कोटिगुणं भवेत् /
अयने विषुवे पुण्ये व्यतीपाते दिनक्षये //
209.m: A gift in a proper place, at a proper time, and to a worthy recipient bears fruit ten-millionfold: / at the solstices, at the holy equinoxes, at a vyatīpāta, on a day of lunar attrition,

209.s:
yugādiṣu ca saṅkrāntau caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca /
sitapañcadaśīsarvadvādaśīṣvaṣṭakāsu ca //
209.d:
युगादिषु च सङ्क्रान्तौ चतुर्दश्यष्टमीषु च /
सितपञ्चदशीसर्वद्वादशीष्वष्टकासु च //
209.m: at the commencements of the cosmic ages, at a transit of the sun, on the fourteenth and eighth lunar days, / on all bright full-moon days, on all twelfth lunar days, and on the aṣṭakā days,

209.s:
yajñotsavavibāheṣu tathā manvantarādiṣu /
vaidhṛte dṛṣṭaduḥkhapne dravyabrāhmaṇalābhataḥ //
209.d:
यज्ञोत्सवविबाहेषु तथा मन्वन्तरादिषु /
वैधृते दृष्टदुःखप्ने द्रव्यब्राह्मणलाभतः //
209.m: at sacrifices, festivals, and weddings, and likewise at the commencements of the cosmic eras of a Manu, / at a vaidhṛti, when a bad dream has been seen, upon obtaining goods and a brāhmaṇa,

209.s:
śraddhā vā yaddine tatra sadā vā dānamiṣyate /
ayane dve vipuve dve catasraḥ ṣaḍaśītayaḥ //
209.d:
श्रद्धा वा यद्दिने तत्र सदा वा दानमिष्यते /
अयने द्वे विपुवे द्वे चतस्रः षडशीतयः //
209.m: or on whatever day faith arises, or always—giving is prescribed. / The two solstices, the two equinoxes, the four periods of eighty-six [days],

209.s:
catasro viṣṇupadyaś ca saṅkrātyo dvādaśottamāḥ /
:p 255
kanyāyāṃ mithune mīne dhanuṣyapi ravergatiḥ //
209.d:
चतस्रो विष्णुपद्यश् च सङ्क्रात्यो द्वादशोत्तमाः /
:प् 255
कन्यायां मिथुने मीने धनुष्यपि रवेर्गतिः //
209.m:
and the four Viṣṇupadīs are the twelve excellent transits of the sun.
[Page 255]
The passage of the sun into Virgo, Gemini, Pisces, and Sagittarius—

209.s:
ṣaḍaśītimukhāḥ proktāḥ ṣaḍaśītiguṇāḥ phalaiḥ /
atītānāgate puṇye dve udagdakṣiṇāyane //
209.d:
षडशीतिमुखाः प्रोक्ताः षडशीतिगुणाः फलैः /
अतीतानागते पुण्ये द्वे उदग्दक्षिणायने //
209.m: these are declared the entrances of the eighty-six [days], having fruits eighty-six-fold. / The two solstices, the northern and southern, are holy as they approach and pass.

209.s:
triṃśat karkaṭake nāḍyo makare viṃśatiḥ smṛtāḥ /
vartamāne tulāmeṣe nāḍyāstubhayato daśa //
209.d:
त्रिंशत् कर्कटके नाड्यो मकरे विंशतिः स्मृताः /
वर्तमाने तुलामेषे नाड्यास्तुभयतो दश //
209.m: Thirty nāḍīs in Cancer and twenty in Capricorn are traditionally remembered; / when [the sun] is in Libra and Aries, there are ten nāḍīs on both sides [of the transit].

209.s:
ṣaḍaśītyāṃ vyatītāyāṃ ṣaṣṭiruktāstu nāḍikāḥ /
puṇyākhyā viṣṇupādyāñca prākpaścādapi ṣoḍaśa //
209.d:
षडशीत्यां व्यतीतायां षष्टिरुक्तास्तु नाडिकाः /
पुण्याख्या विष्णुपाद्याञ्च प्राक्पश्चादपि षोडश //
209.m: When the eighty-six has passed, sixty nāḍikās are declared [holy]; / and in the Viṣṇupadī, sixteen [nāḍikās] before and after are designated as holy.

209.s:
śravaṇāśvidhaniṣṭhāsu nāgadaivatamastake /
yadā syādravivāreṇa vyatīpātaḥ sa ucyate //
209.d:
श्रवणाश्विधनिष्ठासु नागदैवतमस्तके /
यदा स्याद्रविवारेण व्यतीपातः स उच्यते //
209.m: When [the moon is] in Śravaṇā, Aśvinī, or Dhaniṣṭhā, or at the head of the serpent deity (Āśleṣā), / if it happens to be a Sunday, that is called a vyatīpāta.

209.s:
navamyāṃ śuklapakṣasya kārttike niragāt kṛtaṃ /
tretā sitatṛtīyāyāṃ vaiśākhe dvāparaṃ yugaṃ //
209.d:
नवम्यां शुक्लपक्षस्य कार्त्तिके निरगात् कृतं /
त्रेता सिततृतीयायां वैशाखे द्वापरं युगं //
209.m: On the ninth [lunar day] of the bright fortnight in Kārttika, the Kṛta age began; / the Tretā on the bright third in Vaiśākha; the Dvāpara age [on...]

209.s:
darśe vai māghamāsasya trayodaśyāṃ nabhasyake /
kṛṣṇe kaliṃ vijānīyāj jñeyā manvantarādayaḥ //
209.d:
दर्शे वै माघमासस्य त्रयोदश्यां नभस्यके /
कृष्णे कलिं विजानीयाज् ज्ञेया मन्वन्तरादयः //
209.m: On the new moon day of the month of Māgha, and on the thirteenth [lunar day] of the dark fortnight / of Bhādrapada, one should know Kali; and the beginnings of the cosmic eras of Manus should be known:

209.s:
aśvayukacchuklanavamī dvādaśī kārttike tathā /
tṛtīyā caiva māghasya tathā bhādrapadasya ca //
209.d:
अश्वयुकच्छुक्लनवमी द्वादशी कार्त्तिके तथा /
तृतीया चैव माघस्य तथा भाद्रपदस्य च //
209.m: the ninth of the bright fortnight of Āśvina, and likewise the twelfth of Kārttika; / the third of Māgha, and likewise of Bhādrapada;

209.s:
phālgunasyāpyamāvāsyā pauṣasyaikādaśī tathā /
āṣāḍhasyāpi daśamī māghamāsasya saptamī //
209.d:
फाल्गुनस्याप्यमावास्या पौषस्यैकादशी तथा /
आषाढस्यापि दशमी माघमासस्य सप्तमी //
209.m: the new moon day of Phālguna, and likewise the eleventh of Pauṣa; / also the tenth of Āṣāḍha, and the seventh of the month of Māgha;

209.s:
āvāṇe cāṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tathāṣāḍhe ca pūrṇimā /
kārttike phālgune tadvaj jyaiṣṭhe pañcadaśī tathā //
209.d:
आवाणे चाष्टमी कृष्णा तथाषाढे च पूर्णिमा /
कार्त्तिके फाल्गुने तद्वज् ज्यैष्ठे पञ्चदशी तथा //
209.m: the eighth of the dark fortnight in Śrāvaṇa, and the full moon day in Āṣāḍha; / likewise in Kārttika and Phālguna, and the fifteenth [lunar day] in Jyaiṣṭha.

209.s:
ūrdhve caivāgrahāyaṇyā aṣtakāstisra īritāḥ /
aṣṭakākhyā cāṣṭamī syādāsu(1) dānāni cākṣyayaṃ //
:n
1 syādatreti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
:p 256
209.d:
ऊर्ध्वे चैवाग्रहायण्या अष्तकास्तिस्र ईरिताः /
अष्टकाख्या चाष्टमी स्यादासु(1) दानानि चाक्ष्ययं //
:न्
1 स्यादत्रेति ग.. , घ.. , ज.. , ञ.. च
:प् 256
209.m:
Following the full moon day of Agrahāyaṇa, three Aṣṭakās are declared; / the eighth lunar day is named Aṣṭakā, and gifts [made] on these are inexhaustible.
[Note]
1 [Variant reading:] 'syādatra' in manuscripts ga, gha, ja, and ña.

209.s:
gayāgaṅgāprayāgādau tīrthe devālayādiṣu /
aprārthitāni dānāni vidyārthaṃ kanyakā na hi //
209.d:
गयागङ्गाप्रयागादौ तीर्थे देवालयादिषु /
अप्रार्थितानि दानानि विद्यार्थं कन्यका न हि //
209.m: At a sacred ford such as Gayā, the Gaṅgā, or Prayāga, and in temples of the deities and the like, / gifts are unsolicited; [they may be given] for the sake of learning, but never a maiden [for money].

209.s:
dadyāt pūrvamukho dānaṃ gṛhṇīyāduttarāmukhaḥ /
āyurvivardhate dāturgrahītuḥ kṣīyate na tat //
209.d:
दद्यात् पूर्वमुखो दानं गृह्णीयादुत्तरामुखः /
आयुर्विवर्धते दातुर्ग्रहीतुः क्षीयते न तत् //
209.m: One should give a gift facing east; [the recipient] should receive it facing north. / The life-span of the giver increases, and that of the recipient is not diminished.

209.s:
nāma gotraṃ samuccārya sampradānasya cātmanaḥ /
sampradeyaṃ prayacchanti kanyādāne punastrayaṃ //
209.d:
नाम गोत्रं समुच्चार्य सम्प्रदानस्य चात्मनः /
सम्प्रदेयं प्रयच्छन्ति कन्यादाने पुनस्त्रयं //
209.m: Having uttered the name and lineage of the recipient and of oneself, / they bestow the item to be given; in the gift of a maiden, however, three [ancestral names are uttered].

209.s:
snātvābhyarcya vyāhṛtibhirdadyāddānantu sodakaṃ /
kanakāśvatilā nāgā dāsīrathamahīgṛhāḥ //
209.d:
स्नात्वाभ्यर्च्य व्याहृतिभिर्दद्याद्दानन्तु सोदकं /
कनकाश्वतिला नागा दासीरथमहीगृहाः //
209.m: Having bathed and worshipped, one should give a gift with water using the sacred utterances: / gold, a horse, sesame seeds, elephants, a maidservant, a chariot, land, houses,

209.s:
kanyā ca kapilā dhenurmahādānāni vai daśa /
śrutaśauryatapaḥkanyāyājyaśiṣyādupagataṃ //
209.d:
कन्या च कपिला धेनुर्महादानानि वै दश /
श्रुतशौर्यतपःकन्यायाज्यशिष्यादुपगतं //
209.m: a maiden, and a brown cow—these indeed are the ten great gifts. / That which is acquired from sacred learning, valor, ascetic austerity, a maiden, a sacrificer, or a student;

209.s:
śulkaṃ dhanaṃ hi sakalaṃ śulkaṃ śilpānuvṛttitaḥ /
kuśīdakṛṣivāṇijyaprāptaṃ yadupakārataḥ //
209.d:
शुल्कं धनं हि सकलं शुल्कं शिल्पानुवृत्तितः /
कुशीदकृषिवाणिज्यप्राप्तं यदुपकारतः //
209.m: wealth that is white [i.e., pure]; all white wealth gained from practicing crafts; / that which is gained through lending on interest, agriculture, trade, or by conferring a favor;

209.s:
pāśakadyūtacauryādipratirūpakasāhasaiḥ /
vyājenopāvarjitaṃ kṛtsnaṃ trividhaṃ trividhaṃ phalaṃ //
209.d:
पाशकद्यूतचौर्यादिप्रतिरूपकसाहसैः /
व्याजेनोपावर्जितं कृत्स्नं त्रिविधं त्रिविधं फलं //
209.m: and all that is acquired by fraud through dice, gambling, theft, forgery, and violence: / [each of these is of] three kinds, and threefold is their fruit.

209.s:
adhyagnyadhyāvāhanikaṃ dattañca prītikarmaṇi /
bhrātṛmātṛpitṛprāptaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ strīdhanaṃsmṛtaṃ(1) //
209.d:
अध्यग्न्यध्यावाहनिकं दत्तञ्च प्रीतिकर्मणि /
भ्रातृमातृपितृप्राप्तं षड्विधं स्त्रीधनंस्मृतं(1) //
209.m: [Wealth] given before the nuptial fire, given during the bridal procession, given in an act of affection, / and received from brother, mother, or father—this is remembered as the sixfold property of a woman.

209.s:
brahmakṣatraviśāṃ dravyaṃ śūdrasyaiṣāmanugrahāt /
bahubhyo na pradeyāni gaurgṛhaṃ śayanaṃ stryiyaḥ //
209.d:
ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशां द्रव्यं शूद्रस्यैषामनुग्रहात् /
बहुभ्यो न प्रदेयानि गौर्गृहं शयनं स्त्र्यियः //
209.m: Wealth belongs to the Brāhmaṇas, Kṣatriyas, and Vaiśyas; for a Śūdra, it comes through their favor. / A cow, a house, a bed, and women must not be given to many.

209.s:
kulānāntu śataṃ hanyādaprayacchan pratiśrutaṃ /
devānāñca gurūṇāñca mātāpitrostathaiva ca //
209.d:
कुलानान्तु शतं हन्यादप्रयच्छन् प्रतिश्रुतं /
देवानाञ्च गुरूणाञ्च मातापित्रोस्तथैव च //
209.m: One who does not give what was promised destroys a hundred ancestral lineages. / To the gods, to gurus, and likewise to parents,

209.s:
puṇyaṃ deyaṃ prayatnena yat puṇyañcārjitaṃ kvacit /
:n
1 kuśodetyādiḥ strīdhanaṃ smṛtamityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ cha..
pustake nāsti
:p 257
pratilābhecchayā dattaṃ yaddhanaṃ tadapārthakaṃ //
209.d:
पुण्यं देयं प्रयत्नेन यत् पुण्यञ्चार्जितं क्वचित् /
:न्
1 कुशोदेत्यादिः स्त्रीधनं स्मृतमित्यन्तः पाठः छ..
पुस्तके नास्ति
:प् 257
प्रतिलाभेच्छया दत्तं यद्धनं तदपार्थकं //
209.m:
merit should be given diligently, whatever merit has been acquired anywhere.
[Note]
1 The reading from 'kuśīda' up to 'strīdhanaṃ smṛtam' is absent in manuscript cha.
Whatever wealth is given with a desire for a return is futile.

209.s:
śraddhayā sādhyate dharmo dattaṃ vāryapi cākṣayaṃ /
jñānaśīlaguṇopetaḥ parapīḍāvahiṣkṛtaḥ //
209.d:
श्रद्धया साध्यते धर्मो दत्तं वार्यपि चाक्षयं /
ज्ञानशीलगुणोपेतः परपीडावहिष्कृतः //
209.m: Righteousness is accomplished through faith; even water given [with faith] becomes inexhaustible. / One endowed with knowledge, good conduct, and virtue, who refrains from harming others,

209.s:
ajñānāṃ pālanāttrāṇāttat pātraṃ paramaṃ smṛtaṃ /
mātuḥ śataguṇaṃ dānaṃ sahasraṃ piturucyate //
209.d:
अज्ञानां पालनात्त्राणात्तत् पात्रं परमं स्मृतं /
मातुः शतगुणं दानं सहस्रं पितुरुच्यते //
209.m: and who protects and saves the ignorant, is remembered as the supreme recipient. / A gift to one's mother is hundredfold; to one's father it is said to be thousandfold;

209.s:
anantaṃ duhiturdānaṃ sodarye dattamakṣayaṃ /
amanuṣye samaṃ dānaṃ pāpe jñeyaṃ mahāphalaṃ //
209.d:
अनन्तं दुहितुर्दानं सोदर्ये दत्तमक्षयं /
अमनुष्ये समं दानं पापे ज्ञेयं महाफलं //
209.m: a gift to a daughter is endless; that given to a full brother is inexhaustible; / a gift to a non-human brings equal reward; to an evil person it should be known to bring great fruit.

209.s:
varṇasaṅkare dviguṇaṃ śūdre dānaṃ caturguṇaṃ /
vaiśye cāṣṭaguṇaṃ kṣatre ṣoḍaśatvaṃ dvijavruve //
209.d:
वर्णसङ्करे द्विगुणं शूद्रे दानं चतुर्गुणं /
वैश्ये चाष्टगुणं क्षत्रे षोडशत्वं द्विजव्रुवे //
209.m: A gift to one of mixed caste brings double; to a Śūdra, fourfold; / to a Vaiśya, eightfold; to a Kṣatriya, sixteenfold; to a nominal twice-born,

209.s:
vedādhyāye śataguṇamantaṃ vedabodhake(1) /
purohite yājakādau(2) dānamakṣayamucyate //
209.d:
वेदाध्याये शतगुणमन्तं वेदबोधके(1) /
पुरोहिते याजकादौ(2) दानमक्षयमुच्यते //
209.m: to a reciter of the Veda, hundredfold; and to one who teaches the Veda, endless; / to a family priest, an officiating priest, and the like, a gift is said to be inexhaustible.

209.s:
śrīvihīneṣu yaddattaṃ tadanantaṃ ca yajavani /
atapasvyanadhīyānaḥ pratigraharucirdvijaḥ //
209.d:
श्रीविहीनेषु यद्दत्तं तदनन्तं च यजवनि /
अतपस्व्यनधीयानः प्रतिग्रहरुचिर्द्विजः //
209.m: Whatever is given to those destitute of fortune is endless, O sacrificer! / A twice-born who performs no ascetic austerity, does not study, yet delights in accepting gifts,

209.s:
ambhasyaśmaplavenaiva saha tenaiva majjati /
snātaḥ samyagupaspṛśya gṛhṇīyāt prayataḥ śuciḥ //
209.d:
अम्भस्यश्मप्लवेनैव सह तेनैव मज्जति /
स्नातः सम्यगुपस्पृश्य गृह्णीयात् प्रयतः शुचिः //
209.m: sinks in water along with [the giver], just like a raft of stone. / Having bathed, properly sipped water, and become restrained and pure,

209.s:
pratigrahītā sāvitrīṃ sarvadaiva prakīrtayet(3) /
tatastu kīrtayetsārdhaṃ dravyeṇa saha daivataṃ //
209.d:
प्रतिग्रहीता सावित्रीं सर्वदैव प्रकीर्तयेत्(3) /
ततस्तु कीर्तयेत्सार्धं द्रव्येण सह दैवतं //
209.m: the recipient should always recite the Sāvitrī verse. / Then he should declare the deity together with the article [of donation].

209.s:
pratigrāhī paṭheduccaiḥ pratigṛhya dvijottamāt /
mandaṃ paṭhet kṣatriyāttu upāṃśu ca tathā viśaḥ //
:n
1 brahmabodhake iti gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca
2 purohite yācakādāviti kha.. , cha.. , ṭa.. ca
3 sarvatraiva prakīrtayediti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca
:p 258
209.d:
प्रतिग्राही पठेदुच्चैः प्रतिगृह्य द्विजोत्तमात् /
मन्दं पठेत् क्षत्रियात्तु उपांशु च तथा विशः //
:न्
1 ब्रह्मबोधके इति घ.. , ङ.. , ज.. , ञ.. , ट.. च
2 पुरोहिते याचकादाविति ख.. , छ.. , ट.. च
3 सर्वत्रैव प्रकीर्तयेदिति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , ज.. , ञ.. , ट.. च
:प् 258
209.m:
The recipient should recite aloud when receiving from an excellent twice-born; / softly when from a Kṣatriya; and in a whisper when likewise from a Vaiśya;
[Note]
1 [Variant reading:] 'brahmabodhake' in manuscripts gha, ṅa, ja, ña, and ṭa.
2 [Variant reading:] 'purohite yācakādau' in manuscripts kha, cha, and ṭa.
3 [Variant reading:] 'sarvatraiva prakīrtayed' in manuscripts kha, ga, gha, ṅa, ja, ña, and ṭa.

209.s:
manasā ca tathā śūdrāt svastivācanakaṃ tathā /
abhayaṃ sarvadaivatyaṃ bhūmirvai viṣṇudevatā //
209.d:
मनसा च तथा शूद्रात् स्वस्तिवाचनकं तथा /
अभयं सर्वदैवत्यं भूमिर्वै विष्णुदेवता //
209.m: and mentally from a Śūdra; and likewise the blessing of welfare. / Protection from fear has all deities as its presiding divinity; the earth has Viṣṇu as its deity;

209.s:
kanyā dāsas tathā dāsī prājāpatyāḥ prakirtitāḥ /
prājāpatyo gajaḥ proktasturago yamadaivataḥ //
209.d:
कन्या दासस् तथा दासी प्राजापत्याः प्रकिर्तिताः /
प्राजापत्यो गजः प्रोक्तस्तुरगो यमदैवतः //
209.m: a maiden, a manservant, and likewise a maidservant are declared to belong to Prajāpati; / an elephant is declared to belong to Prajāpati; a horse has Yama as its deity;

209.s:
tathā caikaśaphaṃ sarvaṃ yāmyaś ca mahiṣas tathā /
uṣṭraś ca nairṛto dhenū raudrī chāgo 'nalas tathā //
209.d:
तथा चैकशफं सर्वं याम्यश् च महिषस् तथा /
उष्ट्रश् च नैरृतो धेनू रौद्री छागो ऽनलस् तथा //
209.m: and likewise all one-hoofed animals belong to Yama, and so does a buffalo; / a camel belongs to Nirṛti; a cow to Rudra; and a goat to Agni;

209.s:
āpyo meṣo hariḥ krīḍa āraṇyāḥ paśavo 'nilāḥ /
jalāśayaṃ vāruṇaṃ syādvāridhānīghaṭādayaḥ //
209.d:
आप्यो मेषो हरिः क्रीड आरण्याः पशवो ऽनिलाः /
जलाशयं वारुणं स्याद्वारिधानीघटादयः //
209.m: a sheep belongs to the Waters; a monkey belongs to Vāyu; wild beasts belong to Vāyu; / a reservoir of water belongs to Varuṇa, as do water-jars, pots, and the like;

209.s:
samudrajāni ratnāni hemalauhāni cānalaḥ /
prājāpatyāni śasyāni pakvānnamapi sattama //
209.d:
समुद्रजानि रत्नानि हेमलौहानि चानलः /
प्राजापत्यानि शस्यानि पक्वान्नमपि सत्तम //
209.m: gems born of the ocean belong to Varuṇa; gold and iron to Agni; / grains belong to Prajāpati, as well as cooked food, O best of men;

209.s:
gāndharvaṃ gandhamityāhurvastraṃ vārhaspataṃ smṛtaṃ /
vāyavyāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ sarve vidyā brāhmī tathāṅgakaṃ //
209.d:
गान्धर्वं गन्धमित्याहुर्वस्त्रं वार्हस्पतं स्मृतं /
वायव्याः पक्षिणः सर्वे विद्या ब्राह्मी तथाङ्गकं //
209.m: they say fragrance belongs to the Gandharvas; clothing is remembered as belonging to Bṛhaspati; / all birds belong to Vāyu; sacred knowledge belongs to Brahmā, and likewise its auxiliary limbs.

209.s:
sārasvataṃ pustakādi viśvakarmā tu śilapke /
vanaspatirdrumādīnāṃ dravyadevā harestanuḥ //
209.d:
सारस्वतं पुस्तकादि विश्वकर्मा तु शिलप्के /
वनस्पतिर्द्रुमादीनां द्रव्यदेवा हरेस्तनुः //
209.m: Books and the like belong to Sarasvatī, but Viśvakarman presides over craftsmanship; / Vanaspati belongs to trees and the like. The deities of objects are the body of Hari.

209.s:
chatraṃ kṛṣṇājinaṃ śayyā ratha āsanameva ca /
upānahau tathā yānamuttānāṅgira īritaṃ //
209.d:
छत्रं कृष्णाजिनं शय्या रथ आसनमेव च /
उपानहौ तथा यानमुत्तानाङ्गिर ईरितं //
209.m: An umbrella, a black antelope skin, a bed, a chariot, a seat, / shoes, and a vehicle are declared to belong to Uttānāṅgiras.

209.s:
raṇopakaraṇaṃ śastraṃ dhvajādyaṃ sarvadaivataṃ /
gṛhañca sarvadaivatyaṃ sarveṣāṃ viṣṇudevatā //
209.d:
रणोपकरणं शस्त्रं ध्वजाद्यं सर्वदैवतं /
गृहञ्च सर्वदैवत्यं सर्वेषां विष्णुदेवता //
209.m: Equipment of war, weaponry, banners, and the like belong to all the gods; / a house also belongs to all deities. Viṣṇu is the deity of all things;

209.s:
śivo vā na tato dravyaṃ vyatiriktaṃ yato 'sti hi(1) /
dravyasya nāma gṛhṇīyāddadānīti tathā vadet //
209.d:
शिवो वा न ततो द्रव्यं व्यतिरिक्तं यतो ऽस्ति हि(1) /
द्रव्यस्य नाम गृह्णीयाद्ददानीति तथा वदेत् //
209.m: or Śiva [is]. For no substance is separate from him. / One should name the object and say: 'I give [this].'

209.s:
toyaṃ dadyāttato haste dāne vidhirayaṃ smṛtaḥ /
:n
1 yātotra hīti ja..
:p 259
viṣṇurdātā viṣṇurdravyaṃ pratigṛhṇāmi vai vadet //
209.d:
तोयं दद्यात्ततो हस्ते दाने विधिरयं स्मृतः /
:न्
1 यातोत्र हीति ज..
:प् 259
विष्णुर्दाता विष्णुर्द्रव्यं प्रतिगृह्णामि वै वदेत् //
209.m:
Then one should place water in [the recipient's] hand; this is declared the rule in a gift.
[Note]
1. Manuscript ja reads: "yātotra hi".
[Page 259]
'Viṣṇu is the giver, Viṣṇu is the object,' [and the recipient] should say: 'I receive [it].'

209.s:
svasti pratigrahaṃ dharmaṃ bhuktimuktī phaladvayaṃ /
gurūn bhṛtyānna jihīrṣurarciṣyan devatāḥ pitṝn //
209.d:
स्वस्ति प्रतिग्रहं धर्मं भुक्तिमुक्ती फलद्वयं /
गुरून् भृत्यान्न जिहीर्षुरर्चिष्यन् देवताः पितॄन् //
209.m: [The recipient should utter] 'Svasti.' Acceptance of a gift [brings] merit, and the two fruits: worldly enjoyment and liberation. / Wishing to support gurus and dependants, and desiring to worship the gods and the ancestors,

209.s:
sarvataḥ pratigṛhṇīyānna tu tṛpyet svayantataḥ /
śūdrīyanna tu yajñārthaṃ dhanaṃ śūdrasya tatphalaṃ //
209.d:
सर्वतः प्रतिगृह्णीयान्न तु तृप्येत् स्वयन्ततः /
शूद्रीयन्न तु यज्ञार्थं धनं शूद्रस्य तत्फलं //
209.m: one may accept from anyone; but one must not satisfy oneself from it. / What belongs to a Śūdra is not for sacrifice; a Śūdra's wealth [bears] that [very] fruit.

209.s:
guḍatakrarasādyāś ca śūdrādgrāhyā nivartinā /
sarvataḥ pratigṛhṇīyādavṛtyākarṣito dvijaḥ //
209.d:
गुडतक्ररसाद्याश् च शूद्राद्ग्राह्या निवर्तिना /
सर्वतः प्रतिगृह्णीयादवृत्याकर्षितो द्विजः //
209.m: Raw sugar, buttermilk, juices, and the like may be accepted from a Śūdra by one who has withdrawn [from active worldly life]. / A twice-born man afflicted by lack of livelihood may accept from anyone.

209.s:
nādhyāpanādyājanādvā garhitādvā pratigrahāt /
doṣo bhavati viprāṇāṃ jvalanārkasamā hi te //
209.d:
नाध्यापनाद्याजनाद्वा गर्हिताद्वा प्रतिग्रहात् /
दोषो भवति विप्राणां ज्वलनार्कसमा हि ते //
209.m: No sin accrues to Brahmins from teaching, from officiating at sacrifice, / or from blameworthy acceptance of a gift; for they are equal to fire and the sun.

209.s:
kṛte tu dīyate gatvā tretāsvānīya dīyate /
dvāpāre yācamānāya kalau tvanugamānvite //
209.d:
कृते तु दीयते गत्वा त्रेतास्वानीय दीयते /
द्वापारे याचमानाय कलौ त्वनुगमान्विते //
209.m: In the Kṛta [age] a gift is given having gone [to the recipient]; in the Tretā [age] it is given having summoned [him]; / in the Dvāpara to one who asks; but in the Kali [age] to one who follows after.

209.s:
manasā pātramuddiśya jalaṃ bhūmau vinikṣipet /
vidyate sāgarasyānto nānto dānasya vidyate(1) //
209.d:
मनसा पात्रमुद्दिश्य जलं भूमौ विनिक्षिपेत् /
विद्यते सागरस्यान्तो नान्तो दानस्य विद्यते(1) //
209.m: Designating the recipient in one's mind, one should pour water on the earth. / There is an end to the ocean, but there is no end to [the fruit of] a gift.

209.s:
adya somārkagrahaṇasaṅkrāntyādau ca kālake /
gaṅgāgayāprayāgādau tīrthadeśe mahāguṇe //
209.d:
अद्य सोमार्कग्रहणसङ्क्रान्त्यादौ च कालके /
गङ्गागयाप्रयागादौ तीर्थदेशे महागुणे //
209.m: 'Today, at this time of an eclipse of the moon or sun, a solstice, or the like, / in an exceedingly meritorious sacred ford such as the Gaṅgā, Gayā, or Prayāga,

209.s:
tathā cāmukagotrāya tathā cāmukaśarmaṇe /
vedavedāṅgayuktāya pātrāya sumahātmane //
209.d:
तथा चामुकगोत्राय तथा चामुकशर्मणे /
वेदवेदाङ्गयुक्ताय पात्राय सुमहात्मने //
209.m: to such-and-such a gotra, to such-and-such a Śarman, / endowed with the Veda and Vedāṅgas, a worthy recipient, a great-souled one,

209.s:
yathānāma mahādravyaṃ viṣṇurudrādidaivataṃ /
putrapautragṛhaiśvaryapatnīdharmārthasadguṇā //
209.d:
यथानाम महाद्रव्यं विष्णुरुद्रादिदैवतं /
पुत्रपौत्रगृहैश्वर्यपत्नीधर्मार्थसद्गुणा //
209.m: this great gift of such-and-such a name, having Viṣṇu, Rudra, and others as deity, / for sons, grandsons, house, sovereignty, wife, righteousness, wealth, and virtues,

209.s:
kīttividyāmahākāmasaubhāgyārogyavṛddhaye /
sarvapāpopaśāntyarthaṃ svargārthaṃ bhuktimuktaye //
:n
1 na taddānasya vidyate iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. , ña.. , ṭha..
ca
:p 260
209.d:
कीत्तिविद्यामहाकामसौभाग्यारोग्यवृद्धये /
सर्वपापोपशान्त्यर्थं स्वर्गार्थं भुक्तिमुक्तये //
:न्
1 न तद्दानस्य विद्यते इति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. , ज.. , ञ.. , ठ..
च
:प् 260
209.m:
for the increase of fame, knowledge, great desires, good fortune, and health, / for the pacification of all sins, for heaven, and for worldly enjoyment and liberation,
[Note]
1. Manuscripts kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cha, ja, ña, and ṭha read: "na taddānasya vidyate".
[Page 260]

209.s:
etattubhyaṃ sampradade prīyatāṃ me hariḥ śivaḥ /
divyāntarīkṣabhaumādisamutpātaughaghātakṛt(1) //
209.d:
एतत्तुभ्यं सम्प्रददे प्रीयतां मे हरिः शिवः /
दिव्यान्तरीक्षभौमादिसमुत्पातौघघातकृत्(1) //
209.m: this I give to you. May Hari and Śiva be pleased with me, / destroying the multitude of portents arising from heaven, the mid-space, the earth, and elsewhere!

209.s:
dharmārthakāmamokṣāptyai brahmalokaprado 'stu me /
yathānāmasagotrāya viprāyāmukaśarmaṇe //
209.d:
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाप्त्यै ब्रह्मलोकप्रदो ऽस्तु मे /
यथानामसगोत्राय विप्रायामुकशर्मणे //
209.m: May it grant me the world of Brahmā, for the attainment of righteousness, wealth, desire, and liberation!' / To a Brahmin of such-and-such a name and gotra, such-and-such a Śarman,

209.s:
etaddānapratiṣṭhārthaṃ suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dade /
anena dānavākyena sarvadānāni vai dadet //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe dānaparibhāṣā nāma
navādhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha daśādhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
mahādānāni
209.d:
एतद्दानप्रतिष्ठार्थं सुवर्णं दक्षिणां ददे /
अनेन दानवाक्येन सर्वदानानि वै ददेत् //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे दानपरिभाषा नाम
नवाधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ दशाधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः
महादानानि
209.m:
'I give gold as a sacrificial fee for the consecration of this gift.' / With this formula of gift, one should indeed bestow all gifts.
Thus ends the two hundred and ninth chapter, named 'The Definition of Gifts,' in the Great Purāṇa of Agni.
Now the two hundred and tenth chapter.
The Great Gifts

210.s:
agnir uvāca
sarvadānāni vakṣyāmi mahādānāni ṣoḍaśa /
tulāpuruṣa ādyantu hiraṇyagarbhadānakaṃ //
210.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
सर्वदानानि वक्ष्यामि महादानानि षोडश /
तुलापुरुष आद्यन्तु हिरण्यगर्भदानकं //
210.m: Agni said: / I shall declare all gifts, the sixteen great gifts. / The weighing of a man [against gold] is the first, then the gift of the golden embryo,

210.s:
brahmāṇḍaṃ kalpavṛkṣaś ca gosahasrañca pañcamaṃ /
hiraṇyakāmadhenuś ca hiraṇyāśvaś ca saptamaṃ //
210.d:
ब्रह्माण्डं कल्पवृक्षश् च गोसहस्रञ्च पञ्चमं /
हिरण्यकामधेनुश् च हिरण्याश्वश् च सप्तमं //
210.m: the cosmic egg, the wishing tree, and a thousand cows as the fifth, / the golden wish-granting cow, and the golden horse as the seventh,

210.s:
hiraṇyāśvarathastadvaddhemahastirathas tathā /
pañcalāṅgalakantadvaddharādānaṃ tathaiva ca //
:n
1 samutpātādyapāpahṛt iti ṅa.. / samutpātādipāpahṛditi gha..
:p 261
210.d:
हिरण्याश्वरथस्तद्वद्धेमहस्तिरथस् तथा /
पञ्चलाङ्गलकन्तद्वद्धरादानं तथैव च //
:न्
1 समुत्पाताद्यपापहृत् इति ङ.. / समुत्पातादिपापहृदिति घ..
:प् 261
210.m:
likewise the golden chariot with horses, and so the golden elephant chariot, / likewise the five ploughs, and in the same way the gift of land,
[Note]
1. Manuscript ṅa reads: "samutpātādyapāpahṛt"; manuscript gha reads: "samutpātādipāpahṛt".
[Page 261]

210.s:
viśvacakraṃ kalpalatā saptasāgarakaṃ paraṃ /
ratnadhenurmahābhūtaghaṭaḥ śubhadine 'rpayet //
210.d:
विश्वचक्रं कल्पलता सप्तसागरकं परं /
रत्नधेनुर्महाभूतघटः शुभदिने ऽर्पयेत् //
210.m: the universal wheel, the wishing creeper, next the seven oceans, / the jewel-cow, and the jar of the elements. One should present [these] on an auspicious day.

210.s:
maṇḍape maṇḍale dānaṃ devān prārcyārpayeddvije /
merudānāni puṇyāni meravo daśa tān śṛṇu //
210.d:
मण्डपे मण्डले दानं देवान् प्रार्च्यार्पयेद्द्विजे /
मेरुदानानि पुण्यानि मेरवो दश तान् शृणु //
210.m: Having worshipped the gods in a pavilion on a maṇḍala, one should bestow the gift on a twice-born man. / Listen to the meritorious gifts of Merus; they are ten Merus.

210.s:
dhānyadroṇasahasreṇa uttamo 'rdhārdhataḥ parau /
uttamaḥ ṣoḍaśadroṇaḥ kartavyo lavaṇācalaḥ //
210.d:
धान्यद्रोणसहस्रेण उत्तमो ऽर्धार्धतः परौ /
उत्तमः षोडशद्रोणः कर्तव्यो लवणाचलः //
210.m: The highest [mountain of grain] is [made] with a thousand droṇas of grain; the other two are successively halved. / The highest mountain of salt should be made with sixteen droṇas;

210.s:
daśabhārair guḍādriḥ syāduttamo 'rdhārdhataḥ parau /
uttamaḥ palasāhasraiḥ svarṇamerus tathā parau //
210.d:
दशभारैर् गुडाद्रिः स्यादुत्तमो ऽर्धार्धतः परौ /
उत्तमः पलसाहस्रैः स्वर्णमेरुस् तथा परौ //
210.m: the highest mountain of raw sugar should be [made] of ten bhāras; the other two are successively halved. / The highest golden Meru is [made] with thousands of palas; likewise the other two.

210.s:
daśadroṇaistilādriḥ syāt pañcabhiś ca tribhiḥ kramāt /
kārpāsaparvato viṃśabhāraiś ca daśapañcabhiḥ //
210.d:
दशद्रोणैस्तिलाद्रिः स्यात् पञ्चभिश् च त्रिभिः क्रमात् /
कार्पासपर्वतो विंशभारैश् च दशपञ्चभिः //
210.m: The mountain of sesame seeds should be of ten droṇas, five [droṇas], and three [droṇas] respectively; / and the cotton mountain with twenty bhāras, ten, and five.

210.s:
viṃśatyā ghṛhakumbhānāmuttamaḥ syād ghṛtācalaḥ(1) /
daśabhiḥ palasāhasrair uttamo rajatācalaḥ //
210.d:
विंशत्या घृहकुम्भानामुत्तमः स्याद् घृताचलः(1) /
दशभिः पलसाहस्रैर् उत्तमो रजताचलः //
210.m: The highest mountain of ghee is [made] with twenty jars of ghee; / the highest silver mountain with ten thousand palas;

210.s:
aṣṭabhāraiḥ śarkarādrirmadhyomando 'rdhato 'rdhataḥ /
daśa dhenūḥ pravakṣyāmi yā dattvā bhuktimuktibhāk //
210.d:
अष्टभारैः शर्कराद्रिर्मध्योमन्दो ऽर्धतो ऽर्धतः /
दश धेनूः प्रवक्ष्यामि या दत्त्वा भुक्तिमुक्तिभाक् //
210.m: the sugar mountain with eight bhāras, the middling and inferior halved and halved [again]. / I shall declare the ten cows, having given which one partakes of worldly enjoyment and liberation.

210.s:
prathamā guḍadhenuḥ syād ghṛtadhenus tathāparā /
tiladhenustṛtoyā ca caturthī jaladhenukā //
210.d:
प्रथमा गुडधेनुः स्याद् घृतधेनुस् तथापरा /
तिलधेनुस्तृतोया च चतुर्थी जलधेनुका //
210.m: The cow of raw sugar is the first, and the cow of ghee is another; / the cow of sesame seeds is the third, and the fourth is the cow of water;

210.s:
kṣīradhenurmadhudhenuḥ śarkarādadhidhenuke /
rasadhenuḥ svarūpeṇa daśamī vidhirucyate //
210.d:
क्षीरधेनुर्मधुधेनुः शर्करादधिधेनुके /
रसधेनुः स्वरूपेण दशमी विधिरुच्यते //
210.m: the cow of milk, the cow of honey, the cow of sugar and the cow of curds; / the cow of sugarcane juice, and the tenth [consists of a cow] in its actual form; the rule is declared [here].

210.s:
kumbhāḥ syurdravadhenūnāmitarāsāntu rāśayaḥ /
kṛṣṇājinañcaturhastaṃ prāggrīvaṃ vinyasedbhuvi //
210.d:
कुम्भाः स्युर्द्रवधेनूनामितरासान्तु राशयः /
कृष्णाजिनञ्चतुर्हस्तं प्राग्ग्रीवं विन्यसेद्भुवि //
210.m: Jars are [used] for the liquid cows, but heaps for the others. / One should place on the ground a four-cubit black antelope skin with the neck to the east,

210.s:
gomayenānuliptāyāṃ darbhānāstīrya sarvataḥ /
:n
1 atra ratnācalabodhakapāṭhaḥ patitaḥ daśavidhācalavibhāgasya
pratijñātatvāt matsyapurāṇīyasaptasaptatyadhyāye ratnaśailas
tathāṣṭama ity anena ratnācalasya
daśavidhācalāntargatatvenollekhanācca
:p 262
laghvaiṇakājinaṃ tadvadvatsasya parikalpayet //
210.d:
गोमयेनानुलिप्तायां दर्भानास्तीर्य सर्वतः /
:न्
1 अत्र रत्नाचलबोधकपाठः पतितः दशविधाचलविभागस्य
प्रतिज्ञातत्वात् मत्स्यपुराणीयसप्तसप्तत्यध्याये रत्नशैलस्
तथाष्टम इत्य् अनेन रत्नाचलस्य
दशविधाचलान्तर्गतत्वेनोल्लेखनाच्च
:प् 262
लघ्वैणकाजिनं तद्वद्वत्सस्य परिकल्पयेत् //
210.m:
on [ground] smeared with cow dung, having scattered darbha grass all around.
[Note]
1. Here a passage indicating the jewel-mountain has dropped out, since a division of ten kinds of mountains was promised, and because in chapter seventy-seven of the Matsyapurāṇa, with the phrase "likewise the jewel-mountain is the eighth", the jewel-mountain is mentioned as included among the ten kinds of mountains.
[Page 262]
In the same way, one should prepare a small skin of a blackbuck for the calf.

210.s:
prāṅmukhīṃ kalpayeddhenumudakpādāṃ savatsakāṃ /
uttamā guḍadhenuḥ syāt sadā bhāracatuṣṭayāt //
210.d:
प्राङ्मुखीं कल्पयेद्धेनुमुदक्पादां सवत्सकां /
उत्तमा गुडधेनुः स्यात् सदा भारचतुष्टयात् //
210.m: One should fashion the cow facing east, with its legs to the north, accompanied by its calf. / The superior cow of raw sugar is always [made] from four bhāras;

210.s:
vatsaṃ bhāreṇa kurvīta bhārābhyāṃ madhyamā smṛtā /
ardhabhāreṇa vatsaḥ syāt kaniṣṭhā bhārakeṇa tu //
210.d:
वत्सं भारेण कुर्वीत भाराभ्यां मध्यमा स्मृता /
अर्धभारेण वत्सः स्यात् कनिष्ठा भारकेण तु //
210.m: one should make the calf with one bhāra. The middling [cow] is stated to be of two bhāras; / the calf should be with half a bhāra; and the smallest with one bhāra,

210.s:
caturthāṃśena vatsaḥ syād guḍavittānusārataḥ /
pañca kṛṣṇalakā māṣaste suvarnastu ṣoḍaśa //
210.d:
चतुर्थांशेन वत्सः स्याद् गुडवित्तानुसारतः /
पञ्च कृष्णलका माषस्ते सुवर्नस्तु षोडश //
210.m: and the calf should be with a quarter [bhāra], according to the wealth of raw sugar. / Five kṛṣṇalakas are a māṣa, and sixteen of those are a suvarṇa;

210.s:
palaṃ suvarṇāś catvārastulā palaśataṃ smṛtaṃ /
syādbhāro viṃśatitulā droṇastu caturāḍhakaḥ //
210.d:
पलं सुवर्णाश् चत्वारस्तुला पलशतं स्मृतं /
स्याद्भारो विंशतितुला द्रोणस्तु चतुराढकः //
210.m: a pala is four suvarṇas, and a tulā is recorded as a hundred palas; / a bhāra is twenty tulās, and a droṇa is four āḍhakas.

210.s:
dhenuvatsau guḍasyobhau sitasūkṣmāmbarāvṛtau /
śuktikarṇāvikṣupādau śucimuktāphalekṣaṇau //
210.d:
धेनुवत्सौ गुडस्योभौ सितसूक्ष्माम्बरावृतौ /
शुक्तिकर्णाविक्षुपादौ शुचिमुक्ताफलेक्षणौ //
210.m: Both cow and calf made of raw sugar are covered with white, fine garments, / with mother-of-pearl ears, sugarcane legs, and eyes of pure pearls,

210.s:
sitasūtraśirālau ca sitakambalakamvalau /
tāmragaḍḍukapṛṣṭhau tau sitacāmararomakau //
210.d:
सितसूत्रशिरालौ च सितकम्बलकम्वलौ /
ताम्रगड्डुकपृष्ठौ तौ सितचामररोमकौ //
210.m: with white thread veins, white woolen blankets as dewlaps, / with copper vessels for backs, and white yak-tail chowries for hair,

210.s:
vidrumabhrūyugāvetau navanītastanānvitau /
kṣaumapucchau kāṃsyadohāvindranīlakatārakau //
210.d:
विद्रुमभ्रूयुगावेतौ नवनीतस्तनान्वितौ /
क्षौमपुच्छौ कांस्यदोहाविन्द्रनीलकतारकौ //
210.m: with pairs of coral eyebrows, provided with butter udders, / linen tails, bronze milking vessels, and sapphire pupils,

210.s:
suvarṇaśṛṅgābharaṇau rajatakṣurasaṃyutau /
nānāphalamayā dantā gandhaghrāṇaprakalpitau //
210.d:
सुवर्णशृङ्गाभरणौ रजतक्षुरसंयुतौ /
नानाफलमया दन्ता गन्धघ्राणप्रकल्पितौ //
210.m: endowed with gold-adorned horns and silver hooves, / teeth made of various fruits, and fashioned with fragrant scents for nostrils.

210.s:
racayitvā yajeddhenumimair mantrair dvijottama /
yā lakṣmīḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yā ca deveṣvavasthitā //
210.d:
रचयित्वा यजेद्धेनुमिमैर् मन्त्रैर् द्विजोत्तम /
या लक्ष्मीः सर्वभूतानां या च देवेष्ववस्थिता //
210.m: Having fashioned it, one should worship the cow with these mantras, O best of twice-born: / 'The Lakṣmī who belongs to all beings, and who abides among the gods,

210.s:
dhenurūpeṇa sā devī mama śāntiṃ prayacchatu /
dehasthā yā ca rudrāṇī śaṅkarasya sadā priyā //
210.d:
धेनुरूपेण सा देवी मम शान्तिं प्रयच्छतु /
देहस्था या च रुद्राणी शङ्करस्य सदा प्रिया //
210.m: may that goddess, in the form of a cow, grant me peace! / And the Rudrāṇī who resides in the body, who is ever dear to Śaṅkara,

210.s:
dhenurūpeṇa sā devī mama pāpaṃ vyapohatu /
viṣṇuvakṣasi yā lakṣmīḥ svāhā yā ca vibhāvasoḥ //
:p 263
210.d:
धेनुरूपेण सा देवी मम पापं व्यपोहतु /
विष्णुवक्षसि या लक्ष्मीः स्वाहा या च विभावसोः //
:प् 263
210.m:
May that goddess in the form of a cow remove my sin. / That Lakṣmī who is on Viṣṇu’s chest, and who is Svāhā of the fire,
[Page 263]

210.s:
candrārkaṛkṣaśaktiryā dhenurūpāstu sā śriye /
caturmukhasya yā lakṣmīryā lakṣmīrdhanadasya ca //
210.d:
चन्द्रार्कऋक्षशक्तिर्या धेनुरूपास्तु सा श्रिये /
चतुर्मुखस्य या लक्ष्मीर्या लक्ष्मीर्धनदस्य च //
210.m: And who is the power of the moon, sun, and stars—may she in the form of a cow bring prosperity. / She who is the Fortune of the four-faced [Brahmā], and the Fortune of the giver of wealth [Kubera],

210.s:
lakṣmīryā lokapālānāṃ sa dhenurvaradāstu me /
svadhā tvaṃ pitṛmukhyānāṃ svāhā yajñabhujāṃ yataḥ //
210.d:
लक्ष्मीर्या लोकपालानां स धेनुर्वरदास्तु मे /
स्वधा त्वं पितृमुख्यानां स्वाहा यज्ञभुजां यतः //
210.m: And the Fortune of the world guardians—may that cow be the granter of boons to me. / Since you are Svadhā for the chief ancestors, and Svāhā for the eaters of sacrificial offerings,

210.s:
sarvapāpaharā dhenustasmācchāntiṃ prayaccha me /
evamāmantritāṃ dhenuṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet //
210.d:
सर्वपापहरा धेनुस्तस्माच्छान्तिं प्रयच्छ मे /
एवमामन्त्रितां धेनुं ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् //
210.m: And the cow that removes all sins, therefore grant me peace!’ / Having addressed the cow in this manner, he should present it to a brāhmaṇa.

210.s:
samānaṃ sarvadhenūnāṃ vidhānaṃ caitadeva hi /
sarvayajñaphalaṃ prāpya nirmalo bhuktimuktibhāk //
210.d:
समानं सर्वधेनूनां विधानं चैतदेव हि /
सर्वयज्ञफलं प्राप्य निर्मलो भुक्तिमुक्तिभाक् //
210.m: And this very ritual is the same for all [symbolic] cows. / Attaining the fruit of all sacrifices, free of impurity, he partakes of worldly enjoyment and liberation.

210.s:
svarṇaśṛṅgo śaphai raupyaiḥ suśīlā vastrasaṃyutā /
kāṃsyopadohā dātavyā kṣoriṇau gauḥ sadakṣiṇā //
210.d:
स्वर्णशृङ्गो शफै रौप्यैः सुशीला वस्त्रसंयुता /
कांस्योपदोहा दातव्या क्षोरिणौ गौः सदक्षिणा //
210.m: With golden horns, silver hooves, well-tempered, clothed with garments, / with a bronze milking vessel, a milch cow should be given accompanied by a sacrificial fee.

210.s:
dātāsyāḥ svargamāpnoti vatsarān somasammitān /
kapilā cettārayati bhūyaścāsaptamaṃ kulaṃ //
210.d:
दातास्याः स्वर्गमाप्नोति वत्सरान् सोमसम्मितान् /
कपिला चेत्तारयति भूयश्चासप्तमं कुलं //
210.m: Its giver attains heaven for years equal [in number to the rays of] the moon. / If it is a tawny cow, it delivers his lineage up to the seventh generation furthermore.

210.s:
svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ kāṃsyadohanakānvitāṃ /
śaktito dakṣiṇāyuktāṃ dattvā syādbhuktimuktibhāk //
210.d:
स्वर्णशृङ्गीं रौप्यखुरां कांस्यदोहनकान्वितां /
शक्तितो दक्षिणायुक्तां दत्त्वा स्याद्भुक्तिमुक्तिभाक् //
210.m: Having given [a cow] with golden horns, silver hooves, accompanied by a bronze milking vessel, / along with a sacrificial fee according to one's means, one partakes of worldly enjoyment and liberation.

210.s:
savatsaromatulyāni yugānyubhayatomukhīṃ /
dattvā svargamavāpnoti pūrveṇa vidhinā dadet //
210.d:
सवत्सरोमतुल्यानि युगान्युभयतोमुखीं /
दत्त्वा स्वर्गमवाप्नोति पूर्वेण विधिना ददेत् //
210.m: Having given an ubhayatomukhī cow, he attains heaven for yugas / equal [in number] to its hairs along with the calf; he should give it according to the previously stated rule.

210.s:
āsannamṛtyunā deyā savatsā gaustu pūrvavat /
yamadvāre mahāvīre taptā vaitaraṇī(1) nadī //
210.d:
आसन्नमृत्युना देया सवत्सा गौस्तु पूर्ववत् /
यमद्वारे महावीरे तप्ता वैतरणी(1) नदी //
210.m: A cow with calf should be given by one whose death is near, just as before: / ‘At the entrance of Yama, O mighty hero, is the scorching Vaitaraṇī river;

210.s:
tāntartuñca dadāmyenāṃ(2) kṛṣṇāṃ vaitaraṇīñca gāṃ /
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe mahādānāni nāma daśādhikadviśatatamo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 kṛṣṇā vaitaraṇī iti ja.. , jha.. , ṭa.. ca
2 tāntartuṃ vai dadāmyenāmiti cha..
:p 264
:ś athaikādaśādhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
nānādānāni
210.d:
तान्तर्तुञ्च ददाम्येनां(2) कृष्णां वैतरणीञ्च गां /
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे महादानानि नाम दशाधिकद्विशततमो
ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 कृष्णा वैतरणी इति ज.. , झ.. , ट.. च
2 तान्तर्तुं वै ददाम्येनामिति छ..
:प् 264
:श् अथैकादशाधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः
नानादानानि
210.m:
to cross it, I give this black cow [as] Vaitaraṇī.’
Thus ends the two hundred and tenth chapter, called ‘The Great Gifts’, in the great Purāṇa of Agni.
[Notes]
[Note] 1: ‘kṛṣṇā vaitaraṇī’ thus in ja, jha, and ṭa.
[Note] 2: ‘tāntartuṃ vai dadāmyenām’ thus in cha. / [Page 264]
Now the two hundred and eleventh chapter:
Various Gifts

211.s:
agnir uvāca
ekāṅgāṃ daśagurdadyāddaśa dadyācca gośatī /
śataṃ sahasragurdadyāt sarve tulyaphalā hi te //
211.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
एकाङ्गां दशगुर्दद्याद्दश दद्याच्च गोशती /
शतं सहस्रगुर्दद्यात् सर्वे तुल्यफला हि ते //
211.m: Agni said: / The owner of ten cows should give one cow; the owner of a hundred cows should give ten; / the owner of a thousand cows should give a hundred; indeed, they all obtain equal fruit.

211.s:
prāsādā yatra sauvarṇā vasordhārā ca yatra sā /
gandharvāpsaraso yatra tatra yānti sahasradāḥ //
211.d:
प्रासादा यत्र सौवर्णा वसोर्धारा च यत्र सा /
गन्धर्वाप्सरसो यत्र तत्र यान्ति सहस्रदाः //
211.m: Where there are golden palaces, and where there is that stream of wealth, / where there are Gandharvas and Apsarases, thither go the givers of a thousand [cows].

211.s:
gavāṃ śatapradānena mucyate narakārṇavāt /
dattvā vatsatarīṃ caiva svarhaloke mahīyate //
211.d:
गवां शतप्रदानेन मुच्यते नरकार्णवात् /
दत्त्वा वत्सतरीं चैव स्वर्हलोके महीयते //
211.m: By donating a hundred cows, one is freed from the ocean of hell. / And having given a heifer, one is honoured in the heavenly world.

211.s:
godānādāyurārogyasaubhāgyasvargamāpnuyāt /
indrādilokapālānāṃ yā rājamahiṣī śubhā //
211.d:
गोदानादायुरारोग्यसौभाग्यस्वर्गमाप्नुयात् /
इन्द्रादिलोकपालानां या राजमहिषी शुभा //
211.m: From the gift of a cow, one obtains long life, health, good fortune, and heaven. / She who is the auspicious royal buffalo-cow of the world guardians headed by Indra—

211.s:
mahiṣīdānamāhātmyādastu me sarvakāmadā(1) /
dharmarājasya sāhāyye(2) yasyāḥ putraḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ //
211.d:
महिषीदानमाहात्म्यादस्तु मे सर्वकामदा(1) /
धर्मराजस्य साहाय्ये(2) यस्याः पुत्रः प्रतिष्ठितः //
211.m: by virtue of the gift of a buffalo-cow, may she grant all my desires; / she whose son is established in the service of Dharmarāja,

211.s:
mahiṣāsurasya jananī yā sāstu varadā mama /
mahiṣīdānācca saubhāgyaṃ vṛṣadānāddivaṃ vrajet //
211.d:
महिषासुरस्य जननी या सास्तु वरदा मम /
महिषीदानाच्च सौभाग्यं वृषदानाद्दिवं व्रजेत् //
211.m: she who was the mother of Mahiṣāsura—may she grant boons to me. / From the gift of a buffalo-cow [comes] good fortune; from the gift of a bull, one goes to heaven.

211.s:
saṃyuktahalapaṅktyākhyaṃ dānaṃ sarvaphalapradaṃ /
paṅktirdaśahalā proktā dārujā vṛṣasaṃyutā //
211.d:
संयुक्तहलपङ्क्त्याख्यं दानं सर्वफलप्रदं /
पङ्क्तिर्दशहला प्रोक्ता दारुजा वृषसंयुता //
211.m: The gift named ‘a row of yoked ploughs’ yields all fruits: / a row is declared to be ten wooden ploughs equipped with bulls.

211.s:
sauvarṇapaṭṭasannaddhāndattvā svarge mahīyate /
:n
1 gavāṃ śatapradānenetyādiḥ, sarvakāmadā ity antaḥ pāṭhaḥ
jha.pustake nāsti
2 dharmarājasya māhātmye iti ja..
:p 265
daśānāṃ kapilānāṃ tu dattānāṃ jyeṣṭhapuṣkare //
211.d:
सौवर्णपट्टसन्नद्धान्दत्त्वा स्वर्गे महीयते /
:न्
1 गवां शतप्रदानेनेत्यादिः, सर्वकामदा इत्य् अन्तः पाठः
झ.पुस्तके नास्ति
2 धर्मराजस्य माहात्म्ये इति ज..
:प् 265
दशानां कपिलानां तु दत्तानां ज्येष्ठपुष्करे //
211.m:
Having given them fitted with gold bands, one is honoured in heaven.
[Notes]
[Note] 1: The reading beginning with ‘gavāṃ śatapradānena’ up to ‘sarvakāmadā’ is missing in the jha manuscript.
[Note] 2: ‘dharmarājasya māhātmye’ thus in ja. / [Page 265]
When ten tawny cows are given at Jyeṣṭha-puṣkara,

211.s:
tat phalañcākṣayaṃ proktaṃ(1) vṛṣabhasya tu mokṣaṇe(2) /
dharmo 'sitvañcatuṣpādaś catasraste priyā imāḥ //
211.d:
तत् फलञ्चाक्षयं प्रोक्तं(1) वृषभस्य तु मोक्षणे(2) /
धर्मो ऽसित्वञ्चतुष्पादश् चतस्रस्ते प्रिया इमाः //
211.m: the fruit is declared imperishable; and at the release of a bull [the mantra is]: / ‘You are four-footed Dharma; these four are your beloveds.

211.s:
namo brahmaṇyadeveśa pitṛbhūtarṣipoṣaka /
tvayi mukte 'kṣayā lokā mama santu nirāmayāḥ //
211.d:
नमो ब्रह्मण्यदेवेश पितृभूतर्षिपोषक /
त्वयि मुक्ते ऽक्षया लोका मम सन्तु निरामयाः //
211.m: Salutations to the lord of gods who is kind to brāhmaṇas, the nourisher of ancestors, living beings, and sages! / When you are released, may imperishable, disease-free worlds be mine!

211.s:
mā me ṛṇo 'stu daivatyo(3) bhautaḥ paitro 'tha mānuṣaḥ /
dharmastvaṃ tvatprapannasya yā gatiḥ sāstu me dhruvā //
211.d:
मा मे ऋणो ऽस्तु दैवत्यो(3) भौतः पैत्रो ऽथ मानुषः /
धर्मस्त्वं त्वत्प्रपन्नस्य या गतिः सास्तु मे ध्रुवा //
211.m: May I have no debt to the gods, to living beings, to ancestors, or to human beings! / You are Dharma; whatever is the destination of one surrendered to you, let that be mine permanently!’

211.s:
aṅgayeccakraśūlābhyāṃ mantreṇānena cotsṛjet /
ekādaśāhe pretasya yasya cotsṛjyate vṛṣaḥ //
211.d:
अङ्गयेच्चक्रशूलाभ्यां मन्त्रेणानेन चोत्सृजेत् /
एकादशाहे प्रेतस्य यस्य चोत्सृज्यते वृषः //
211.m: One should brand it with the discus and trident, and release it with this mantra. / The deceased for whom a bull is released on the eleventh day

211.s:
mucyate pretalokāttu ṣaṇmāse cāvdikādiṣu /
daśahastena kuṇḍena triṃśatkuṇḍānnivartanaṃ //
211.d:
मुच्यते प्रेतलोकात्तु षण्मासे चाव्दिकादिषु /
दशहस्तेन कुण्डेन त्रिंशत्कुण्डान्निवर्तनं //
211.m: is freed from the world of ghosts, as also at six months, the annual rite, and so on. / By a rod of ten cubits, thirty rods make a nivartana;

211.s:
tānyeva daśavistārādgocarme tatprado 'ghabhit(4) /
gobhūhiraṇyasaṃyuktaṃ kṛṣṇājinantu yo 'rpayet(5) //
211.d:
तान्येव दशविस्ताराद्गोचर्मे तत्प्रदो ऽघभित्(4) /
गोभूहिरण्यसंयुक्तं कृष्णाजिनन्तु यो ऽर्पयेत्(5) //
211.m: the same ten in extent make a gocarma; the giver of that destroys sin. / Whosoever offers a black antelope skin accompanied by a cow, land, and gold,

211.s:
sarvaduṣkṛtakarmāpi sāyujyaṃ brahmaṇo vrajet /
bhājanantilasampūrṇaṃ madhunā pūrṇameva ca //
211.d:
सर्वदुष्कृतकर्मापि सायुज्यं ब्रह्मणो व्रजेत् /
भाजनन्तिलसम्पूर्णं मधुना पूर्णमेव च //
211.m: even if he has committed all evil deeds, goes to union with Brahman. / A vessel filled with sesame seeds, and likewise full of honey,

211.s:
dadyāt kṛṣṇatilānāñca prasthamekañca māgadhaṃ /
śayyāṃ dattvā tu saguṇāṃ(6) bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt //
211.d:
दद्यात् कृष्णतिलानाञ्च प्रस्थमेकञ्च मागधं /
शय्यां दत्त्वा तु सगुणां(6) भुक्तिमुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् //
211.m: one should give, and one Māgadha prastha of black sesame seeds. / Having given a bed endowed with good qualities, one attains worldly enjoyment and liberation.

211.s:
haimīṃ pratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā dattvā svargas tathātmanaḥ /
vipulantu gṛhaṃ kṛtvā dattvā syādbhuktimuktibhāk //
:n
1 tatphalaṃ cākṣayaṃ syādvai iti ṭa..
2 vṛṣabhasya vimokṣaṇe iti kha.. / vṛṣabhasya ca mokṣaṇāditi
ja..
3 daivo 'theti kha.. , cha.. ca
4 tatprado 'ghanuditi śa.. / tatprado 'ghajiditi gha.. , ṅa.. ca
5 yastu kṛṣṇājinaṃ dadediti ṭa..
6 dattvottamaguṇāmiti gha..
:p 266
211.d:
हैमीं प्रतिकृतिं कृत्वा दत्त्वा स्वर्गस् तथात्मनः /
विपुलन्तु गृहं कृत्वा दत्त्वा स्याद्भुक्तिमुक्तिभाक् //
:न्
1 तत्फलं चाक्षयं स्याद्वै इति ट..
2 वृषभस्य विमोक्षणे इति ख.. / वृषभस्य च मोक्षणादिति
ज..
3 दैवो ऽथेति ख.. , छ.. च
4 तत्प्रदो ऽघनुदिति श.. / तत्प्रदो ऽघजिदिति घ.. , ङ.. च
5 यस्तु कृष्णाजिनं ददेदिति ट..
6 दत्त्वोत्तमगुणामिति घ..
:प् 266
211.m:
Having made a golden effigy [of oneself] and given it, heaven [is attained] for oneself. / Having built a spacious house and given it, one partakes of worldly enjoyment and liberation.
[Notes]
[Note] 1: ‘tatphalaṃ cākṣayaṃ syādvai’ thus in ṭa.
[Note] 2: ‘vṛṣabhasya vimokṣaṇe’ thus in kha; ‘vṛṣabhasya ca mokṣaṇāt’ thus in ja.
[Note] 3: ‘daivo ’tha’ thus in kha and cha.
[Note] 4: ‘tatprado ’ghanud’ thus in śa; ‘tatprado ’ghajid’ thus in gha and ṅa.
[Note] 5: ‘yastu kṛṣṇājinaṃ daded’ thus in ṭa.
[Note] 6: ‘dattvottamaguṇām’ thus in gha. / [Page 266]

211.s:
gṛhaṃ maṭhaṃ sabhāṃ svargī dattvā syācca pratiśriyaṃ /
dattvā kṛtvā gogṛhañca niṣpāpaḥ svargamāpnuyāt //
211.d:
गृहं मठं सभां स्वर्गी दत्त्वा स्याच्च प्रतिश्रियं /
दत्त्वा कृत्वा गोगृहञ्च निष्पापः स्वर्गमाप्नुयात् //
211.m: Having given a house, a monastery, an assembly hall, or a shelter, one attains heaven; / having built and given a cowshed, free of sin, one attains heaven.

211.s:
yamamāhiṣadānāttu niṣpāpaḥ svargamāpnuyāt /
brahmā haro harirdevair madhye ca yamadūtakaḥ //
211.d:
यममाहिषदानात्तु निष्पापः स्वर्गमाप्नुयात् /
ब्रह्मा हरो हरिर्देवैर् मध्ये च यमदूतकः //
211.m: From the gift of a buffalo belonging to Yama, one becomes sinless and attains heaven. / Brahmā, Hara, and Hari [should be placed] with the gods, and in the middle the messenger of Yama

211.s:
pāśī(1) tasya śiraśchittvā taṃ dadyāt svargabhāgbhavet /
trimukhākhyamidaṃ dānaṃ gṛhītvā tu dvijo 'ghabhāk //
211.d:
पाशी(1) तस्य शिरश्छित्त्वा तं दद्यात् स्वर्गभाग्भवेत् /
त्रिमुखाख्यमिदं दानं गृहीत्वा तु द्विजो ऽघभाक् //
211.m: holding a noose; cutting off his head, one should give it, and one becomes a sharer of heaven. / Having received this gift named Trimukha, however, a twice-born incurs sin.

211.s:
cakraṃ rūpyamayaṃ kṛtvā ke dhṛtvā tat pradāpayet /
hemayuktaṃ dvijāyaitat kālacakramidammahat //
211.d:
चक्रं रूप्यमयं कृत्वा के धृत्वा तत् प्रदापयेत् /
हेमयुक्तं द्विजायैतत् कालचक्रमिदम्महत् //
211.m: Having made a discus out of silver, holding it in water, he should have it given; / endowed with gold, [given] to a brāhmaṇa, this is the great Wheel of Time.

211.s:
ātmatulyantu yo lauhaṃ dadenna narakaṃ vrajet /
pañcāśatpalasaṃyuktaṃ lauhadaṇḍaṃ tu yo 'rpayet //
211.d:
आत्मतुल्यन्तु यो लौहं ददेन्न नरकं व्रजेत् /
पञ्चाशत्पलसंयुक्तं लौहदण्डं तु यो ऽर्पयेत् //
211.m: Whoever gives iron equal to one's own weight does not go to hell. / Whosoever offers an iron staff weighing fifty palas,

211.s:
vastreṇācchādya viprāya yamadaṇḍo na vidyate /
mūlaṃ phalādi vā dravyaṃ saṃhataṃ vātha caikaśaḥ //
211.d:
वस्त्रेणाच्छाद्य विप्राय यमदण्डो न विद्यते /
मूलं फलादि वा द्रव्यं संहतं वाथ चैकशः //
211.m: covered with a cloth, to a brāhmaṇa, the staff of Yama does not exist [for him]. / Roots, fruits, and the like, or wealth, combined or one by one,

211.s:
mṛtyujjayaṃ samuddiśya dadyādāyurvivardhaye /
pumān kṛṣṇatilaiḥ kāryo raupyadantaḥ suvarṇadṛk //
211.d:
मृत्युज्जयं समुद्दिश्य दद्यादायुर्विवर्धये /
पुमान् कृष्णतिलैः कार्यो रौप्यदन्तः सुवर्णदृक् //
211.m: one should give dedicated to Mṛtyuñjaya; one promotes life. / An effigy of a man should be made of black sesame seeds, with silver teeth and golden eyes,

211.s:
khaḍgodyatakaro dīrgho javākusumamaṇḍalaḥ /
raktāmvaradharaḥ sragvī śaṅkamālāvibhūṣitaḥ //
211.d:
खड्गोद्यतकरो दीर्घो जवाकुसुममण्डलः /
रक्ताम्वरधरः स्रग्वी शङ्कमालाविभूषितः //
211.m: holding a sword aloft in his hand, tall, with a garland of java flowers, / wearing red garments, garlanded, adorned with a necklace of conch shells,

211.s:
upānadyugayuktāṅghriḥ kṛṣṇakambalapārśvakaḥ /
gṛhītamāṃsapiṇḍaś ca vāme vai kālapūruṣaḥ //
211.d:
उपानद्युगयुक्ताङ्घ्रिः कृष्णकम्बलपार्श्वकः /
गृहीतमांसपिण्डश् च वामे वै कालपूरुषः //
211.m: his feet provided with a pair of sandals, with a black blanket at his side, / and holding a lump of meat in his left [hand]—the Person of Time (Kālapūruṣa).

211.s:
sampūjya tañca gandhādyaiḥ(2) brāhmaṇāyopapādayet /
maraṇavyādhihīnaḥ syādrājarājeśvaro bhavet //
211.d:
सम्पूज्य तञ्च गन्धाद्यैः(2) ब्राह्मणायोपपादयेत् /
मरणव्याधिहीनः स्याद्राजराजेश्वरो भवेत् //
211.m: Having worshipped him with perfumes and the like, he should present him to a brāhmaṇa; / he becomes free from death and disease, and becomes a king of kings and a ruler.

211.s:
govṛṣau tu dvije dattvā bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt /
:n
1 pāpo iti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
2 sampūjya vastragandhādyair iti ṅa..
:p 267
revantādhiṣṭhitañcāśvaṃ haimaṃ dattvā na mṛtybhāk //
211.d:
